trans-unit.target: 漫游车车轮的最大尺寸。

trans-unit.source: How large your chute can be, increasing its drag.
trans-unit.target: 降落伞的尺寸上限,尺寸越大阻力越大。

trans-unit.source: The length of a parachute chord can make it more stable.
trans-unit.target: 降落伞伞绳的长度会影响其稳定性。

trans-unit.source: The amount of volume in a command disc dedicated to store batteries.
trans-unit.target: 指令舱中用于存放电池的空间量。

trans-unit.source: The amount of volume in a command disc dedicated to store gyroscopes. These can point a craft but can be slow and expensive.
trans-unit.target: 指令盘中用于安装陀螺仪的容量。陀螺仪可以调整载具朝向,但响应较慢且成本较高。

trans-unit.source: The amount of volume available for each crew member in a compartment.
trans-unit.target: 舱室中每位乘员可用的空间大小。

trans-unit.source: Night Vision cameras allow you to see in the dark without the need of having lights, but they need at least some light to work.
trans-unit.target: 夜视摄像头让你在黑暗中也能看见,不需要灯光,但需要一些光线才能工作。

trans-unit.source: Lead pellets you can put in your fuel tanks to adjust the CoM.
trans-unit.target: 可以放入燃料箱中的铅粒,用于调整重心位置。

trans-unit.source: The pinch tool allows you to deform a fuselage to make it narrower on one side.
trans-unit.target: 捏边工具可以让你把机身压形,使一侧变窄。

trans-unit.source: The slant tool lets you make a diagonal cut to the top face of a fuselage.
trans-unit.target: 斜切工具可以让你把机身的顶面切成斜面。

trans-unit.source: The clamp tool lets you cut sections out of a fuselage.
trans-unit.target: 切平工具可以让你把机身切掉一段。

trans-unit.source: The curve tool lets you change the profile of a nosecone to any curve.
trans-unit.target: 曲线工具可以让你把头锥的截面改成任意曲线。

trans-unit.source: The amount of panels per row the array can have.
trans-unit.target: 阵列每行可以容纳的电池板数量。

trans-unit.source: The amount of rows of panels the array can have.
How much the panel can be stretched to tweak its shape.
trans-unit.target: 电池板可拉伸以微调形状的程度。

trans-unit.source: The brake torque affects how hard it can stop.
trans-unit.target: 制动扭矩影响其刹停力度。

trans-unit.source: How fast the electric motor can spin given enough torque.
trans-unit.target: 在扭矩足够的情况下,电动机能够转到的最高转速。

trans-unit.source: The torque of a motor defines how much force it can do.
trans-unit.target: 电机的扭矩决定它能输出多大的力。

trans-unit.source: The number of unique blades in the propeller assembly.
trans-unit.target: 螺旋桨组件中不同桨叶的数量。

trans-unit.source: A set of hinges in the propeller blades, allowing for a variable pitch to fine tune their AoA.
trans-unit.target: 螺旋桨桨叶上的一组铰链,允许可变桨距以微调迎角。

trans-unit.source: The brake torque affects how hard it can stop a wheel.
trans-unit.target: 制动扭矩影响其刹停车轮的力度。

trans-unit.source: Shock absorbers integrated in the wheels can help drive on bumpy terrain.
trans-unit.target: 集成在车轮中的减震器有助于在崎岖地形上行驶。

trans-unit.source: The torque of a motor defines how much force it can do.
trans-unit.target: 车轮的扭矩决定它能输出多大的力。

trans-unit.source: The ability to retract the landing gear to reduce its drag footprint.
trans-unit.target: 起落架的收放能力,收起后可减小阻力。

trans-unit.source: The amount of control surfaces you can pack in a single wing.
trans-unit.target: 单个机翼上可以容纳的控制舵面数量。

trans-unit.source: The wing chord is the size the wing can have between its front and back.
trans-unit.target: 翼弦决定机翼前后方向上的尺寸。

trans-unit.source: The wing span is its length, the distance between the root and the tip.
trans-unit.target: 翼展是机翼的长度,即从翼根到翼尖的距离。

trans-unit.source: How thick a wing can get, making them more resistant to snaps and increasing its fuel storage capacity.
trans-unit.target: 机翼的最大厚度,加厚后可更耐折断,并提升其燃料储存能力。

trans-unit.source: A solid propellant grain that results in a basic ramp up, hold, ramp down thrust curve.
trans-unit.target: 一种固体推进剂药柱,产生典型的爬升,保持,再下降的推力曲线。

trans-unit.source: A solid propellant with a hole in the center, resulting in a ramping up thrust curve.
trans-unit.target: 中心带孔的固体推进剂,推力曲线为逐渐上升型。

trans-unit.source: A solid propellant grain that results in a ramping down thrust curve.
trans-unit.target: 一种固体推进剂药柱,推力曲线为逐渐下降型。

trans-unit.source: A solid propellant grain designed to produce a constant thrust over its entire burn.
trans-unit.target: 一种在整个燃烧过程中能保持恒定推力的固体推进剂药柱。

trans-unit.source: A solid propellant grain that burns all the fuel at the start, resulting in a large impulse followed by a long residual thrust.
trans-unit.target: 一种在起燃时烧尽大量燃料的固体推进剂药柱,先产生一个大的冲量,随后是较长的残余推力。

trans-unit.source: Bell shaped nozzles provide better performance than their conical counterparts. This one is resizable.
trans-unit.target: 钟形喷管的性能优于锥形喷管,且该喷管尺寸可调。

trans-unit.source: Cone shaped nozzles are about as basic as a nozzle can be, but this one is resizable.
trans-unit.target: 锥形喷管是最基础的喷管形状,但这款尺寸可调。

trans-unit.source: It's a basic bell shaped rocket nozzle. More efficient than a cone.
trans-unit.target: 一款基础款钟形火箭喷管,效率高于锥形喷管。

trans-unit.source: Resizable bell shaped nozzle with more visual detail.
trans-unit.target: 可调尺寸的钟形喷管,带有更丰富的外观细节。

trans-unit.source: Advanced rocket nozzle with integrated cooling system.
trans-unit.target: 带集成冷却系统的高级火箭喷管。

trans-unit.source: Gigantic nozzle that pairs well with the Gas Generator II power cycle.
trans-unit.target: 超大喷管,与燃气发生器 II 动力循环搭配使用效果极佳。

trans-unit.source: A milled piece of graphite, the simplest possible plug to put at the end of a rocket.
trans-unit.target: 一块经过铣削加工的石墨塞,是最简单的火箭喷管。

trans-unit.source: Large nozzle made for solid rocket boosters.
trans-unit.target: 为固体火箭助推器设计的大型喷管。

trans-unit.source: A gimbaled version of the Echo nozzle.
trans-unit.target: Echo 喷管的万向可调版本。

trans-unit.source: Aerospike nozzles offer better performance across a wide range of altitudes than bell or cone nozzles.
trans-unit.target: 与钟形或锥形喷管相比,气尖喷管在各种高度范围内均表现出更优异的性能.

trans-unit.source: Gas generator is a powerful type of fuel injection capable of respectable chamber pressures.
trans-unit.target: 燃气发生器是一种强大的燃料喷射方式,能达到可观的燃烧室压力。

trans-unit.source: It's the muscle car equivalent for rocket engines. It's powerful, but it's not too efficient.
trans-unit.target: 相当于火箭发动机里的肌肉车——动力强劲,但效率不算太高。

trans-unit.source: Very advanced power cycle capable of extremely high chamber pressures.
trans-unit.target: 非常先进的动力循环,能够实现极高的燃烧室压力。

trans-unit.source: The holy grail of power cycles capable of the highest chamber pressures at the highest efficiency.
trans-unit.target: 动力循环中的圣杯,能够以最高效率实现最高的燃烧室压力。

trans-unit.source: The simplest possible rocket engine, it isn't very powerful but it works great in space. As a plus, it can gimbal, enabling for precise maneuvers.
trans-unit.target: 最简单的火箭发动机,推力不大但在太空中表现优异。此外,它的矢量范围大,从而实现精确操控。

trans-unit.source: A high tech rocket engine without a turbopump, using electric pumps to get the fuel into the chamber.
trans-unit.target: 一款没有涡轮泵的高科技火箭发动机,使用电泵将燃料送入燃烧室。

trans-unit.source: A solid rocket motor mounted on a sturdy gimbal capable of handling the high stress, enabling thrust vectoring for precise control.
trans-unit.target: 一台安装于坚固万向节上的固体火箭发动机,能够承受高强度应力,通过推力矢量控制实现精确操作。

trans-unit.source: A very small engine with very low efficiencies, perfect for hobbyists or stage separations.
trans-unit.target: 一款体积小,效率低的小型发动机,适合爱好者或用于级间分离。

trans-unit.source: An oversized version of the model rocket, perfect to increase the launch thrust of your rockets without spending too much.
trans-unit.target: 模型火箭的加大版,适合以较低成本提升火箭的起飞推力。

trans-unit.source: Very efficient, but it doesn't pack a punch.
trans-unit.target: 效率非常高,但推力不大。
体积小,但操控精准的发动机。

trans-unit.source: This can greatly increase fuel efficiency. All the cool engineers are doing it these days.
trans-unit.target: 可以大幅提升燃油效率,如今所有顶尖工程师都在用它。

trans-unit.source: Increasing compression can increase fuel efficiency (and thrust up to a point), but also increases the length and weight of the core.
trans-unit.target: 提高压缩比可以提升燃油效率(推力也会提升到一定程度),但同时也会增加核心机的长度和重量。

trans-unit.source: Reverse thrust lets you invert the force of the engine to help you brake the craft.
trans-unit.target: 反推力可以将发动机的推力反向,帮助你制动载具。

trans-unit.source: Afterburners can greatly increase thrust by lowering efficiency. And they look cool so win-win.
trans-unit.target: 加力燃烧室可以牺牲效率大幅提升推力,而且外观拉风,稳赚不亏。

trans-unit.source: The addition of liquid oxygen allows the jet engine to run in absence of an atmosphere.
trans-unit.target: 加入液氧后,喷气发动机可以在无大气环境下工作。

trans-unit.source: A chemical storage for your power needs, so you don't depend strictly on power generation.
trans-unit.target: 一种化学储能方式,可以在不依赖发电的情况下满足你的电力需求。

trans-unit.source: Plane juice, your everyday kerosene, ready to be pumped into a jet engine to spin it up.
trans-unit.target: 飞机喝的果汁,随时可被抽进喷气发动机里驱动它旋转。

trans-unit.source: A more refined version of the jet fuel mixed with liquid oxygen, providing high energy density.
trans-unit.target: 在航空煤油基础上精炼并混合液氧,具备高能量密度。

trans-unit.source: A very efficient fuel with an incredibly low density, requiring large tanks, mixed with liquid oxygen.
trans-unit.target: 一种效率极高的燃料,但密度极低,需要大型储箱,与液氧混合使用。

trans-unit.source: A light and efficient fuel right in between hydrolox and kerolox, mixed with liquid oxygen.
trans-unit.target: 一种轻质高效的燃料,性能介于氢氧和煤油液氧推进剂之间,与液氧混合使用。

trans-unit.source: Pure hydrogen without any oxidizer, necessary for combustionless nuclear engines.
trans-unit.target: 纯氢,不含任何氧化剂,是核热发动机所必需的燃料。

trans-unit.source: Purified tap water, useful not only as ballast but also for the combustionless nuclear engines.
trans-unit.target: 纯净的一氧化二氢,不仅可用作压舱物,也可用于核热发动机。

trans-unit.source: Nasty hypergolic propellant, easy to ignite but insanely toxic.
trans-unit.target: 易燃的剧毒自燃推进剂,极易点燃但毒性极强。

trans-unit.source: A solid paste easy to store and cheap to produce, that once ignited can't be turned off.
trans-unit.target: 易储存且成本低廉的固体膏状推进剂,一旦点燃就无法关闭。

trans-unit.source: A fuel tightly packed on the back of the Drood's suit, allowing for movement in space.
trans-unit.target: 紧凑封装在Drood宇航服背部的燃料,用于在太空中移动。

trans-unit.source: A noble gas with very heavy molecules, that once accelerated to high speeds can result in high efficiencies.
trans-unit.target: 一种分子量很大的惰性气体,加速到高速后能产生很高的效率。

trans-unit.source: The max amount of Droods that can be hired in the current sandbox.
trans-unit.target: 当前沙盒中可招募的Drood数量上限。

trans-unit.source: The more complex you need to make your crafts, the more stages you will need to manage part activations.
trans-unit.target: 载具结构越复杂,就需要越多级来管理部件的激活顺序。

trans-unit.source: Low efficiency but cheap panels, good enough to power your most basic needs.
trans-unit.target: 效率不高但价格低廉的电池板,足以满足最基础的用电需求。

trans-unit.source: An old but reliable technology, more expensive than thin film but at the same time, more efficient.
trans-unit.target: 虽古老但可靠的技术,比薄膜电池板贵,但同时也更高效。

trans-unit.source: Top tier solar panels, breaking the theoretical limits of maximum efficiency using fancy new materials.
trans-unit.target: 顶级太阳能电池板,使用新型材料突破了理论上的最高效率极限。

trans-unit.source: Low efficiency but cheap panels, good enough to power your most basic needs.
trans-unit.target: 效率不高但价格低廉的电池板,足以满足最基础的用电需求。

trans-unit.source: An old but reliable technology, more expensive than thin film but at the same time, more efficient.
trans-unit.target: 虽古老但可靠的技术,比薄膜电池板贵,但同时也更高效。

trans-unit.source: Top tier solar panels, breaking the theoretical limits of maximum efficiency using fancy new materials.
trans-unit.target: 顶级太阳能电池板,使用新型材料突破了理论上的最高效率极限。

trans-unit.source: You will get new contracts after unlocking this tech.
trans-unit.target: 解锁该科技后将获得新合同。

trans-unit.source: You will get new contracts after unlocking this tech if you already have 'Check Your Staging'.
trans-unit.target: 如果你已经拥有检查你的分级合同,解锁该科技后将获得新合同。

trans-unit.source: You will get new contracts after unlocking this tech, but they may require other dependencies like certain contracts being completed.
trans-unit.target: 解锁该科技后将获得新合同,但这些合同可能依赖其他前置条件,例如需要先完成某些合同。

trans-unit.source: A budget ion propellant. A touch less efficient than xenon, but you can scoop it from the air.
trans-unit.target: 一种更省钱的推进剂。虽然效率略低于氙气,但你可以从空气中获取它。

trans-unit.source: Liquefied methane, the fuel half of methalox. Easy to harvest or brew up for a refuel far from home.
trans-unit.target: 液态甲烷,即液氧甲烷的一半。易于采集或者发酵,以便在远离家园的地方补充燃料。

trans-unit.source: A storable monopropellant made from plain water. Gentler than hydrazine, but you can produce it just about anywhere.
trans-unit.target: 一种由普通水制成的可储存单组元推进剂。它比肼更温和,而且几乎可以在任何地方生产.

trans-unit.source: Liquid oxygen on its own, the oxidizer half of every bipropellant. Scoopable from any atmosphere that carries it.
trans-unit.target: 液氧,它本身是所有双组元推进剂中的氧化剂部分。可以从任何存在氧的大气中提取。

trans-unit.source: Highly refined kerosene, the fuel half of kerolox. Cheap, dense and easy to handle.
trans-unit.target: 高度精炼的航天煤油,是液氧煤油的一半。价格低廉,密度大,易于处理。

trans-unit.source: Just another aerospike but we had to cut some corners, it isn't as efficient but it is a tad lighter.
trans-unit.target: 虽然它也是一款气尖发动机,但我们不得不采取一些简化措施,虽然效率没那么高,但重量稍微轻一点。

trans-unit.source: A variant of the cargo bay with no doors, for whatever you may need to have just half a fuselage.
trans-unit.target: 一种无门的货舱变体,适用于只需要半个机身的各种需求。

trans-unit.source: Simpler and more rugged, this style of interstage will just ensure things don't come apart until you want.
trans-unit.target: 更简单更坚固的级间段设计,确保在你想要之前一切都不会分离。

trans-unit.source: A rocket chair to keep your crew comfy when under the high Gs of a launch.
trans-unit.target: 一款火箭座椅,让乘员在发射高过载下保持舒适。

trans-unit.source: A chair. Usable furniture. Ideal to sit down for a while and… yeah. A chair.
trans-unit.target: 一把椅子。可用家具。适合坐下来休息一会儿...没错,就是一把椅子。

trans-unit.source: Striped variants of all the fuselages, including fuel tanks, interstages, fairings… To add a pop of color to your crafts.
trans-unit.target: 所有机身(包括燃料箱,级间段,整流罩等)的条纹变体,为载具增添一抹色彩。

trans-unit.source: Jet engines are expensive components, this cover will sure make things look more professional.
trans-unit.target: 喷气发动机是昂贵的部件,这个整流罩能让发动机看上去很正经。

trans-unit.source: If you want to get fancy, chevron is the way to go, you will be cutting the air like butter.
trans-unit.target: 想要花哨,锯齿是必选之路,你将丝滑地划破空气。

trans-unit.source: A naked engine will afford you some mass, but leave the fragile components exposed to the elements.
trans-unit.target: 裸露的发动机会帮你减轻一些重量,但会让精密部件暴露在各种环境因素下。

trans-unit.source: You may try to lie to yourself thinking you want curved fans to get a better airflow, but we all know you just want their fancy looks.
trans-unit.target: 你也许自欺欺人地认为弧形风扇能带来更好的气动效益,但我们都明白你只是看中了它们花哨的外观。

trans-unit.source: As you get further away from the rotation axis the ideal angle of attack of the fan blades changes, this fan will match the ideal angle to result in the best looking engines.
trans-unit.target: 离旋转轴越远,风扇叶片的理想攻角就会改变。这种风扇能匹配理想角度,打造外观最佳的发动机。

trans-unit.source: A bunch of planks spinning fast. It does the job, but it sure is ugly.
trans-unit.target: 一堆高速旋转的平板。能干活,但确实难看。

trans-unit.source: The basic engine nozzle is boring, but effective, and for a cheap craft they will sure do the job.
trans-unit.target: 基础发动机喷管虽然平淡无奇,但效果不错,对于廉价载具来说完全够用。

trans-unit.source: Civilian nozzles are a fancier version of the basic, ideal for a wide range of sizes, from a small private one to a commercial passenger plane.
trans-unit.target: 民用喷管是基础款的升级版,适用范围广泛,从小型私人飞机到商用客机均可使用。

trans-unit.source: Who doesn't want to have a moving nozzle that adjusts its opening to maximize performance and allows for the hottests of exhausts?
trans-unit.target: 谁不想急头白脸整一个可调节开口的航发喷管,既能最大化性能又能承受最高温度的排气呢?

trans-unit.source: A double wheel, allowing for twice the traction and braking power.
trans-unit.target: 双轮配置,提供双倍的牵引力和制动力。

trans-unit.source: A single wheel attached on one of its ends.
A single wheel attached on both ends.
A curved door that will better match rounded fuselages.
trans-unit.target: 弧形舱门,能更好地匹配圆形机身。

trans-unit.source: Without a bay the landing gear will be left exposed once retracted.
trans-unit.target: 没有起落架舱,起落架收起后会暴露在外。

trans-unit.source: A flat door… yeah, that is all, it is flat and it is a door.
trans-unit.target: 一扇扁平的门...没错,就是这样,它是扁平的,它是一扇门。

trans-unit.source: A hinge that opens a pair of doors alongside the direction of the bay.
trans-unit.target: 一种沿舱方向打开一对舱门的铰链。

trans-unit.source: Just a hole, in case you hate aerodynamics.
trans-unit.target: 就一个洞,如果你不在乎空气动力学的话。

trans-unit.source: A hinge that opens a door towards one side of the bay.
trans-unit.target: 一种向舱一侧打开舱门的铰链。

trans-unit.source: A hinge that opens a pair of doors towards the sides of the bay.
trans-unit.target: 一种向舱两侧打开一对舱门的铰链。

trans-unit.source: Although their colliders are still pointy, rounded noses are perfect for anything spherical.
trans-unit.target: 虽然碰撞箱仍是尖的,但圆鼻头非常适合球形部件。

trans-unit.source: An aerodynamic package meant to be mounted at the front of a craft to split the airstream.
trans-unit.target: 空气动力学外壳,可以安装在载具前部以劈开气流。

trans-unit.source: A compact package ideal to just snap on the side of your craft to get a handy parachute.
trans-unit.target: 紧凑包装,只需装在载具侧面即可获得一个方便的降落伞。

trans-unit.source: A checkered pattern meant to make small parachutes easy to spot in the sky.
trans-unit.target: 棋盘格图案,便于在天空中快速定位小型降落伞。

trans-unit.source: A ringed parachute. It makes for a perfect target if you want to train your aim.
trans-unit.target: 环形条纹降落伞。如果你想练习瞄准,这是个完美的目标。

trans-unit.source: A striped parachute similar to the ones used in crewed capsules.
trans-unit.target: 类似于载人舱使用的条纹降落伞。

trans-unit.source: A small boat propeller, perfect for motorboats of small submarines.
trans-unit.target: 小型船用螺旋桨,非常适合摩托艇和小型潜艇。

trans-unit.source: A very large boat propeller made out of heavy steel. Watch out for the icebergs.
trans-unit.target: 重型钢材制成的大型船用螺旋桨。小心冰山。

trans-unit.source: A classic small aircraft propeller made out of aluminium. All rounded performance for a decent price.
trans-unit.target: 经典的铝合金小型飞机螺旋桨。全能型性能,价格合理。

trans-unit.source: A set of very agressive blades made out of composite materials, making them very light and powerful.
trans-unit.target: 一套采用复合材料制成的激进叶片,非常轻便且动力强劲。

trans-unit.source: Let it fool you. It looks like a helicopter but it lacks the swashplate. Players will surely find a way to make helis out of this.
trans-unit.target: 别被它骗了,虽然看起来像直升机但缺少倾斜盘,不过玩家们肯定会想出办法用它做直升机。

trans-unit.source: A curved blade capable of cutting through the air like a sword. Careful not to put your finger in it.
trans-unit.target: 能像利剑般切开空气的弯曲叶片,小心别把手指伸进去。

trans-unit.source: Carved out of wood to imitate the blades in the XX century fighters, perfect for replica lovers.
trans-unit.target: 仿照20世纪战斗机叶片雕刻而成的木质螺旋桨,复刻爱好者的首选。

trans-unit.source: A rim containing a motor with normal torque and gear reduction.
trans-unit.target: 内含标准扭矩和减速比的轮毂。

trans-unit.source: A rim containing a motor with low torque and a huge gear reduction to get good torque using less power, also keeping speeds down.
trans-unit.target: 内含低扭矩电机和超大减速比的轮毂,以更低功耗获得良好扭矩,同时也限制了速度。

trans-unit.source: A rim containing a motor designed for speed, with decent torque and a great gear increment allowing for very high speeds.
trans-unit.target: 专为速度设计的轮毂电机,扭矩适中,出色的增速比可实现极高的速度。

trans-unit.source: A rim containing a cheap motor with low torque and a normal gear reduction.
trans-unit.target: 内含廉价低扭矩电机和标准减速比的轮毂。

trans-unit.source: A rim containing a motor with tons of torque and a good gear reduction to further increase it.
trans-unit.target: 内含大扭矩电机和良好减速比的轮毂,可进一步提升扭矩。

trans-unit.source: A well balanced wheel with normal grip on any surface.
trans-unit.target: 一款平衡性良好的轮胎,在任何表面都有正常的抓地力。

trans-unit.source: A tire with insanely good offroad grip but very dense and expensive.
trans-unit.target: 越野抓地力极佳,但密度大且价格昂贵的轮胎。

trans-unit.source: A tire with great grip when offroad but mediocre over concrete.
trans-unit.target: 越野时抓地力出色,混凝土路面表现一般的轮胎。

trans-unit.source: The perfect tire for races, with very good grip on concrete but terrible when offroading.
trans-unit.target: 竞赛的完美之选,混凝土路面抓地力极佳,但越野时表现糟糕。

trans-unit.source: An average tire with decent grip on concrete and mediocre grip offroad.
trans-unit.target: 一款普通轮胎,在混凝土路面上抓地力不错,越野抓地力一般。

trans-unit.source: What Are You Even Trying To Do

trans-unit.note: Fits 429px at 20px. Contracts/*.xml: contract name + subtitle + flair + description (long/short). Keys auto-derived from contract id. Default and Hybrid Contracts/*.xml share these keys (Hybrid differs only in tiny typo edits). Per-completion-count variants use Completions<N>.{Long,Short}

trans-unit.source: Go higher than 25km and drop nearby.
trans-unit.target: 飞得比25公里高然后在附近降落。

trans-unit.source: Once you send your fireworks high enough, hitting a house in the village becomes a huge problem, but going too far makes finding the scraps annoying. Try to crash no farther than 20km, but no closer than 500m from the launchpad.
trans-unit.target: 一旦你把一枚没飞控的烟花送得够高,那么砸到村里的房子就会变成大麻烦,但飞得太远又会让搜寻残骸变得很烦人,设法把落点控制在距发射台500米到20公里之间。

trans-unit.source: Leave the atmosphere with a payload.
trans-unit.target: 携带有效载荷离开大气层。

trans-unit.source: Droo's atmosphere ends right under 80km, can you go to space to expose a probe a scientist has sent me?
trans-unit.target: Droo的大气层在80公里以下就结束了,你能进入太空去展示一位科学家给我送来的探测器吗?
在飞行中炸掉你的载具。

trans-unit.source: Fireworks are one of the best inventions of droomankind. Fly high, blow up.
trans-unit.target: 烟花是人类最伟大的发明之一。飞高点,然后炸掉。

trans-unit.source: Drop a rocket far from the village.
trans-unit.target: 把火箭送到离村庄远的地方。

trans-unit.source: Before hoping to reach space, you need some horizontal speed, since orbit requires going sideways more than up. Try to fall @Distance:distance away from the village.
trans-unit.target: 在希望到达太空之前,你需要一些水平速度,因为轨道需要更多的是横向移动而不是向上。试着在距离村庄 @Distance:distance的地方坠落。

trans-unit.source: Blow up to entertain the neighbors.

Everyone loves explosions, especially far from your property. Create a fireworks spectacle by blowing something up with enough kick at high altitude. You can find a fuel tank's explosive power in the Design Info panel in the designer.
trans-unit.target: 每个人都喜欢爆炸,尤其是在远离你房子的地方。通过在高海拔地区炸掉一些有足够推力的东西来创造一场烟花表演。你可以在设计器的设计信息面板中找到燃料箱的爆炸威力。

trans-unit.source: Drop a rocket in the water.
Polluting the oceans is bad, but neighbors complaining about things dropping on their lands is worse. Launch a rocket and drop it in any ocean.
trans-unit.target: 污染海洋是不好的,但总比邻居抱怨有东西掉在他们的土地上强。发射一枚火箭并把它投进任何水体里。

trans-unit.source: The scientist who gave me the probe you sent to space has some things for you to do, but he first wants to be sure you can reach orbit. Can you give it a go?
trans-unit.target: 送我探测器的科学家有些事情要你去做,但他首先想确认你能进入轨道。你能试试吗?

trans-unit.source: One advantage of a huge ramp on the edge of a cliff is you can fly without much effort. Go airborne for more than @Distance:distance after jumping off the end of the runway.
trans-unit.target: 悬崖边缘有一个大斜坡,好处是不用费多少力就能飞起来。从跑道尽头跳下后,在空中飞行超过 @Distance:distance。

trans-unit.source: You've already tried to jump as far as possible from the runway; now you have to take off from it. You can be wise and get some wings, or yolo it and find an alternative. You do you.
trans-unit.target: 你已经试过从跑道上尽可能远地跳出去;现在你要从跑道上真正起飞了。你可以稳妥地装上机翼,或者直接放手一搏找点别的办法。你随意。

trans-unit.source: Visit some locations in the Juno Village.
trans-unit.target: 在 Juno 村子里逛几个地方。

trans-unit.source: I want to be sure you know how to move around properly without blowing up (too much). Visit these 4 spots in any order. Once done, come to the Town Hall.
trans-unit.target: 我想确认你知道如何在不炸掉(太多)的情况下正确地四处移动。按任意顺序访问这4个地点。完成后,到镇政厅来。

trans-unit.source: Go up the peak near the village.

The peak right next to our village has some of the best views I've seen. Can you go up there to enjoy them and take a couple photos? If your craft slides too much, increase its torque by maxing out the Gear Ratio.
trans-unit.target: 紧挨着我们村子的那座山峰,拥有我见过的最棒的景色。你能爬上去好好欣赏一下,顺便拍几张照片吗?如果你的载具打滑太厉害,可以通过把齿比拉满来增加扭矩。

trans-unit.source: To bring some tourists to the village we're preparing some hiking routes. Can you help us scout them to see if they're viable?
trans-unit.target: 为了给村庄带来一些游客,我们正在准备一些徒步路线。你能帮我们勘察一下看看它们是否可行吗?

trans-unit.source: Follow the route up the mountain.

I've been watching videos lately and extreme sports seem trendy. To see if we can attract some sporty tourists, can you climb the mountain next to the village? It's tough, but we have a route planned to the top.
trans-unit.target: 我最近在看一些视频,极限运动似乎很流行。为了看看我们是否能吸引一些运动型游客,你能爬一下村庄旁边的山吗?这很艰难,但我们有一条通往山顶的规划路线。

trans-unit.source: Bring some supplies to the camp.

We need supplies brought to the camp on the mountain top. Drive or fly them, we don't care, just get them there. Careful not to bump the tents; these days they make them rock solid.

You can place these packages on your craft but they won't stick to it, so you'll have to figure out how to keep them from falling while still being able to leave them at the target. You can identify these non-sticky parts by their white attachpoints.
trans-unit.target:
我们需要把补给送到山顶的营地。开车也好,飞过去也好,我们不在乎方式,送到就行。小心别撞到帐篷,如今它们做得跟石头一样结实。

这些货物可以放到你的载具上,但它们不会粘在上面,所以你得自己想办法既不让它们掉下来,又能在到达地点后放下。你可以凭白色的连接点来识别这些没有连接点的货物。

trans-unit.source: Achieve an air-speed record without going too high.
trans-unit.target: 在不太高的情况下创造空速纪录。

trans-unit.source: The Wright Brothers were the first to fly at a whopping… 3m/s. You can do better, can't you?
trans-unit.target: 莱特兄弟是第一个飞行的人,速度达到了惊人的...3m/s。你能做得更好,不是吗?

trans-unit.source: To get airborne you need to catch some airspeed. The Mach number represents the speed of sound at a given altitude, and around the Village a Mach number of 0.25 is just under 100 m/s.
trans-unit.target: 要脱离地面你需要获得一些空速。马赫数代表给定高度下的音速,在村庄附近飞到0.25马赫,大概是略低于100 m/s。

trans-unit.source: Going supersonic is cool, but you have to aim for realistic goals. Can you first get to Mach 0.5?
trans-unit.target: 突破音障很酷,但你要设定现实的目标。你能先达到0.5马赫吗?

trans-unit.source: They call Mach 1 the sound barrier, but is it a barrier for you?
trans-unit.target: 他们称1马赫为音障,但对你来说它是一个障碍吗?

trans-unit.source: Going supersonic is fun, but where the real challenge starts is when you reach hypersonic speeds.
trans-unit.target: 超音速飞行很有趣,但真正的挑战是你达到超高速的时候。

trans-unit.source: Mountain villages aren't known for how fast you can drive past them, reaching 50km/h would be insane!
trans-unit.target: 山区村庄并不是以你能开多快经过它们而闻名,能达到50公里/小时就已经疯狂了!

trans-unit.source: 100km/h or 60mph has been always the reference speed for acceleration tests, can you even beat it?
trans-unit.target: 100公里/小时或60英里/小时一直是加速测试的参考速度,你能超过它吗?

trans-unit.source: By the time you are offroading at 200km/h you know you are into something… be aware of the bumps!
trans-unit.target: 当你以200km/h越野时你就知道你入坑了...小心颠簸!

trans-unit.source: Rapid and Raging (TM). This is already in the land of super-cars, do you have the drip?
trans-unit.target: 这已经进入了超级跑车的领域,你有那么炫酷吗?

trans-unit.source: It's time to dip your toes in the water. Find the closest pond, lake or ocean and try to see if you float.
trans-unit.target: 是时候试试水了。找到最近的池塘,湖泊或海洋,试试看你能不能浮起来。

trans-unit.source: Reaching 65 knots is something only reserved for the best interceptors, will they catch you?
trans-unit.target: 只有最好的快艇才能开到65节,他们会追上你吗?

trans-unit.source: You are an experienced sailor it seems, but drag hits hard underwater, go faster than 50 m/s.
trans-unit.target: 你看起来是个经验丰富的水手,但水下阻力很大,开快点,超过50 m/s。

trans-unit.source: If you haven't sunk yet, going at 70m/s shouldn't be that hard.
trans-unit.target: 如果你还没沉的话,以70m/s的速度航行应该不那么难。

trans-unit.source: It's time to gather some dust on those wheels. Make a car and drive it for @DistanceTarget:distance.
trans-unit.target: 是时候让车轮沾点灰尘了。造一辆车并行驶@DistanceTarget:distance。

trans-unit.source: Endurance is important if you want to show everyone you are both a great engineer and a skilled pilot. Go for a @DistanceTarget:distance drive.
trans-unit.target: 如果你想向所有人展示你既是伟大的工程师又是熟练的飞行员,耐力很重要。来一次@DistanceTarget:distance的驾驶。

trans-unit.source: Are you ready to go for a trip? I want to see if you are capable of driving around for @DistanceTarget:distance without falling asleep.
trans-unit.target: 你准备好出发了吗?我想看看你能不能在行驶@DistanceTarget:distance时不开小差。

trans-unit.source: Once you leave the atmosphere and you free yourself from its drag, there's nothing stopping you from going as fast as you want.
trans-unit.target: 一旦离开大气层,摆脱了空气阻力,就没有任何东西能阻止你想到多快就有多快。

trans-unit.source: Going at 2000 m/s doesn't sound impressive, until you realize that is 7200 km/h. That's some speed.
trans-unit.target: 2000 m/s听起来好像没什么,但换算一下就是 7200 公里/小时。这速度相当可以。

trans-unit.source: Reaching a LEO orbit means going really fast. The higher you go, the slower the speed, but the harder it is to get there. For a low orbit, you'll need to go faster than 3000 m/s.
trans-unit.target: 进入近地轨道意味着要飞得非常快。飞得越高,速度越慢,但到达那里就越困难。对于低轨道,你需要快于3000 m/s。

trans-unit.source: In order to get to the moons or even reach other planets, you will need some insane speeds.
trans-unit.target: 为了到达卫星甚至到达其他星球,你需要一些惊人的速度。

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in any order.
trans-unit.target: 按任意顺序通过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: This is a time trial, so get your boots tight! Go through all the checkpoints in any order before time runs out. The timer starts once you pass through any checkpoint.
trans-unit.target: 这是一次计时赛,系紧你的靴子!在时间耗尽之前按任意顺序通过所有检查点。计时器会在通过任一检查点时启动。

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序通过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: This is a time trial, so get your boots tight! Go through all the checkpoints in order before the time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 这是一次计时赛,系紧你的靴子!在时间耗尽之前按顺序通过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: I saw you gained access to the Ali Base recently, let's have some fun. This is a time trial, so get your boots tight!
trans-unit.target: 我看到你最近获得了Ali基地的访问权限,来找点乐子吧。这是一次计时赛,系紧你的靴子!

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序通过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: After watching you race in Ali, I noticed they have a really interesting wall all around the base. How fast can you ride it?
trans-unit.target: 在看你在Ali的竞速之后,我注意到他们基地周围有一圈非常有趣的墙。你能以多快的速度绕墙一圈?

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序通过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: This is a time trial, so get your boots tight! Go through all the checkpoints in order before the time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 这是一次计时赛,系紧你的靴子!在时间耗尽之前按顺序通过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: It seems like only yesterday you were launching from the village… Now we have even better taxiways! This is a time trial, so get your boots tight!
trans-unit.target: 好像就在昨天你还在从村庄发射...现在我们有更好的跑道了!这是一次计时赛,系紧你的靴子!

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: This is a time trial, so get your boots tight! Go through all the checkpoints in order before the time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 这是一个计时赛,系好鞋带准备开跑!在时间耗尽之前按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: This is a time trial, so get your boots tight! Go through all the checkpoints in order before the time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 这是一个计时赛,系好鞋带准备开跑!在时间耗尽之前按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: This is a time trial for planes, so get your gloves tight! Go through all the checkpoints in order before the time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 这次是飞行计时赛,戴好手套准备起飞!在时间耗尽之前按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: This is a time trial for planes, so get your gloves tight! Go through all the checkpoints in order before the time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 这次是飞行计时赛,戴好手套准备起飞!在时间耗尽之前按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: This is a time trial for planes, so get your gloves tight! Go through all the checkpoints in order before the time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 这次是飞行计时赛,戴好手套准备起飞!在时间耗尽之前按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: I saw some interesting hangars and overhangs around the DSC. Can you thread the needle? This is a time trial for planes, so get your gloves tight! Hit all the checkpoints in order before time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 我在 DSC 周围看到一些有趣的机库和挑檐,你能穿针引线吗?这次是飞行计时赛,戴好手套!在时间耗尽之前按顺序击中所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: While attempting an air race near Juno Village, a Drood crashed their SimpleCub! Can you safely bring them back to the Juno Village? Time is critical!
trans-unit.target: 一名Drood在Juno村附近的飞行比赛中,驾驶 SimpleCub 时坠毁了。你能把他们安全带回 Juno 村吗?时间紧迫!

trans-unit.source: A pair of reckless Droods pushed a SimpleOffroad to its limits and a little beyond that. Can you bring them back safely to the Juno Village?
trans-unit.target: 两个鲁莽的Drood把一辆 SimpleOffroad 越野车推到了极限,甚至突破了极限。你能把他们安全带回 Juno 村吗?

trans-unit.source: Fly low around the desert base.
trans-unit.target: 在沙漠基地周围低空飞行。

trans-unit.source: Our systems detected you flying around the planet, and you seem like the perfect candidate for one of our missions. We're validating the new ALI Base radars: fly 10km under 150m above the ground at mach 1 or above near the base.
trans-unit.target: 我们侦测到你在行星附近飞行,看起来你就是执行我们某项任务的完美人选。我们正在验证新的 ALI 基地雷达:在基地附近以不低于1马赫的速度,距地 150 米以下低空飞行 10 公里。

trans-unit.source: We've been closely following your launch activity and you seem to be doing pretty well. Our needs are a bit special, though: we need you to prove you can work with us by getting to orbit fast.
trans-unit.target: 我们一直在密切关注你的发射活动,你表现得相当不错。不过我们的需求有点特殊:我们需要你证明你能与我们合作——快速进入轨道。

trans-unit.source: Bring some crates to the outpost.
trans-unit.target: 把一些货物运到前哨基地。

trans-unit.source: We need to bring a couple of crates full of PETN to the desert base outpost. They're very delicate, so be careful with them — we don't need stunts for this one.
trans-unit.target: 我们需要把几个装满 PETN 的板条箱送到沙漠基地前哨。这些东西非常易碎易爆,所以请小心对待——这次任务不需要玩什么花活。

trans-unit.source: Bring some supplies to the Outpost.
trans-unit.target: 把一些补给送到前哨基地。

trans-unit.source: We need to bring some supplies to the Outpost, we don't care if you drive or fly them as long as they get there.
trans-unit.target: 我们需要把一些补给送到前哨基地,开车或飞过去都行,只要送到就好。

trans-unit.source: Bring some supplies to the Launchpad.
trans-unit.target: 把一些补给送到发射台。

trans-unit.source: We need to bring some supplies to the Ali Launchpad, we don't care if you drive or fly them as long as they get there.
trans-unit.target: 我们需要把一些补给送到 Ali 发射台,开车或飞过去都行,只要送到就好。

trans-unit.source: Algernon's private jet made an emergency landing on rough terrain. Luckily he wasn't aboard, just his crew. Bring them back to the Ali Outpost quickly, no time to waste.
trans-unit.target: Algernon 的私人飞机在崎岖地形上紧急迫降。幸运的是,他本人不在机上,只有机组人员。赶紧把他们带回 Ali 前哨基地,刻不容缓。

trans-unit.source: Somehow a Drood broke their motorboat and is stranded at sea. They've asked me for help, but I'm sure you're skilled enough to handle the situation yourself.
trans-unit.target: 不知怎么的,一名Drood的摩托艇坏了,被困在海上。他向我们求助,但我相信你完全有能力独自处理这种情况。

trans-unit.source: Pricklespac sent a team of Droods to the pole, but their Polar Exploration Vehicle fell into a crevasse and is inoperable. Bring them back to the Ali Base before they freeze.
trans-unit.target: Pricklespac 派了一队Drood去极地,但他们的极地探险车掉进了冰缝,无法开动。赶紧把他们带回 Ali 基地,免得冻坏了。

trans-unit.source: Shotwell has called for help with a SimpleRCV that is stuck in the middle of nowhere. Can you safely transport them to the DSC Port?
trans-unit.target: Shotwell 呼叫支援:一辆 SimpleRCV 困在了荒郊野外。你能安全地把它运到 DSC 港口吗?
1 名Drood,乘坐一艘 SimpleCrew 飞船

trans-unit.source: Yet another one of those cheap SimpleCrews still using 100% sized docking ports is leaking again. This time it was crewed, though. Can you figure out how to bring the Drood back?
trans-unit.target: 又是那种还在用 100% 对接尺寸的廉价 SimpleCrew 又漏气了,这次还载着人。你能想办法把那名Drood带回来吗?

trans-unit.source: Algernon sent a couple of Droods on a space trip aboard his flashy Rapture capsule and now they're stuck in space. He won't rescue them, so it's your job now. They have a 200% size docking port — figure it out.
trans-unit.target: Algernon 把几名Drood用他那浮夸的 Rapture 飞船送上了太空,现在他们困在太空里了。他不打算救他们,所以这次看你的了。他们的对接口是 200% 尺寸——动动脑筋吧。
3 名Drood,乘坐 Thermos 空天飞机

trans-unit.source: A crew of 3 is stuck in an experimental shuttle we launched a couple weeks ago into a polar orbit for some research I needed. It has a 400% size docking port; if you can figure out how, you can try to ride it back.
trans-unit.target: 一个3人机组被困在我们几周前发射的实验性航天飞机里,当时为了某项研究把它送入了极轨道。它有 400% 尺寸的对接口;如果你有办法,你可以试着搭乘它回来。

trans-unit.source: Shotwell needs help bringing back a Drood stranded in orbit of Luna, in a Bruno Capsule with a 100% size docking port. Don't mess this one up or it'll be terrible PR.
trans-unit.target: Shotwell 需要帮助把一名被困在Luna轨道上的Drood带回来,他坐的是一艘带 100% 尺寸对接口的 Bruno舱。这次可别搞砸了,否则公关会很糟糕。

trans-unit.source: 2 Droods in a LM Ascent Stage

Somehow Shotwell sent another mission to Luna, and it got stranded again. This time it's the Ascent Stage of their Luna Module, so it's on a really low orbit. It has a 100% size docking port; bring them back without crashing them into Luna.
trans-unit.target: 不知怎么的,Shotwell 又向Luna派了一次任务,结果又困住了。这次是他们Luna登月舱的上升段,所以轨道非常低。它有 100% 尺寸的对接口;把他们带回来,别撞上 Luna。

trans-unit.source: I have unsurprising news for you. Shotwell has lost yet another craft orbiting Luna, this time a flashy new Nebula Capsule with a 200% size docking port. It's on a really extreme orbit, good luck approaching it.
trans-unit.target: 我有个不太意外的消息要告诉你。Shotwell 又丢了一艘绕Luna飞行的载具,这次是一艘带 200% 尺寸对接口的崭新飞船。它的轨道非常极端,接近它可要小心。

trans-unit.source: Yet another Luna Module has malfunctioned, this time on the surface of Luna, and is inoperable. Try to bring those Droods back home.
trans-unit.target: 又有一艘Luna登月舱出了故障,这次是在Luna表面,而且无法运作。试着把那些Drood带回家。

trans-unit.source: The LunaTown Base got one of its windows punctured somehow, you need to get there really quick to rescue the two Droods that survived the event.
trans-unit.target: LunaTown 基地的窗户不知为何被人戳穿了,你得赶紧过去,把在那次事故中幸存的两个Drood救出来。

trans-unit.source: Another of Algernon's toys has failed, this time the electrical system in a Lunar Lander. Now the crew can't launch and their elevator won't work, so figure out a way to get them down to the surface and then back home.
trans-unit.target: Algernon 的玩具又坏了,这次是一艘月球着陆器的电力系统。现在机组成员既无法起飞,他们的电梯也用不了,所以想办法把他们先放到月面上,再带回家。

trans-unit.source: We have detected some potentially dangerous debris in orbit. You must eliminate it asap.
trans-unit.target: 我们在轨道上侦测到一些潜在的危险碎片。你必须尽快清除它们。

trans-unit.source: Get a payload to the DSC port.
trans-unit.target: 把一个载荷送到 DSC 港口。

trans-unit.source: If you show you can get your crafts to the water safely, we'll let you use our port in the future. This will make water recovery substantially cheaper.
trans-unit.target: 如果你能证明自己的载具可以安全开到水里,以后就允许你使用我们的港口。这会让水上回收的成本大幅下降。

trans-unit.source: Land a craft safely in the village.
trans-unit.target: 在村里安全着陆一架载具。

trans-unit.source: Our space center runways are a valuable asset we can't afford to lose, so first we need to ensure you can land safely in a rough situation. Build a crewed craft capable of Mach 3, then land it safely on the runway at the village.
trans-unit.target: 我们航天中心的跑道是宝贵的资产,不容有失,所以首先需要确认你能在恶劣情况下安全着陆。造一架能飞到3马赫的载人载具,然后在村里的跑道上安全降落。

trans-unit.source: Bring a large payload to the Hippolyta GS.
trans-unit.target: 把一个大型载荷送到 Hippolyta 地面站。

trans-unit.source: We're looking for someone who can carry a very large payload all the way down to the Hippolyta Ground Station. The Station has no runway, so we can't ship it ourselves. Pull this off and we'll let you use our best runway at the DSC.
trans-unit.target: 我们正在找能把超大载荷一路运到 Hippolyta 地面站的人。该站没有跑道,所以我们自己送不了。你能办成这事,我们就允许你使用 DSC 最好的跑道。

trans-unit.source: Land a booster on the Drone Ship.
trans-unit.target: 在无人船上降落一枚助推器。

trans-unit.source: Before you can launch from our best launchpad, we need to verify you know what you're doing. Get on a suborbital trajectory and then land on the barge to unlock the raised launchpad.
trans-unit.target: 在你从我们的最佳发射台发射之前,我们需要先确认你知道自己在做什么。先进入亚轨道,然后降落到回收船上,即可解锁DSC发射台。

trans-unit.source: Get a large payload to space.
trans-unit.target: 把一个大型载荷送入太空。

trans-unit.source: We want to see if you can put a @Mass:mass craft into orbit. If you can, we'll let you use our large launchpad. It's just a patch of concrete, but it'll let you launch really huge things.
trans-unit.target: 我们想看看你能不能把一架 @Mass:mass 的载具送入轨道。如果你能,我们就允许你使用我们的大型发射台。它只是一块水泥地,但它能让你发射真正的巨无霸。

trans-unit.source: Get a rover to Luna to drive around the South Pole base.
trans-unit.target: 把一辆漫游车送上 Luna,在南极基地周围开一开。

trans-unit.source: Before you can use our infrastructure at Luna, we need to check you can actually get there yourself and survive the environment. So, get a rover to the base and drive until you exit the crater, without flying there.
trans-unit.target: 在使用Luna上的基础设施之前,我们需要确认你自己能到达那里并生存下来。所以,把一辆漫游车送到基地,开着它直到驶出陨石坑,不许飞过去。

trans-unit.source: Bring a probe around the system and out.
trans-unit.target: 带一颗探测器在星系里转一圈再飞出去。

trans-unit.source:
After blowing our whole budget building the infrastructure on Luna, we're running short. I need something really impressive so we can ask for more funds.

We have a Traveler Probe ready: bring it to at least 3 of Juno's planets, then get it out of Juno's Sphere of Influence.
trans-unit.target:
在Luna上的基地建造花光了我们的预算后,我们现在资金紧张。我需要一些真正亮眼的东西,这样才能去申请更多经费。

我们有一台现成的 Traveler 探测器:带它至少经过Juno的3颗行星,然后再飞出 Juno 的引力影响范围。

trans-unit.source:
We need your help building the Space Port Esperanza (SPE) in Low Droo Orbit. First, bring up the Radix Module. This is a key step in the DSC's efforts to colonize the Juno System, so get it right and many contracts will follow.

We don't like leaving debris around Droo if we can avoid it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
我们需要你帮忙在Droo低轨道建造Esperanza空间港(SPE)。先把 Radix舱段送上去。这是 DSC 在 Juno 星系殖民工作的关键一步,做好了后面会有大量合同跟进。

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果可以避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source:
Now that Radix is in orbit, we want to start building up SPE. Dock the Expansion Module to the Radix Module; it brings needed resources and more docking capabilities, but you'll need to bring some monoprop yourself to maneuver it.

We don't like to leave debris around Droo if we can avoid it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
Radix已经入轨,我们要开始扩建 SPE 了。把扩展舱段对接到 Radix舱段上;它会带来所需资源和更多对接口,但你需要自带一些单元推进剂来机动它。

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果可以避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source:
Dock the Nexus Cross to the Space Port Esperanza. These docking hubs expand the SPE's docking capacity and will host future DSC Modules and even your own, but you'll need to bring some monoprop yourself to maneuver it.

We don't like leaving debris around Droo if we can help it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
把 十字扩展舱段 对接到Esperanza空间港。这些对接口会扩展 SPE 的对接容量,以后将容纳 DSC 舱段乃至你自己的舱段,但你需要自带一些单元推进剂来机动它。

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果能避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source:
Dock the Habitation Module to the Space Port Esperanza. These modules create a comfortable, spacious place for inhabitants to reside, but you'll need to bring some monoprop yourself to maneuver it.

We don't like to leave debris around Droo if we can avoid it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
把居住舱段对接到Esperanza空间港。这些舱段为居住者提供舒适宽敞的居住空间,但你需要自带一些单元推进剂来机动它。

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果可以避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source:
Dock the Cupola Module to the Space Port Esperanza. It'll give crew and tourists inside excellent views of Droo, but you'll need to bring some monoprop yourself to maneuver it.

We don't like leaving debris around Droo if we can avoid it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
把穹顶观测舱对接到Esperanza空间港。它会让里面的乘员和游客欣赏到Droo的绝佳景观,但你需要自带一些单元推进剂来机动它。

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果可以避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source:
Dock the Solar Array to the Space Port Esperanza. Once all the solar arrays are docked to the SPE, they'll provide enough power for all operations, but you'll need to bring some monoprop yourself to maneuver it.

We don't like to leave debris around Droo if we can avoid it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
把太阳能阵列对接到Esperanza空间港。一旦所有太阳能阵列都对接上 SPE,它们将为所有运行提供足够的电力,但你需要自带一些单元推进剂来机动它。

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果可以避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source:
Dock the @Name to the Space Port Esperanza.

We don't like leaving debris around Droo if we can help it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
把 @Name 对接到Esperanza空间港。

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果能避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source:
Dock the Fuel Depot Core to the Space Port Esperanza. This core infrastructure lets us expand our resources aboard the SPE, including keeping fuel for any future missions that need a bit of extra gas.

We don't like to leave debris around Droo if we can avoid it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
把燃料库核心对接到Esperanza空间港。这一核心基础设施让我们能够扩展 SPE 上的资源,包括为任何需要额外油气的未来任务储备燃料。

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果可以避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source:
Dock the @Name Fuel Sphere to the Fuel Depot Core. These fueling spheres have unique docking interfaces, so make sure you dock to the Depot Core!

We don't like to leave debris around Droo if we can avoid it. Make sure you safely deorbit your stage!
trans-unit.target:
把 @Name 燃料球对接到燃料库核心。这些燃料球有独特的对接口,所以请确保对接到燃料库核心上!

我们不喜欢在Droo周围留下碎片,如果可以避免的话。确保安全地把你的尾段分级离轨处理掉!

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: Buck told me you're a great pilot. I've prepared a plane race to watch you zoom past my window and see if it's true. Get ready for a real challenge.
trans-unit.target: Buck 告诉我你是个很棒的飞行员。我准备了一场飞行比赛,看你从我窗前呼啸而过,是不是真那么厉害。准备迎接真正的挑战吧。

trans-unit.source: Bring some supplies to the camp.
Bring some supplies to my research station near the Juno Village. You can drive or fly, as long as you don't break anything.
trans-unit.target: 把一些补给送到 Juno 村附近我的研究站。你可以开车或飞过去,只要别打烂东西就行。

trans-unit.source: Go through all the checkpoints in order.
trans-unit.target: 按顺序穿过所有检查点。

trans-unit.source: Your delivery to the Research Station was impressive. I've been looking for help for a while and you seem like a perfect fit. To test that, I need you to visit a series of landmarks. Speed isn't important, just visit them all in order. It's a long drive over steep terrain, so consider flying point to point, or a hybrid approach.
trans-unit.target: 你把东西送到研究站的表现真不错。我一直在找人帮忙,看来你很合适。为了试一试,我需要你跑遍一系列地标。速度不重要,按顺序走完即可。这是一段穿越陡峭地形的长途,可以考虑点对点飞行,或者陆地+空中混合方案。

trans-unit.source: Go to the indicated locations and inspect them.
trans-unit.target: 前往指定位置进行检查。

trans-unit.source: I need to grab some samples from one of Droo's biomes. Go there and grab @Samples samples.
trans-unit.target: 我需要从Droo的某个群系采集一些样本。去那里采集 @Samples 个样本。

trans-unit.source: Drop a payload in the ocean.
trans-unit.target: 把一个有效载荷投入海中。

trans-unit.source: I need to bring a submarine to the designated location to run some experiments, can you get it there?
trans-unit.target: 我需要把一艘潜艇送到指定位置进行一些实验,你能送过去吗?

trans-unit.source: Bring a container to one of the Ground Stations.
trans-unit.target: 把一个集装箱送到某个地面站。

trans-unit.source: I need some tools and resources to keep the Ground Station running, but it's really far from the Research Station. Can you bring me a container?
trans-unit.target: 我需要一些工具和资源来维持地面站的运转,但它离研究站很远。能帮我送一个集装箱过去吗?

trans-unit.source: Can you go to orbit? I need you to be close to a very specific orbit, can you make it there?
trans-unit.target: 你能进入轨道吗?我需要你非常接近一条特定轨道,你能到吗?

trans-unit.source: Carry a payload to the desired orbit.
trans-unit.target: 把一个有效载荷送到指定轨道。

trans-unit.source: I need help getting some satellites into orbit. Let's start easy: can you put this CubeSat into any orbit? I've added a deployer to ease integration, but you decide where it goes in the rocket. It can fit next to an engine, inside a fairing if you've unlocked them, or you can even eject the nosecone with an interstage holding the payload inside.
trans-unit.target: 我需要帮忙把一些卫星送入轨道。我们从简单的开始:你能把这颗 CubeSat 送入任意轨道吗?我已经加了一个部署器方便集成,至于放火箭哪里你自己定。它可以放在发动机旁边,整流罩里(如果你解锁了),甚至你可以用级间段把头锥连同有效载荷一起弹出去。

trans-unit.source: Carry a payload to the desired orbit.
trans-unit.target: 把一个有效载荷送到指定轨道。

trans-unit.source:
I have @SatCount @SatName@SatCount:s ready for orbit, mind helping? I've already added the deployment gear to ease integration.

You can do more than one satellite contract at a time, I won't complain as long as they reach their destination. If you do, make sure you assign the @SatName@SatCount:s to the right contract in the designer.
trans-unit.target:
我有 @SatCount 颗 @SatName 准备入轨,你能帮帮忙吗?我已经加好了部署装置方便集成。

你可以同时进行多个卫星合同,只要它们到达目的地就行。如果同时做多个,记得在设计器里把 @SatName 指派给正确的合同。
进入 Juno 同步轨道。

trans-unit.source: Heliosynchronous orbits use orbital precession to keep the orbit's position relative to the sun throughout an entire year. This game's physics aren't that fancy, but it's a cool orbit regardless. Can you get something into such an odd orbit?
trans-unit.target: 太阳同步轨道利用轨道进动,使轨道在整个一年中相对太阳保持相同位置。本游戏的物理没做到那么精细,但这仍是一个很有意思的轨道。你能把什么东西送入这样一个奇特的轨道吗?
把一架望远镜送到轨道上。

trans-unit.source: My satellites have detected weird activity on Droo's surface, can you bring a telescope to Droostationary orbit so I can observe what is going on?
trans-unit.target: 我的卫星侦测到Droo表面有异常活动,你能把一架望远镜送到Droo静止轨道上来观测发生了什么吗?

trans-unit.source: I need you to fly by Luna to study its orbital conditions. My studies show these bodies' physics are governed by something called 'Spheres of Influence', a region of space where their gravity is stronger than any other nearby body's, so your orbits are only affected by it.
trans-unit.target: 我需要你飞掠 Luna,研究其轨道条件。我的研究表明,这些天体的物理受所谓"引力影响范围"的支配,即在该空间区域内某天体的引力强于附近其他所有天体,因此你的轨道只受它影响。

trans-unit.source: I need you to fly by @Moon to study its orbital conditions. You just need to get close enough to be in its Sphere of Influence.
trans-unit.target: 我需要你飞掠 @Moon,研究其轨道条件。你只需要足够靠近,进入它的引力影响范围即可。

trans-unit.source: I need you to orbit Brigo so we can start studying it in depth. Get into its sphere of influence and slow down enough to get captured.
trans-unit.target: 我需要你绕 Brigo 飞行,这样我们就可以开始深入研究它。进入它的引力影响范围,减速到能被它捕获。

trans-unit.source: I need you to get in orbit of @Moon, with an apoapsis lower than @Apoapsis:distance
trans-unit.target: 我需要你进入 @Moon 的轨道,轨道远点低于 @Apoapsis:distance

trans-unit.source: Carry a payload to the desired orbit.
trans-unit.target: 把一个有效载荷送到指定轨道。

trans-unit.source: I have a @ProbeName Probe ready to be put into @Moon orbit, mind helping? I have already added the deployment gear to ease the integration.
trans-unit.target: 我有一颗 @ProbeName 探测器准备送入 @Moon 轨道,能帮个忙吗?我已加好了部署装置方便集成。

trans-unit.source: I need you to reach the surface of @Moon to carry some experiments. The sensors aren't very sensitive, so no need to soft land it — though I've added an airbag just in case.
trans-unit.target: 我需要你到达 @Moon 表面,以携带一些实验。传感器灵敏度不高,不必软着陆——不过我还是给它加了个气囊以防万一。

trans-unit.source:
I need you to bring a set of more sensitive sensors to the surface of @Moon, so no bouncing this time.

I've prepared a lander with an engine and legs, but you need to bring it to @Moon orbit and drive it down to the surface — not that I didn't trust you to build it.
trans-unit.target:
我需要你把一组灵敏度更高的传感器送到 @Moon 表面,这次不能弹跳。

我准备了一个带发动机和着陆腿的着陆器,但你需要先把它送到 @Moon 轨道,再控制它降落到表面——不是我信不过你的造物能力。
在 @Moon 上驾驶一辆漫游车

trans-unit.source:
I appreciate your landing skills, but I need a bit more precision. I've made a rover, can you bring it to @Moon?

This time you'll have to make the lander, bring the Rover there, and drive it for me. Remember, you can select @Moon in the craft info panel in the designer to better tune your engine thrust, and legs will help soften the touchdown.
trans-unit.target:
你的着陆技术我很佩服,但我需要更精确一点。我造了一辆漫游车,能帮我把它送到 @Moon 吗?
这次你需要造一个着陆器,把漫游车带过去,再开着它替我跑一段。提醒一下,在设计器里你可以在载具信息面板里选中 @Moon 来更好地调整发动机推力,着陆腿会让落地更稳。

trans-unit.source: Can you get to @Moon and safely land? Your craft has to stay landed for at least 30 seconds.
trans-unit.target: 你能到达 @Moon 并安全着陆吗?你的载具必须保持着陆至少 30 秒。

trans-unit.source: I need you to fly by @Planet to study its orbital conditions. You just need to get close enough to be in its Sphere of Influence.
trans-unit.target: 我需要你飞掠 @Planet,研究其轨道条件。你只需要足够靠近,进入它的引力影响范围即可。

trans-unit.source: I need you to get in orbit of @Planet, with an apoapsis lower than @Apoapsis:distance
trans-unit.target: 我需要你进入 @Planet 的轨道,轨道远点低于 @Apoapsis:distance

trans-unit.source: Can you get to @Planet and safely land? Your craft has to stay landed for at least 30 seconds.
trans-unit.target: 你能到达 @Planet 并安全着陆吗?你的载具必须保持着陆至少 30 秒。

trans-unit.source:
We have @Count @Count:plural(tourist|tourists) who want to feel special and tell their friends they've been to space, but they don't want to be cramped in a tight container for too long.

Get them out of the atmosphere for a few minutes and return them safely, keeping things smooth.

Don't bring random tourists, they haven't paid! Grab them from the Payloads section, they'll be waiting there.
trans-unit.target:
我们有 @Count 名游客想感受一下与众不同,然后回去告诉朋友自己上过太空——但他们不想在狭小的舱里挤太久。

把他们带出大气层几分钟,再安全送回来,全程尽量平稳。

不要随便带游客,他们可没付钱!从有效载荷区拉人,他们在那里等你。
处于Droo的引力影响范围内

trans-unit.source: Time to fly! Are you ready?
trans-unit.target: 是时候飞了!你准备好了吗?
从村子里的发射台发射

trans-unit.source: %ActivateInstruction% to activate your first stage, igniting your engine. Since it's a solid engine, once ignited you won't be able to stop it or adjust its power.
trans-unit.target: %ActivateInstruction% 激活你的第一级,点燃发动机。因为它是固体发动机,点燃后就停不下来,也无法调节推力。

trans-unit.source: Wait for your engine to ramp up
At the bottom of your screen you can find the main dashboard.
trans-unit.target: 屏幕底部就是主仪表盘。

trans-unit.source: You can switch between AGL and ASL altitudes. AGL is your distance to the ground (or to the water above oceans); ASL is your distance to Sea Level, useful once you're high enough to ignore the terrain, since it better shows how close to space you are.
trans-unit.target: 你可以在 离地高度 和 海拔高度之间切换。离地是你距地面(或海面以上)的距离;海拔 是你距海平面的距离,在飞得够高,不必在意地形时很有用,因为它能更准确地告诉你离太空还有多远。

trans-unit.source: You can also switch between Surface and Orbit speeds. Surface accounts for the planet's rotation, while Orbit doesn't. Whenever you target another craft, a third mode shows your relative speed.
trans-unit.target: 你也可以在 地面速度 和 轨道速度之间切换。地面速度考虑了行星自转,轨道速度则没有。一旦你锁定了另一艘载具,会出现第三种模式,显示相对速度。

trans-unit.source: As you change modes, you'll see the green arrow in the nav sphere move around. It adapts to your velocity mode to show where forward is pointing. Again, with something targeted, it shows the direction of your relative speed.
trans-unit.target: 当你切换模式时,导航球里的绿色箭头会移动。它会适配你的速度模式,指明 "前进" 的方向。同理,锁定目标时,它会显示相对速度的方向。

trans-unit.source: Use the nav sphere to change your rocket's heading. This automatically uses the engine gimbals, wings, gyroscopes, and more to try to point the craft where you want.
trans-unit.target: 用导航球来改变火箭的航向。它会自动利用发动机万向节,机翼,陀螺仪等,试图把载具指向你想要的方向。

trans-unit.source: A really useful tool for any pilot is the nav ball. This sphere of strikes and numbers shows where you're looking. Its two colored halves are split by the horizon line. If all's going well right now you shouldn't see it, since your craft is pointing up.
trans-unit.target: 对任何飞行员来说,姿态球都是非常有用的工具。这个由线条和数字组成的球体显示了你的朝向。它的两个色半区由地平线分割。如果一切顺利,你现在应该看不到它,因为你的载具正指着上方。

trans-unit.source: You also have a map to find where you are. You can zoom in and out and change its orientation. It can be really useful, especially early on before you've unlocked the more advanced map view.
trans-unit.target: 你还有一张地图可以查看自己所在的位置。你可以缩放和切换方向。它非常有用,特别是在你还没解锁更高级地图视图的早期。
开始时距地面1公里以内。
让火箭的加速度超过 10 m/s²
达到 25 公里 ASL(海拔高度)。

trans-unit.source: Crash at least 500m away from the village.
trans-unit.target: 坠毁点离村子至少 500 米。

trans-unit.source: Time to touch down! No need to survive this one.
trans-unit.target: 是时候落地了!这次不需要你活下来。
携带有效载荷一起发射。
处于Droo的引力影响范围内
从村子里的发射台发射

trans-unit.source: Wait for your first stage to run out of fuel.
Now it's on you, wait until the rocket goes higher than 80km and then stage again to expose the probe.
trans-unit.target: 现在看你的了,等到火箭飞到 80 公里以上,再次分级让探测器暴露出来。

trans-unit.source: Select a part to blow it up
trans-unit.target: 选择一个部件把它炸掉

trans-unit.source: You've reached the necessary altitude, now it's time to blow this thing up! Select a fuel tank by clicking it to show a menu with more details about the part and a nice orange button. That's where the boom begins.
trans-unit.target: 你已经到达必要的高度,现在该把这东西炸掉了!点击一个燃料箱以显示该部件的详细信息菜单和一个漂亮的橙色按钮。爆炸就从那里开始。

trans-unit.source: Select your command disc and blow up the craft before it goes too low!
trans-unit.target: 选中指令盘,在载具飞得太低之前把它炸掉!
处于Droo的引力影响范围内

trans-unit.source: Crash at least @Distance:distance away from the village.
Time to touch down! No need to survive this one.
trans-unit.target: 是时候落地了!这次不需要你活下来。

trans-unit.source: Make sure the explosion has more than @Explosion boom power in a single fuel tank.
trans-unit.target: 确保单个燃料箱的爆炸威力超过 @Explosion。
处于Droo的引力影响范围内

trans-unit.source: Time to drop, fall in the water.
trans-unit.target: 是时候落水了,落进水里。
处于Droo的引力影响范围内
从村子里的发射台发射

trans-unit.source: %ActivateInstruction% to activate your first stage. This will activate your engines.
trans-unit.target: %ActivateInstruction% 激活你的第一级。这会点燃你的发动机。

trans-unit.source: Wait until the booster's fuel is depleted. Your next step will happen at around 6km AGL, so relax, but not too much.
trans-unit.target: 等助推器燃料耗尽。下一步会在大约6公里 AGL 时发生,所以放松一点,但也别太放松。

trans-unit.source: %ActivateInstruction% to activate your second stage. Remember to throttle up this time, it's no longer a solid motor.
trans-unit.target: %ActivateInstruction% 激活你的第二级。记得把节流阀拉满,这可不是固体发动机了。

trans-unit.source: Your rocket will now start tilting. This is important because to be in orbit you need to go sideways very fast.
trans-unit.target: 你的火箭现在会开始倾斜,这很重要——要进入轨道,你需要向侧面飞得非常快。

trans-unit.source: You can build your rocket to follow a natural gravity turn. This forces it to pitch down as it rises, following an efficient path to orbit without the need for complex guidance systems.
trans-unit.target: 你可以把火箭设计成沿自然的重力转向飞行。这样它会在上升过程中自动低头俯仰,沿着一条高效路径进入轨道,不需要复杂的制导系统。

trans-unit.source: Wait until the fuel in this stage is depleted.
%ActivateInstruction% to activate your third stage. Third time is the charm.
trans-unit.target: %ActivateInstruction% 激活你的第三级。第三次才见真章。

trans-unit.source: Almost there, burn your engine until your Apoapsis passes 150km. The Apoapsis is the highest point in your trajectory.
trans-unit.target: 快到了,一直工作到轨道远点超过 150 公里。轨道远点是轨迹上最高的一点。

trans-unit.source: You can speed up game time to reduce waiting. Wait until you're out of the atmosphere to increase game speed.
trans-unit.target: 你可以加快游戏时间以减少等待。等到飞出大气层后再提高游戏速度。

trans-unit.source: Your final maneuver can be performed more efficiently closer to your apoapsis, wait until you are just 10 seconds away from it.
trans-unit.target: 你最后的机动最好在接近轨道远点时执行,等到距离轨道远点大约 10 秒再操作。

trans-unit.source: At last, raise your periapsis, the lowest point in the orbit, until it's higher than the atmosphere. This way you won't touch it at any moment, keeping you in orbit.
trans-unit.target: 最后,提高轨道近点——也就是轨道的最低点——直到它高于大气层。这样你才不会在任何时刻碰到它,稳定保持在轨道上。

trans-unit.source: You need to go faster than 3300 m/s to get to orbital speeds at this height, you are almost there!
trans-unit.target: 在这个高度你需要超过 3300 m/s才能达到入轨速度,你快到了!

trans-unit.source: Now that you have reached orbit you are going to be asked to get to precise orbits, let's see how that is done.
trans-unit.target: 你已经成功入轨,接下来会被要求进入精确轨道,让我们看看怎么做。

trans-unit.source: The easiest way to adjust an orbit is to wait until the craft reaches its highest or lowest point and change one thing at a time. To adjust the apoapsis, be at the periapsis, and vice versa.
trans-unit.target: 调整轨道的最简单办法,是等到载具到达最高点或最低点时,一次只改一个量。要调轨道远点,就在轨道近点操作;反之亦然。

trans-unit.source: Since your apoapsis went a tad too high, the orbit is very elliptical. Let's make it more circular by waiting until you're at periapsis to lower it.
trans-unit.target: 因为你的轨道远点拉得过高,轨道非常椭圆。让我们等到接近轨道近点时把它降下来,让轨道更接近正圆。

trans-unit.source: Let's wait for the craft to be close to its periapsis.
trans-unit.target: 让我们等到载具接近轨道近点。
处于Droo的引力影响范围内

trans-unit.source: Time to fly! Are you ready?
trans-unit.target: 是时候起飞了!你准备好了吗?

trans-unit.source: Controlling a vehicle's heading is very important. For cars it's typical to use either Yaw or Roll. This one uses Roll, but let's try both.
trans-unit.target: 控制载具的航向非常重要。对汽车来说,通常用偏航或滚转来控制。这辆车用的是滚转,但我们两种都试试。

trans-unit.source: Controlling a vehicle's heading is very important. For cars it's typical to use either Yaw or Roll. This one uses Roll, but let's try both.
trans-unit.target: 控制载具的航向非常重要。对汽车来说,通常用偏航或滚转来控制。这辆车用的是滚转,但我们两种都试试。

trans-unit.source: As expected Roll did nothing, now look at the front wheels while using Yaw.
trans-unit.target: 果然滚转没用,现在看看前轮——我们用偏航试试。

trans-unit.source: As expected Roll did nothing, now look at the front wheels while using Yaw.
trans-unit.target: 果然滚转没用,现在看看前轮——我们用偏航试试。

trans-unit.source: Sometimes you may find the input of the wheels set to the Throttle, but that doesn't let you reverse the car, let's use Pitch instead.
trans-unit.target: 有时你会发现车轮输入被设成了节流阀,但那没法倒车。我们用俯仰代替。

trans-unit.source: If you want to have finer control or to leave an input fixed at a defined value then you can use the input sliders.
trans-unit.target: 如果你想要更精细的控制,或者把某个输入固定在某个值,可以使用输入滑块。

trans-unit.target: 处于Droo的引力影响范围内

trans-unit.source: Time to fly! Are you ready?
trans-unit.target: 是时候飞了!你准备好了吗?

trans-unit.source: In the 'The Jump' tutorial we had you use pitch for the wheels, but now pitch controls the wings, so let's figure out the new controls.
trans-unit.target: 在 "一个大跳" 教程里我们让你用俯仰来控制车轮,但现在俯仰控制的是机翼,让我们来熟悉一下新的控制方式。

trans-unit.source: Look at the wing while using the pitch and roll to see the control surfaces move.
trans-unit.target: 操纵时机翼,观察俯仰和滚转时控制舵面是如何运动的。

trans-unit.source: The pitch inputs are inverted, pushing down will pitch up, pushing up will pitch down.
trans-unit.target: 俯仰输入是反的——往下推会抬头,往上推会低头。

trans-unit.source: The pitch inputs are inverted, pushing down will pitch up, pushing up will pitch down.
trans-unit.target: 俯仰输入是反的——往下推会抬头,往上推会低头。

trans-unit.source: The roll inputs let you tilt the plane to a side. This, combined with pitch will let you turn around.
trans-unit.target: 滚转输入让你把飞机向一侧倾斜。和俯仰配合使用,就可以转弯。

trans-unit.source: The roll inputs let you tilt the plane to a side. This, combined with pitch will let you turn around.
trans-unit.target: 滚转输入让你把飞机向一侧倾斜。和俯仰配合使用,就可以转弯。

trans-unit.source: Set your throttle to max to gather speed and try to keep it straight, since you won't have any source of propulsion after take-off.
trans-unit.target: 把节流阀推到最大以加速,尽量保持直线,因为起飞后你就没有动力来源了。

trans-unit.source: Roll down to the end of the runway

trans-unit.target: 我们把车轮关掉以免浪费电池,然后开启自动驾驶。自动驾驶会尽力让你保持在期望的航向上。

trans-unit.source: Great job! Now it's time to have some fun before you lose your speed, let's do some loops!
trans-unit.target: 干得漂亮!趁你还没失去速度,让我们来点乐趣,做几个筋斗!

trans-unit.source: This is a present from a small distant world, a token of our sounds, our science, our images, our music, our thoughts, and our feelings. We are trying to survive our time so we may live into yours. We hope someday, having solved the problems we face, to join a community of galactic civilizations. This record represents our hope, our determination, and our good will in a vast and awesome universe.
