Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from BeaconLight1.xml
Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Block1.xml
Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Camera1.xml

trans-unit.source: Attach to your craft to add new views that you can cycle through during flight.
trans-unit.target: 连接到你的载具上,在飞行过程中添加可以切换的新视角。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CargoBay1.xml

trans-unit.source: Cargo bay that can hold stuff and comes with two hinged doors by default.
trans-unit.target: 可容纳物品的货舱,默认带有两个铰链门。

trans-unit.source: Cargo bay that can hold stuff and comes with a single sliding door by default.
trans-unit.target: 可容纳物品的货舱,默认带有单个滑动门。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Cockpit1.xml
Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CockpitBundle.xml

trans-unit.source: It's a cockpit. For planes, or whatever.
trans-unit.target: 这就是座舱。用于飞机,或者其他什么。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CockpitCanopy1.xml
Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CommandChip1.xml

trans-unit.source: Compact and lightweight alternative to using a Space Capsule for controlling a craft.
trans-unit.target: 紧凑轻量的太空舱替代品,用于控制载具。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CommandDisc1.xml

trans-unit.source: A pack combining a command chip with room for batteries and gyroscopes, giving you all you need to control your craft in a single, more configurable part.
trans-unit.target: 将指令芯片与电池和陀螺仪空间结合在一起的组合件,在单一且可配置性更高的部件中提供控制载具所需的一切。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CommandPod1.xml

trans-unit.source: Controls the craft. Every rocket must have at least one command pod. This command pod has a built-in gyroscope for attitude control. Batteries are included.
trans-unit.target: 控制载具。每个火箭必须至少有一个指令舱。此指令舱内置姿态控制陀螺仪,并包含电池。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CommandPod2.xml

trans-unit.source: Space capsule which includes a small amount of fuel and built-in engines.
trans-unit.target: 包含少量燃料和内置发动机的太空舱。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CommandPod3.xml

trans-unit.source: Space capsule that has a bit more legroom than the alternatives. Great capsule if you love your country and if you have the money.
trans-unit.target: 比其他替代品有更多空间的太空舱。如果你热爱你的国家,而且有钱的话,这是个不错的选择。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CommandPod4.xml

trans-unit.source: Controls the craft. Every rocket must have at least one capsule or command chip. Includes built-in gyroscope for attitude control. Batteries are included.
trans-unit.target: 控制载具。每个火箭必须至少有一个太空舱或指令芯片。内置姿态控制陀螺仪,并包含电池。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CommandPod5.xml

trans-unit.source: Controls the craft. Every rocket must have at least one capsule or command chip. This capsule has a built-in gyroscope for attitude control. Batteries are included.
trans-unit.target: 控制载具。每个火箭必须至少有一个太空舱或指令芯片。此太空舱内置姿态控制陀螺仪,并包含电池。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CommandPod6.xml

trans-unit.source: Spherical space capsule that fits quite nicely on top of the Vroz Descent Module in case you want to bring more people into space.
trans-unit.target: 球形太空舱,如果你想带更多人进入太空的话,非常适合安装在弗洛兹太空舱上方.

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from CrewCompartment.xml

trans-unit.source: A fuselage capable of holding crew inside, but with a very low density. Ideal for large vehicles such as spaceships, space stations and the like.
trans-unit.target: 可容纳船员的机身,但密度非常低。非常适合大型载具,如宇宙飞船,空间站等。

trans-unit.source: A fuselage that holds crew with a high density of seats, but a limited working pressure range. Under too much or too little pressure, it takes damage.
trans-unit.target: 可容纳船员的机身,座位密度高,但工作压力范围有限。压力过大或过小都会造成损坏。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Detacher1.xml

trans-unit.source: Use this to split your craft into stages.
trans-unit.target: 用这个来将你的载具分离成多个分级。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from DetacherSide1.xml

trans-unit.source: Interstage that is designed to connect to the side of a fuel tank, but can connect to other places, too.
trans-unit.target: 设计用于连接到燃料箱侧面的级间段,但也可以连接到其他地方。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from DockingPort1.xml

trans-unit.source: Allows connecting two crafts in flight so they can be friends and transfer fuel.
trans-unit.target: 允许在飞行中连接两个载具,使它们成为朋友并转移燃料。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from ElectricMotor1.xml

trans-unit.source: Motor that can continuously rotate parts. Uses Electricity.
trans-unit.target: 可以连续旋转部件的电机。使用电力。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from ElectricMotor2.xml

trans-unit.source: Motor that can continuously rotate parts. Uses Electricity.
trans-unit.target: 可以连续旋转部件的电机。使用电力。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Engine1.xml

trans-unit.source: Powerful engine that can be used for takeoff and orbiting. Not a great choice for landing on moons.
trans-unit.target: 可用于起飞和轨道的强力发动机。用于在卫星上着陆不是好选择。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Engine2.xml

trans-unit.source: Lower power engine useful for second stages and landing on small planetary bodies.
trans-unit.target: 功率较低的发动机,适合用于上面级和在小型天体上着陆。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Engine3.xml

trans-unit.source: It's heavy, expensive, and drinks RP-1 like there's no tomorrow, but it will have the power to get even your most poorly engineered contraptions into space.
trans-unit.target: 它又重又贵,跟不要命一样消耗RP-1,但它有足够的动力把你那些设计糟糕的玩意儿送入太空。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Eva-Tourist.xml

trans-unit.source: They pay money to go places, but sadly they lack jetpacks and grappling hooks, how useless…
trans-unit.target: 他们付钱去各地,但遗憾的是他们没有喷气背包和抓钩,真没用…

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Eva.xml

trans-unit.source: A mysterious being that resembles an Earthling. They can be a bit fragile but are great at exploring and piloting. Put them into cockpits, cabins, or seats to control your crafts even without power, and get them out in flight to have a walk.
trans-unit.target: 一种类似地球人的神秘生物。可能有点脆弱还不耐摔,但在探索和驾驶方面很出色。把他们放进航天舱,飞船或驾驶舱中,即使没有电力也能控制你的载具,或者在飞行中让他们出去散步。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from EvaChair1.xml

trans-unit.source: Astronauts will stand as long as you ask them to, but sometimes it's nice to give them a break and let them sit down.
trans-unit.target: 只要你想,宇航员会一直站着,但有时给让他们坐下休息一下也挺好的。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Fairing1.xml

trans-unit.source: Protects precious cargo on its way to space.
trans-unit.target: 保护珍贵的载荷前往太空。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from FairingBase1.xml

trans-unit.source: The base of your fairings. When using fairings, this must be the first part you connect to your craft.
trans-unit.target: 整流罩的底座。使用整流罩时,这必须是你连接到载具的第一个部件。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from FairingNoseCone1.xml

trans-unit.source: Nose cone specially designed to only connect to fairings.
trans-unit.target: 专门设计用于仅连接到整流罩的鼻锥。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Fin1.xml

trans-unit.source: Smaller wing section designed for rockets.
trans-unit.target: 为火箭设计的小型翼面。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from FuelAdapter1.xml

trans-unit.source: Makes it easier to connect engines to odd places on fuel tanks.
trans-unit.target: 使发动机更容易连接到燃料箱的奇怪位置。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Fuselage1.xml

trans-unit.source: Versatile fuel tank that can be resized into many shapes and can hold many different types of fuel.
trans-unit.target: 多功能的燃料箱,可以调整成许多形状,可以容纳多种不同类型的燃料。

trans-unit.source: A properly sized, handy fuel tank preset to hold battery, in case you don't feel like using the built-in battery of a command disc.
trans-unit.target: 尺寸合适的便捷燃料箱预设,用于容纳电池,如果你不想使用指令圆盘的内置电池。

trans-unit.source: If you don't worry about weight and you don't feel like bringing some solar panels with you, this clearly over-sized battery will do.
trans-unit.target: 如果你不担心重量,又不想带太阳能电池板,这个明显超大的电池可以满足你的需求。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Gauge1.xml
Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from GaugeBase1.xml
Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from GaugeBundle.xml

trans-unit.target: 用于显示输入的径向仪表。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Generator1.xml

trans-unit.source: A generator that turns fuel into power. It's far from efficient at burning it, but can be a lighter, more compact alternative to large batteries.
trans-unit.target: 将燃料转化为电力的发电机。虽然燃烧效率不高,但可以是相比大型电池更轻便,更紧凑的替代品。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Generator2.xml

trans-unit.source: Radioisotope Thermal Generators act as a passive power source thanks to their insanely radioactive plutonium core. With one you can have power anywhere in the system, but it doesn't come cheap.
trans-unit.target: 放射性热核发电机,使用其极度放射性的钚核心作为被动电源。有了它,你可以在整个星系的任何地方获得电力,但这可不便宜。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Gyroscope1.xml

trans-unit.source: Allows attitude control without thrust. Uses electricity.
trans-unit.target: 无需推力即可进行姿态控制,需要使用电力。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from HeatShield1.xml

trans-unit.source: Provides protection from intense heat during re-entry.
trans-unit.target: 在重返大气层时提供免受高温的保护。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from HingeRotator1.xml

trans-unit.source: Small motor that can rotate parts around a hinge.
trans-unit.target: 可围绕铰链旋转部件的小型电机。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Inlet1.xml

trans-unit.source: Inlets suck in air for jet engines. Make sure the front of the inlet isn't blocked by other parts, because that can obstruct its airflow.
trans-unit.target: 进气口为喷气发动机吸入空气。确保进气口前端没有被其他部件挡住,因为这会阻碍气流。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from IonEngine1.xml

trans-unit.source: Extremely low power, high-efficiency engine that expels ions at nearly 50km/s. Requires electricity.
trans-unit.target: 极低推力,高效率的发动机,以近50km/s的速度喷射离子,需要大量电力。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from JetEngine1.xml

trans-unit.source: High-bypass jet engines are the most fuel efficient style of jet engines, and are more commonly found on passenger airplanes where money matters.
trans-unit.target: 高涵道比涡扇发动机是燃油效率最高的喷气发动机类型,在注重成本的客机上更常见。

trans-unit.source: A low-bypass jet engine that trades fuel efficiency for more thrust. It also includes an afterburner, which significantly boosts thrust and makes it totally rad.
trans-unit.target: 低涵道比涡扇发动机,牺牲燃油效率换取更多推力。它还包含加力燃烧室,能显著提升推力,让它变得超级酷炫。

trans-unit.source: Indecisive about where to go? Fear no more! This jet engine blends the best of both worlds, feeding extra oxygen to its afterburner so it works even in space.
trans-unit.target: 不知道该去哪里?不用怕!这款喷气发动机融合了两种方式的优点,向加力燃烧室提供额外的氧化剂,使其即使在太空中也能工作。

trans-unit.source: With a great balance between power and efficiency, mid-bypass turbofans are the perfect choice for mid size planes and small and fancy private jets.
trans-unit.target: 中涵道比涡扇发动机在推力和效率之间取得了很好的平衡,是中型飞机和小型豪华私人飞机的完美选择。

trans-unit.source: Turbojets are the oldest and least efficient jet engines. These were designed before engineers knew that redirecting some air around the core was more fuel efficient and produced more thrust.
trans-unit.target: 涡喷发动机是最古老,效率最低的喷气发动机。这些是在工程师们认识到绕过核心重新导向一些空气会更省油并产生更多推力之前设计的。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from KomodoBundle.xml

trans-unit.source: Command pod which includes a small amount of fuel, built-in engines, and a rotating nose cone.
trans-unit.target: 包含少量燃料,内置发动机和可旋转鼻锥的指令舱。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Label1.xml

trans-unit.source: Displays text. For labeling stuff, or whatever.
trans-unit.target: 显示文本。用于标记物品,或者爱干啥干啥。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from LandingGear1.xml
Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from LandingLeg1.xml

trans-unit.source: Useful for landing without smashing your engine into the ground.
trans-unit.target: 用于着陆且避免砸坏发动机。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from LandingLeg2.xml

trans-unit.source: A sturdy set of legs useful for landing without smashing your engines into the ground, with great aero for how far they can deploy
trans-unit.target: 一套坚固的起落架,有助于着陆时避免发动机撞到地面,同时其展开距离具有出色的空气动力学性能

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from LandingLeg3.xml

trans-unit.source: A very advanced and modern landing leg that will allow you to bring down the rockets of the future
trans-unit.target: 非常先进和现代的着陆腿,是未来火箭的选择

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from LandingLeg4.xml

trans-unit.source: A small and simple landing leg, capable of slowing down the impact on moon landers
trans-unit.target: 小型简单的着陆腿,能够减缓着陆器的撞击

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Light1.xml

trans-unit.source: Use these to help light your way.
trans-unit.target: 用这些来帮助你照亮前路。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Mfd1.xml

trans-unit.source: Runs special Vizzy programs to display interactive widgets during flight.
trans-unit.target: 运行特殊的Vizzy程序,在飞行中显示交互式小部件。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from NoseCone1.xml

trans-unit.source: When used correctly, nose cones can reduce drag.
trans-unit.target: 正确使用时,鼻锥可以减少阻力。

trans-unit.source: Half a sphere. Two of these make a ball. Don't expect them to roll nice though, the collider is just a cone, sadly.
trans-unit.target: 半个球体。两个这样的半球可以组成一个球体。很遗憾,但是你别指望它们能丝滑滚动,因为碰撞体只是一个锥体不是球体.

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Package.xml

trans-unit.target: 内容物未知的神秘容器。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Parachute1.xml

trans-unit.source: With this you should hopefully touch down with a more gentle touch, but don't push them too far or they will break.
trans-unit.target: 有了这个,你就能以更轻柔的方式着陆,但不要给它们施压太大阻力,否则会损坏。

trans-unit.source: Activate these in an atmosphere to reduce your chances of rapid unplanned disassembly.
trans-unit.target: 在大气层中开伞可以减少"计划外快速解体"的机会。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Piston1.xml

trans-unit.source: Push parts away from each other with a customizable hydraulic piston.
trans-unit.target: 使用可调的液压活塞将部件彼此推开。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from PropellerAssembly1.xml

trans-unit.source: Your classic civilian small aircraft propeller, suited for the early crafts that require well rounded performance for cheap.
trans-unit.target: 经典的民用小型飞机螺旋桨,适合需要以便宜的价格获得全面性能的早期载具。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from PropellerBundles.xml

trans-unit.source: Your classic civilian small aircraft propeller, suited for the early crafts that require well rounded performance for cheap.
trans-unit.target: 经典的民用小型飞机螺旋桨,适合需要以便宜的价格获得全面性能的早期载具。

trans-unit.source: A large propeller perfect for large aircraft, a couple of these will provide the thrust you need to get things going.
trans-unit.target: 大型螺旋桨,非常适合大型飞机,装上几个这样的螺旋桨就能提供你所需的推力,让飞机顺利起飞。

trans-unit.source: A set of powerful lightweight blades perfect for vertical take-off and landing.
trans-unit.target: 一套强劲的轻量化桨叶,非常适合垂直起降。

trans-unit.source: Modern and efficient blades ideal for long-range flight, just make sure you keep your fingers away from it.
trans-unit.target: 现代高效桨叶,理想的长途飞行选择,不过记得让它离你的手指远点。

trans-unit.source: A small boat propeller. The Oceans are yours now! Well, more like lakes, but you get the point.
trans-unit.target: 小型船用螺旋桨。海洋现在属于你了!好吧其实是湖泊,但道理都一样。

trans-unit.source: A large boat propeller for long-range trips and huge ships, made of heavy steel, so get ahold of a beefy motor for it.
trans-unit.target: 大型船用螺旋桨,适合长途旅行和巨型船舶,由重型钢制成,所以需要一台强力的电机来驱动它。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from RCSNozzle1.xml

trans-unit.source: Reaction control nozzles help provide precise attitude control. Uses monopropellant.
trans-unit.target: 反作用控制喷嘴有助于提供精确的姿态控制。使用单组元推进剂。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from RCSNozzle2.xml

trans-unit.source: A reaction control nozzle that gimbals for far greater control than a standard RCS nozzle. Some say it can do the work of five normal RCS nozzles.
trans-unit.target: 一种可以摆动的反作用控制喷嘴,比标准RCS喷嘴提供更大的控制范围。有人说它能顶五个普通RCS喷嘴。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from RocketEngine1.xml

trans-unit.source: This engine is not about power, but about precision. Capable of small orbit and attitude adjustments, this engine is a must in any deep space mission.
trans-unit.target: 这款发动机的卖点不是推力,而是精度。能够进行小规模且精确的轨道和姿态调整,是任何深空任务的必备。

trans-unit.source: As close as a deflating balloon you can get in terms of complexity, but also in terms of thrust.
trans-unit.target: 在复杂性和推力方面,它就像一个正在漏气的气球。

trans-unit.source: Low-power engine useful for second stages and landing on small bodies. Its electric pump allows a quick start and very low throttling, but requires some batteries on board.
trans-unit.target: 低推力发动机,适合用于上面级和在小型天体上着陆。使用电泵循环,响应速度快,可深度节流,但需要电力工作。

trans-unit.source: Highly efficient nuclear thermal engine. Warning: Do not lick.
trans-unit.target: 高比冲核热发动机。警告:别舔。

trans-unit.source: Powerful engine that can be used for takeoff and orbiting. Not a great choice for landing on moons.
trans-unit.target: 可用于起飞和轨道的强力发动机。用于在卫星上着陆不是好选择。

trans-unit.source: A sophisticated methalox engine with great efficiency thanks to one of the most advanced pump systems ever seen.
trans-unit.target: 精密的甲烷液氧发动机,由于使用了最先进的循环系统,具有出色的效率。

trans-unit.source: Powerful and efficient engine that uses hydrolox and staged combustion.
trans-unit.target: 使用液氢液氧和分级补燃循环的强力高效发动机。

trans-unit.source: It's heavy, expensive, and drinks RP-1 like there's no tomorrow, but it will have the power to get even your most poorly engineered contraptions into space.
trans-unit.target: 它又重又贵,像不要命一样喝RP-1,但它有足够的动力把你那些设计糟糕的玩意儿送入太空。
哥布林 小型固体火箭发动机

trans-unit.source: Sugar, spice and everything nice. The favorite toy of any rocket nerd.
trans-unit.target: 一硫二硝三木炭,火箭迷们的最爱。
伊芙利特 固体助推器

trans-unit.source: Powerful and cheap, but inefficient. Cannot be shut down once ignited.
trans-unit.target: 强力且便宜,但效率低。一旦点燃就无法关闭。

trans-unit.source: An extremely powerful solid rocket motor. Brute forces its usefulness through sheer power with no concern for efficiency whatsoever.
trans-unit.target: 一种极其强大的固体火箭发动机。以纯粹的力量强行发挥作用,完全不考虑效率。
奇美拉 固体助推器

trans-unit.source: An extremely powerful solid rocket motor with a gimbal. This beast can flex its muscles when necessary.
trans-unit.target: 带有摇摆机构的极其强大的固体火箭发动机。这头野兽在必要时可以展示它的肌肉。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from RotatingNoseCone1.xml
Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Rotator1.xml

trans-unit.source: Small motor that can rotate parts.
trans-unit.target: 可以转动部件的伺服电机。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from RoverWheel1.xml

trans-unit.source: Resizable wheels that have a built-in electric motor.
trans-unit.target: 内置电动机的可调尺寸车轮。

trans-unit.source: Resizable wheels that have a built-in electric motor.
trans-unit.target: 可调整大小的车轮,内置电机。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Shock1.xml

trans-unit.source: Shocks are useful when you want to soften impact with terra firma.
trans-unit.target: 当你想要减缓与地面的碰撞时,减震器很有用。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from SolarPanel1.xml

trans-unit.source: Single, stationary solar panel that can be resized.
trans-unit.target: 可调整大小的单个固定式太阳能电池板。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from SolarPanelArray.xml

trans-unit.source: Configurable solar panel array that stows away into a remarkably small space.
trans-unit.target: 可配置的太阳能电池板阵列,可以收纳成非常小的空间。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from StructuralPanel1.xml

trans-unit.source: It may look like a wing, but it has no wing physics simulation. Great when you need lots of wing-like shapes but don't care if they generate lift. They use less processing power than a normal wing, so your design runs a little faster.
trans-unit.target: 看起来像机翼,但没有机翼物理模拟。当你需要很多机翼形状但不在乎它们是否产生升力时很棒。它们比普通机翼使用更少的处理能力,所以用起来更流畅。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from Strut1.xml

trans-unit.source: Resizable strut that can help bolster your crafts.
trans-unit.target: 可调整大小的撑杆,可以帮助加固你的载具。

trans-unit.note: Fits 237px at 16px. DesignerPart presets from TestPilot.xml

trans-unit.source: Human like device that can be used to monitor the safety of your crafts.
trans-unit.target: 可用于监测载具安全性的类人设备。

trans-unit.source: Argon for ion engines, a cheaper stand-in for xenon at the cost of slightly lower efficiency. Where an atmosphere carries it at all it tends to be sparse, so gathering a useful amount takes a dedicated scoop and some patience.
trans-unit.target: 用于离子发动机的氩气,是氙气的廉价替代品,但效率会略低。可以在含氩大气中收集,氩气往往很稀薄,因此需要专门的收集器并耐心收集才能获得有用的量。

trans-unit.source: Battery is used to power many components of a craft, and unlike fuel, it can be regenerated.
trans-unit.target: 电池用于为载具的许多部件供电,与有些不可再生燃料不同,电可以再充.

trans-unit.source: Methane for use as the fuel component in Methalox rocket engines. It turns up as atmospheric gas, surface ice, and even liquid lakes, so a harvester can often top up in the field. Store alongside an Oxygen tank and the engine will burn them together when the combined Methalox mixture tank is depleted.
trans-unit.target: 甲烷用作液氧甲烷火箭发动机的燃料成分。它能以大气组分,地表冰甚至液态湖泊的形式存在,因此采集器通常可以在野外进行补充。与液氧储箱并存,且液氧甲烷组合储箱中的燃料耗尽时,发动机就会将使用二者作为燃料来源。

trans-unit.source: Carbon dioxide, harvested from the atmosphere where a world has one or mined from frozen surface deposits. On its own it's just cargo, but feed it to a Sabatier converter with some hydrogen and it becomes methane fuel.
trans-unit.target: 二氧化碳,可以从大气中提取或从冰冻的表层矿床中开采。它本身只是普通物质,但将其与一些氢气一起输入Sabatier 转化器,就能转化为甲烷燃料。

trans-unit.source: Now that's what I call high-quality H2O.
trans-unit.target: 我称之为高质量一氧化二氢.

trans-unit.source: A storable monopropellant that runs without a separate oxidizer, handy for RCS and small thrusters. It's less efficient than hydrazine, but you can make it from nothing but water, so it's the easy choice for a self-sufficient base.
trans-unit.target: 一种可储存的单组元推进剂,无需单独的氧化剂即可运行,对于RCS和小型推进器而言十分方便。虽然其效率低于肼,但仅用水即可制得,因此对于自给自足的基地而言,它是轻松的选择。

trans-unit.source: Special kerosene for use in jet engines. Note: Jet engines don't need to be directly connected to fuel tanks with jet fuel. As long as your craft has some, they will work.
trans-unit.target: 专为喷气航空发动机使用的特种煤油。注意：喷气发动机无需直接与装有喷气燃料的油箱相连。只要你的载具有燃料,它们就能正常工作。

trans-unit.source: It's for jetpacks…also this shouldn't be showing up anywhere.
trans-unit.target: 给小蓝人喷气背包使用的燃料,理论上来说你不应该看到这个条目.

trans-unit.source: Hydrogen for use in rocket engines. Without an oxidizer it is even more efficient, but can then only be used in nuclear rocket engines. Also serves as the fuel component for Hydrolox engines when stored alongside Oxygen tanks, and a scoop can harvest it from any atmosphere rich enough in it.
trans-unit.target: 用于核热发动机的氢气。在没有氧化剂的情况下,其效率更高,但只能用于核火箭发动机。当与氧气罐并存时,它也可作为液氢液氧发动机的燃料成分,并且可通过任何富含氢气的大气进行采集。

trans-unit.source: Oxygen for use as the oxidizer component in bipropellant rocket engines. Cryogenic in storage, but a scoop can pull it straight from an atmosphere that carries it. Store alongside a compatible fuel (Kerosene, Hydrogen, or Methane) and the engine will burn them together when the combined mixture tank is depleted.
trans-unit.target: 液氧用作双组元火箭发动机中的氧化剂组分。其储存时为低温状态,但可以直接从携带氧气的大气中提取。将其与兼容的燃料(煤油,液氢或甲烷)一起储存,当组合混合燃料储箱耗尽时,发动机将使用它们作为燃料来源。

trans-unit.source: Oxygen and methane for use in rocket engines. Somewhat more efficient than kerolox, but easier to work with than hydrolox.
trans-unit.target: 用于火箭发动机的液氧甲烷。其效率略高于液氧煤油推进剂,但比液氢液氧推进剂更易于使用。

trans-unit.source: Oxygen and hydrogen for use in rocket engines. Hydrolox is very efficient, but it has extremely low density and therefore requires larger fuel tanks.
trans-unit.target: 用于火箭发动机的液氢液氧,非常高效,但其密度极低,因此需要更大的燃料箱。

trans-unit.source: Oxygen and kerosene for use in rocket engines. It's cheap and only moderately cryogenic so it's safer and easier to work with. The downside is that it's not as efficient as some of the other fuels.
trans-unit.target: 用于火箭发动机的液氧煤油。价格低廉,不算太低温,因此使用起来更安全,更方便。缺点是它的效率不如其他一些燃料高。

trans-unit.source: Toxic? Maybe. But its flexibility is perfect for RCS and simple engines. If you smell ammonia, run.
trans-unit.target: 有毒?管他呢。但它的灵活性非常适合RCS和简单引擎。如果你闻到氨味,赶紧跑.

trans-unit.source: Nitrogen, scooped from the atmosphere of any world that has one. Nothing burns it directly, but combine it with hydrogen in a converter and you can synthesize hydrazine, a potent storable propellant.
trans-unit.target: 氮气,从任何有氮气的星球的大气中提取。不能直接当作燃料,但把它和氢气在转换器中混合,你就能合成肼,一种强效的可储存推进剂。

trans-unit.source: Only for those who dare to play with fire, watch for your fingers.
trans-unit.target: 只适合那些胆子大敢于玩火的人,小心别烧伤手指.

trans-unit.source: Highly refined kerosene (RP-1) for use as the fuel component in Kerolox rocket engines. Store alongside an Oxygen tank and the engine will burn them together when the combined Kerolox mixture tank is depleted.
trans-unit.target: 高度精炼的煤油(RP-1),用作液氧煤油的组元。将其与液氧储箱并存,当组合的Kerolox混合物罐耗尽时,发动机将同时使用这两种燃料。

trans-unit.source: Loose surface rock and dust, drilled straight from the ground. No engine burns it and no converter processes it, but with a drill and a tank you can haul it back from anywhere you can land.
trans-unit.target: 直接从地面钻取的松散表层岩石和灰尘。发动机不能烧,转化炉也不能用,只需一把钻头和一个储罐,你就能从任何可降落的地方把它们运回来。

trans-unit.source: Solid fuel for use in rocket engines. It packs a lot of impulse into a small space, but it is heavy and expensive.
trans-unit.target: 用于火箭发动机的固体燃料。能在小体积内产生巨大推力,但重量大且价格昂贵。

trans-unit.source: Xenon is used by ion engines. It's an inert gas, so it won't cause huge explosions. Depending on what you're going for that might be a good thing or a bad thing.
trans-unit.target: 用于离子发动机的氙气。它是一种惰性气体,因此不会引发剧烈爆炸。取决于你想干啥,这可能是好事也可能是坏事.

trans-unit.source: Gradients in Unity do not support more than 8 {0} keys.
trans-unit.target: Unity中的渐变不支持超过8个{0}键.

trans-unit.source: You have passed this requirement (for now)
Build a rocket that can reach an altitude of 100km above sea level.
trans-unit.target: 建造一枚能够到达海拔100km高度的火箭。

trans-unit.source: I can show you how to build a rocket. It'll take only about 10 minutes, but the knowledge will last a lifetime! It'll be fun!
trans-unit.target: 我可以教你如何建造火箭。大约只需要10分钟,但这些知识会让你受益终身!会很有趣的!

trans-unit.source: Practice docking with a satellite. Just ease forward and give the satellite a little kiss with your docking port. Once at close range, the docking port applies a small magnetic force to help align the two ports together.
trans-unit.target: 练习与卫星对接。只需缓缓向前,让对接口轻轻触碰卫星。一旦进入近距离,对接口会施加微小的磁力来帮助两个对接口对齐。

trans-unit.source: The European Space Agency is visiting Jupiter for the first time with the JUpiter ICy moons Explorer. To commemorate this, can you bring JUICE to Tydos? Fuel is low, so you may need some Gravity Assists. Keep your deltaV usage as low as possible!
trans-unit.target: 欧洲航天局首次使用木星冰卫星探测器访问木星。为了纪念这一时刻,你能将 JUICE 带到 Tydos 吗?燃料有限,所以你可能需要一些引力辅助,请尽量降低速度增量 的使用量!

trans-unit.source: Launch from Droo and reach escape velocity so your orbit becomes hyperbolic. The level ends once you leave Droo's Sphere of Influence (SOI). You must use less than 60kL of fuel to win.
trans-unit.target: 从Droo发射并达到逃逸速度,使你的轨道变为逃逸轨道。一旦你离开Droo的引力影响范围(SOI),关卡结束。你必须使用少于60kL的燃料才能获胜。

trans-unit.source: I can show you how to fly the rocket from the Designer Tutorial. All the way from blast-off to orbit.
trans-unit.target: 我可以教你如何驾驶设计器教程中的火箭。从发射到进入轨道。

trans-unit.source: Practice landing on Luna. It's not an easy thing to do, so this is a great place to learn some technique.
trans-unit.target: 练习在Luna着陆。这不是一件容易的事,所以这里是学习技术的好地方。

trans-unit.source: Fly your rocket as far as you can without going above 5,000 meters or touching the ground. You must fly more than 50km to pass. Don't worry about landing safely; just go far and do a spectacular crash landing.
trans-unit.target: 驾驶火箭尽可能飞远,但不能超过5000米高度或触碰地面。你必须飞行超过50km才能通过。别担心安全着陆,只要飞得够远,来一次精彩的坠毁着陆。

trans-unit.source: Get into a low orbit around Droo. Your periapsis must be at least 100km and you must use less than 10kL of fuel.
trans-unit.target: 进入Droo的低轨道。近点必须至少为100km,且必须使用少于10kL的燃料。

trans-unit.source: How fast can you go? You have 20 days to reach the maximum speed possible. Exceed 30,000m/s to win. Speed is calculated relative to the body you're orbiting. Tip: Sometimes you have to slow down to speed up! Also, if you're using more than 25-30 engines, you're not doing it right!
trans-unit.target: 你能飞多快?你有20天时间达到可能的最大速度。超过30,000m/s即可获胜。速度是相对于你所环绕的天体计算的。提示:有时候你必须减速才能加速!另外,如果你使用了超过25-30个发动机,那说明你的方法不对!

trans-unit.source: Build a rocket that exceeds 750m/s before reaching 2km above ground level. You must fly straight up. Drift sideways more than 100 meters and you fail this challenge.
trans-unit.target: 建造一枚在到达地面以上2km之前速度超过750m/s的火箭。你必须垂直飞行。横向漂移超过100米则任务失败。

trans-unit.source: Get into medium orbit around Droo. At least 5,000km periapsis. You must use less than 200 kL of fuel.
trans-unit.target: 进入Droo的中等轨道。近点至少为5,000km。必须使用少于200kL的燃料。

trans-unit.source: Land on Luna using as little fuel as possible. Apollo 11 did this back in 1969 with an on-board computer less powerful than your phone, so this should be easy, right? You must use less than 50kL of fuel to win.
trans-unit.target: 在Luna着陆,并尽可能少地使用燃料。阿波罗11号在1969年做到了这一点,当时它上面的计算机还没有你的手机强大,所以这应该很容易,对吧?你必须使用少于50kL的燃料才能获胜。

trans-unit.source: I hope you like a challenge. Blast off from Droo, make your way to Luna, and reach a stable orbit around it using less than 50kL of fuel. Your Periapsis must be at least 25km for the orbit to count.
trans-unit.target: 希望你喜欢挑战。从Droo发射,前往 Luna,并使用少于50kL的燃料在其周围建立稳定轨道。你的近点必须至少为25km,轨道才能算有效。

trans-unit.source: Get to Luna as fast as you can. Don't worry about landing. The timer stops whenever you smash into Luna's surface. You have 10 hours to accomplish your mission. Good luck!
trans-unit.target: 尽快到达 Luna。别担心着陆问题。只要你撞上Luna表面,计时器就会停止。你有10个小时完成任务。祝你好运!

trans-unit.source: You're given a small rocket with very little fuel and must fly it as far as you can. You must travel at least 15km to win. Tip: Atmospheric drag can really slow you down, but it decreases quickly as you gain altitude.
trans-unit.target: 你将获得一枚携带很少燃料的小火箭,必须尽可能飞得远。你必须飞行至少15km才能获胜。提示:大气阻力真的会拖慢你,但随着高度增加它会迅速减弱。

trans-unit.source: Starting in orbit around Droo with a small rocket, you must make your way back to Droo and parachute safely to the ground. Do a retrograde burn to bring your orbit into the atmosphere, then land safely. Beware of part damage from excessive heat during re-entry.
trans-unit.target: 从绕Droo的小火箭轨道开始,你必须返回Droo并用降落伞安全着陆到地面。进行逆行轨道机动让你的轨道进入大气层,然后安全着陆。注意再入时发热造成的部件损坏。

trans-unit.source: Get into orbit around Droo. Your periapsis must be at least 250km and your inclination between 85 and 95 degrees. You must use less than 50 kL of fuel.
trans-unit.target: 进入绕Droo的极轨道。近点必须至少为250km,轨道倾角在85到95度之间。必须使用少于50kL的燃料。

trans-unit.source: Build a rocket, launch from Droo, and rendezvous with the satellite already in orbit. This is an extremely challenging endeavor, far harder than Luna Landing.
trans-unit.target: 建造火箭,从Droo发射,与已经在轨道上的卫星交会。这是一项极具挑战性的任务,比Luna着陆难得多。

trans-unit.source: You need a docking port to dock with the satellite!
trans-unit.target: 你需要对接口才能与卫星对接!

trans-unit.source: Our shuttle was coming in for a landing when we remembered we don't know how to pilot a space shuttle… Would you please lend us a hand?
trans-unit.target: 我们的航天飞机正在降落,这时我们想起来我们不知道怎么驾驶航天飞机...你能帮帮忙吗?

trans-unit.source: See how quickly you can orbit Droo. Your Periapsis must be at least 100km for the orbit to count. You have 5 minutes from launch.
trans-unit.target: 看看你能多快绕Droo一圈。近点必须至少为100km,轨道才能算有效。从发射起你有5分钟时间。

trans-unit.source: Play the career contract tutorial 'Like a Bird'. This tutorial covers the basics of building and flying airplanes with a very simple glider. Contract Description: You've already tried to jump as far as possible from the runway; now you have to take off from it. Be wise and get some wings, or yolo it and find an alternative, you do you.
trans-unit.target: 游玩生涯合同教程"像鸟一样"。本教程涵盖使用非常简单滑翔机建造和驾驶飞机的基础知识。合同描述:你已经尝试过从跑道尽可能跳远;现在你必须从那里起飞。聪明一点,装上机翼,或者直接莽过去找个替代方案,随你。

trans-unit.source: Play the career contract tutorial 'Droo Orbit'. This tutorial covers staging analysis and tuning rocket engine performance in the designer, followed by a guided tutorial to achieve orbit around Droo. Contract Description: Can you go to orbit? I need you near specific orbits and I know you can get there. First, reach any orbit to prove yourself.
trans-unit.target: 游玩生涯合同教程"Droo 轨道"。本教程涵盖在设计器中分析级数和调整火箭发动机性能的基础知识,然后是实现绕Droo轨道的引导教程。合同描述:你能进入轨道吗?我需要你在特定轨道附近,我知道你能到达那里。首先,进入任何轨道来证明自己。

trans-unit.source: Play the career contract tutorial 'Going High'. This tutorial covers the basics of staging and payloads. Contract Description: Droo's atmosphere ends right under 80km. Can you go to space to expose a probe a scientist sent me?
trans-unit.target: 游玩生涯合同教程"飞得更高"。本教程涵盖级数和有效载荷的基础知识。合同描述:Droo 的大气层在80km以下结束。你能进入太空释放一位科学家发给我的探测器吗?

trans-unit.source: Play the career contract tutorial 'Learning To Fly'. This tutorial guides you through a simple route to practice take off and landing. Contract Description: This is a time trial for planes, so get your gloves tight! Go through all checkpoints in order before time runs out.
trans-unit.target: 游玩生涯合同教程"学习飞行"。本教程引导你通过一条简单的路线来练习起飞和着陆。合同描述:这是一场飞机计时赛,抓紧你的手套!按顺序通过所有检查点,在时间耗尽之前完成。

trans-unit.source: Play the career contract tutorial 'The Jump'. This tutorial teaches the basics of building and driving a very simple wheeled ground vehicle. Contract Description: One advantage of a huge ramp on a cliff's edge is you can fly without much effort. Go airborne for more than 150m after jumping from the end of the runway.
trans-unit.target: 游玩生涯合同教程"一个大跳"。本教程教你建造和驾驶简单轮式地面车辆的基础知识。合同描述:悬崖边缘的巨大坡道的一个优势是你可以不费吹灰之力飞起来。从跑道尽头跳下后,在空中飞行超过150m。

trans-unit.source: Play the career contract tutorial 'Vertical Shot'. This tutorial teaches the basics of building and launching a simple rocket, and briefly covers the flight user interface. Contract Description: When you send your fireworks high enough, hitting a house in the village can become a huge problem, but going too far makes finding the scraps annoying. Crash no further than 20km, but no closer than 500m from the launchpad.
trans-unit.target: 游玩生涯合同教程"垂直发射"。本教程教你建造和发射简单火箭的基础知识,并简要介绍飞行用户界面。合同描述:一旦你把一枚没飞控的烟花送得够高,那么砸到村里的房子就会变成大麻烦,但飞得太远又会让搜寻残骸变得很烦人,设法把落点控制在距发射台500米到20公里之间。

trans-unit.source: There is no money and no research in Sandbox Mode. All parts are unlocked so you can build whatever you want right from the start.

trans-unit.target: 将此载具保存至你的硬盘.

Fits 320px at 24px bold. list view title

Fits 175px at 18px bold. main menu small button opening the menu Map View

What's New glass button label (header font)

trans-unit.source: The input data that defines the strength of the biome to add. These values should be in the range of 0 to 1.
trans-unit.target: 定义要添加的群系强度的输入数据。这些值应在0到1的范围内。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that lets you add biomes to the planet. Connect this modifier's data output to the biome input of a Biomes modifier to define a biome.
trans-unit.target: 一个星球属性,可让您为星球添加群系。将此属性的数据输出连接到"群系"属性的群系输入端,以定义一个生物群系。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that adds a color value to the planet vertex data.
trans-unit.target: 一个行星属性,用于为行星顶点数据添加颜色值.

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that adds a height (elevation) value to the planet vertex data.
trans-unit.target: 一个行星属性,用于为行星顶点数据添加高度(海拔)值。

trans-unit.source: The height, in meters, to add to the planet or biome.
trans-unit.target: 要添加到行星或生物群系的高度(单位:米)。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that defines sub-biomes for a biome based on the altitude of the terrain.
trans-unit.target: 一个星球属性,可根据地形高度为生物群系定义子生物群系。

trans-unit.source: The height (in meters) the current height can vary by when determining which sub-biome it belongs to. This doesn't change the actual height, just adds variation to the sub-biomes' height ranges. The strength of this variation is set by the height variance data input value, which multiplies this value.
trans-unit.target: 在确定当前高度属于哪个子生物群系时,其高度(单位:米)可能会有所变化。这并不会改变实际高度,只是为子生物群系的高度范围增加了变化。这种变化的强度由高度方差数据输入值设置,该值会乘以当前高度。

trans-unit.source: The min and max heights, in meters, defining the range over which height variance reaches full strength. At or below the min, no variance applies. Above the max, variance applies 100%. Between min and max, the variance strength (set by the data input value) scales linearly from 0% to 100%.
trans-unit.target: 以米为单位的最小和最大高度,定义高度变化达到完全强度的范围。在最小高度或以下,不应用变化。超过最大高度时,变化强度为100%。在最小和最大高度之间,变化强度(由数据输入值设置)从0%到100%线性缩放。

trans-unit.source: If height variance is used, this input data defines the strength of the height variance (typically a value between 0 and 1).
trans-unit.target: 如果使用高度变化,此输入数据定义高度变化的强度(通常为0到1之间的值)。

trans-unit.source: If running in a biome specific pass, this determines whether the input data value comes from the common pass or from this biome specific pass.
trans-unit.target: 如果在群系特定通道中运行,这决定输入数据值是来自通用通道还是来自此群系特定通道。

trans-unit.source: The list of sub-biomes and their associated data defined for this biome.
trans-unit.target: 为此群系定义的子群系列表及其相关数据。

trans-unit.source: The altitude range (in meters) for this sub-biome, defined by min and max heights. The min/max values should overlap neighboring sub-biomes for a smooth transition between them.
trans-unit.target: 此子群系的海拔范围(以米为单位),由最小和最大高度定义。最小/最大值应与相邻子群系重叠,以便在它们之间平滑过渡。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that applies data from a biome to the planet vertex data.
trans-unit.target: 将群系的数据应用到星球顶点数据的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier used to perform basic math operations on one or two data input values.
trans-unit.target: 用于对一个或两个数据输入值执行基本数学运算的星球属性。
A 和 B 的最大值
A 和 C 的最大值
A 和 B 的最小值
A 和 C 的最小值

trans-unit.source: The range of input values reassigned to this biome. Biome ranges are ordered and evaluated by their min values. One range's max value should overlap the next range's min value so biomes transition smoothly. Input values outside all ranges are still reassigned: low values to the first biome range, high values to the last.
trans-unit.target: 重新分配给此群系的输入值范围。群系范围按其最小值排序和评估。一个范围的最大值应与下一个范围的最小值重叠,以便群系平滑过渡。范围之外的输入值仍会被重新分配:低值分配给第一个群系范围,高值分配给最后一个。

trans-unit.source: The maximum value to which the output value will be clamped.
trans-unit.target: 输出值将被限制的最大值。

trans-unit.source: The minimum value to which the output value will be clamped.
trans-unit.target: 输出值将被限制的最小值。

trans-unit.source: The data input value to be clamped.
The clamped output value, which should be between the specified minimum and maximum value.
trans-unit.target: 限制后的输出值,应在指定的最小值和最大值之间。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that clamps a data value to a specified range.
trans-unit.target: 将数据值限制在指定范围内的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: Defines detached cloud layers that are rendered on dedicated transparent spheres around the planet in scaled space. Each layer reads its density from a data slot produced by the planet generation modifiers, and has its own height, tint and rotation speed. Order the layers by altitude (Low has the smallest height, High the largest) so higher layers correctly shadow the ones below them. The fourth layer is a non-rotating mask that multiplies the opacity of the other layers.
trans-unit.target: 定义在缩放空间中围绕星球渲染的独立云层。每个云层从星球生成属性生成的数据槽读取密度,并具有各自的高度,色彩和旋转速度。按高度排列云层(低空云层高度最小,高空云层最大),以便较高的云层正确遮挡下方的云层。第四层是一个不旋转的遮罩,乘以其他云层的不透明度。

trans-unit.source: How finely the close-up detail noise tiles on this layer in the ground-level cloud view (higher is finer). Has no effect on the view from space.
trans-unit.target: 此云层在地面云视图中的近景细节噪声平铺的精细程度(值越高越精细)。从太空观看时无效。

trans-unit.source: Multiplies this layer's rotation speed to set how fast its close-up detail drifts and rotates in the ground-level cloud view. Has no effect on the view from space.
trans-unit.target: 将此云层的旋转速度乘以此倍增值,以设置其近景细节在地面云视图中的漂移和旋转速度。从太空观看时无效。

trans-unit.source: How strongly the close-up detail noise erodes this layer's edges in the ground-level cloud view (0 to ~0.6). Has no effect on the view from space.
trans-unit.target: 近景细节噪声在此云层边缘侵蚀的强度(0 到约0.6)。从太空观看时无效。

trans-unit.source: The height of the cloud layer above sea level, in meters.
trans-unit.target: 云层高于海平面的高度,以米为单位。

trans-unit.source: The data slot (produced by the planet generation modifiers) that this layer reads its density from. Set to -1 to disable the layer.
trans-unit.target: 此云层从其读取密度的数据槽(由星球生成属性生成)。设为-1以禁用该云层。

trans-unit.source: The data slot for a non-rotating mask that multiplies the opacity of the cloud layers, so clouds can be confined to certain regions. Set to -1 to disable.
trans-unit.target: 用于不旋转的遮罩的数据槽,乘以云层的不透明度,以便将云限制在特定区域。设为-1以禁用。

trans-unit.source: How strongly the mask layer affects this layer's opacity (0 = ignore the mask, 1 = fully masked). Use low values for high clouds and high values for fog.
trans-unit.target: 遮罩层对此云层不透明度的影响强度(0 = 忽略遮罩,1 = 完全遮罩)。高空云层使用低值,雾使用高值。

trans-unit.source: The rotation speed of the layer in radians per second, applied in addition to the planet's own rotation.
trans-unit.target: 云层的旋转速度,以弧度每秒为单位,在星球自身旋转的基础上附加。

trans-unit.source: Reduces the cloud mask based on the planet's position in its orbit for a seasonal effect (0 disables it). Negative values thin the clouds most at the closest point to the parent (periapsis) and least at the farthest (apoapsis); positive values do the reverse. Only affects planets that use a cloud mask.
trans-unit.target: 根据行星在其轨道上的位置来减少云层遮罩,以产生季节性效果(0表示禁用)。负值会使云层在离母星最近点(近日点)时最稀疏,在离母星最远点(远日点)时最密集;正值则反之。仅影响使用云层遮罩的行星。

trans-unit.source: How strongly this layer follows the terrain height, lifting it over high ground so low clouds do not clip into elevated terrain (0 = flat shell, 1 = fully follows the terrain).
trans-unit.target: 此云层跟随地形高度的强度,将其抬升以越过高地,使低空云不会切入升高地形(0 = 平坦外壳,1 = 完全跟随地形)。

trans-unit.source: The thickness of the cloud layer in meters, giving it a visible vertical extent when flying through it in the ground-level cloud view. Has no effect on the view from space.
trans-unit.target: 以米为单位的云层厚度,在地面云层视图中飞过时,可以显示其可见的垂直范围。但该厚度对从太空观察的视图无影响。

trans-unit.source: The color of the clouds. The alpha channel acts as an overall opacity multiplier.
trans-unit.target: 云的颜色。Alpha通道用作整体不透明度。

trans-unit.source: The input data value which identifies which color band(s) will be used. For gas giants, this is typically the y-coordinate on a Unit sphere.
trans-unit.target: 用于识别将使用哪个颜色条(或多个)的输入数据值。对于气态巨行星,这通常是单位球体上的y坐标。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that produces color bands based on a data value.
trans-unit.target: 基于数据值生成彩色条纹的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: The maximum expected input value. With the minimum, this sets the expected range of the input data value to remap it into the zero-to-one range.
trans-unit.target: 预期的最大输入值。与最小值一起使用时,这会设置输入数据值的预期范围,以便将其重新映射到0到1的范围。

trans-unit.source: The minimum expected input value. Used with the maximum to determine the input data's expected range and remap it into the zero-to-one range.
trans-unit.target: 预期的最小输入值。与最大值一起使用,以确定输入数据的预期范围并将其重新映射到0到1的范围。

trans-unit.source: The color value to be blended in to the existing color.
trans-unit.target: 要混合到现有颜色中的颜色值。

trans-unit.source: An optional input specifying a data value to use as the source alpha channel, instead of the alpha defined in the source color.
trans-unit.target: 可选的输入,指定用作源Alpha通道的数据值,而不是源颜色中定义的Alpha。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that blends two colors together based on a data value.
trans-unit.target: 基于数据值混合两种颜色的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: The blend type used for the destination color (the existing color before this modifier is applied). This essentially selects the value by which the destination color will be multiplied.
trans-unit.target: 用于目标颜色(应用此属性之前的现有颜色)的混合类型。这本质上选择目标颜色将被乘以的值。

trans-unit.source: The blend type used for the source color (specified in this modifier). This is essentially selecting the value by which the source color will be multiplied.
trans-unit.target: 用于源颜色(在此属性中指定)的混合类型。这本质上选择源颜色将被乘以的值。

trans-unit.source: The inner angle (in degrees) based on a vector through the center of the pole.
trans-unit.target: 基于通过极点中心的向量的内角(以度为单位)。

trans-unit.source: The output value (before noise and remapping) that is used leading up to and including the inner angle.
trans-unit.target: 在内角及以内使用的输出值(在噪声和重映射之前)。

trans-unit.source: The outer angle (in degrees) based on a vector through the center of the pole.
trans-unit.target: 基于通过极点中心的向量的外角(以度为单位)。

trans-unit.source: The output value (before noise and remapping) that is used at the outer angle and beyond.
trans-unit.target: 在外角及以外使用的输出值(在噪声和重映射之前)。

trans-unit.source: The input data value that provides noise to the polar cap mask.
trans-unit.target: 为极冠遮罩提供噪声的输入数据值。

trans-unit.source: If enabled, the linear remapping will be clamped in the range of zero to one. If disabled, output values could exceed the zero to one range.
trans-unit.target: 如果启用,线性重映射将被限制在0到1的范围内。如果禁用,输出值可能超出0到1的范围。

trans-unit.source: The maximum value used to remap the output value in the range of zero to one.
trans-unit.target: 用于在0到1范围内重映射输出值的最大值。

trans-unit.source: The minimum value used to remap the output value in the range of zero to one.
trans-unit.target: 用于在0到1范围内重映射输出值的最小值。

trans-unit.source: The noise strength that is used leading up to and including the inner angle.
trans-unit.target: 在内角及以内使用的噪声强度。

trans-unit.source: The noise strength that is used at the outer angle and beyond.
trans-unit.target: 在外角及以外使用的噪声强度。

trans-unit.source: This provides an easy way to quickly disable a crater pass, which can be useful in development and testing.
trans-unit.target: 这是一种快速禁用陨石坑通道的简单方法,在开发和测试时很有用。

trans-unit.source: The frequency of the noise that generates the craters. The higher the frequency the smaller and more numerous the craters become.
trans-unit.target: 生成陨石坑的噪声频率。频率越高,陨石坑越小越多。

trans-unit.source: The maximum depth of the crater in meters. This occurs when the crater shape curve evaluates to -1 on the y-axis.
trans-unit.target: 陨石坑的最大深度,以米为单位。当陨石坑形状曲线在y轴上评估为-1时发生。

trans-unit.source: The value used to linearly interpolate the crater shape noise between data inputs 'A' and 'B'. At 0, only input 'A' provides noise to the crater shapes. At 1, only input 'B' is used. Any value between 0 and 1 interpolates between the two.
trans-unit.target: 用于在数据输入A和B之间线性插值陨石坑形状噪声的值。为0时,只有输入A为陨石坑形状提供噪声。为1时,只使用输入B。0和1之间的任何值在两者之间插值。

trans-unit.source: The scalar value used to adjust the strength of the crater shape noise before it is applied.
trans-unit.target: 用于在应用前调整陨石坑形状噪声强度的标量值。

trans-unit.source: The randomness in the crater position noise. Less randomness means more consistent (and larger) craters but they will be more grid like in alignment.
trans-unit.target: 陨石坑位置噪声的随机性。随机性越低,陨石坑越一致(也越大),但排列会更像网格。

trans-unit.source: The rotation angle applied to the input position used to sample crater positions and sizes. Sometimes adjusting it slightly helps when multiple passes all want to pile craters on top of each other.
trans-unit.target: 应用于输入位置的旋转角度,用于采样陨石坑位置和大小。有时稍微调整它有助于多个通道都希望在彼此之上堆叠陨石坑。

trans-unit.source: The axis of the rotation angle applied to the input position used to sample crater positions and sizes. Sometimes adjusting the rotation slightly helps when multiple passes all want to pile craters on top of each other.
trans-unit.target: 应用于输入位置的旋转角度的轴,用于采样陨石坑位置和大小。有时稍微调整旋转有助于多个通道都希望在彼此之上堆叠陨石坑。

trans-unit.source: The seed value used for the cellular noise that generates the crater positions and sizes.
trans-unit.target: 用于生成陨石坑位置和大小的单元噪声的种子值。

trans-unit.source: The curve that craters resemble. Typically mapped between (0,-1) and (1,0). The x-axis is distance from the crater center, the y-axis is crater depth. The left side, starting at 0, is the crater center; the right side, typically ending at 1, is the end of the crater rims. The bottom, starting at -1, is the deepest part; the top, ending at 0, is the planet's regular surface.
trans-unit.target: 陨石坑相似的曲线。通常映射在(0,-1)和(1,0)之间。x轴是到陨石坑中心的距离,y轴是陨石坑深度。左侧从0开始是陨石坑中心;右侧通常以1结束是陨石坑边缘。底部从-1开始是最深处;顶部以0结束是星球的常规表面。

trans-unit.source: The frequency of the noise that generates the crater positions and sizes. The higher the frequency, the smaller and more numerous the craters become.
trans-unit.target: 生成陨石坑位置和大小的噪声频率。频率越高,陨石坑越小越多。

trans-unit.source: The data input that, if used, can mask out the craters this modifier generates. Typically a value between zero and one, where one means full-strength unmasked craters and zero means this modifier changes nothing.
trans-unit.target: 如果使用,此数据输入可以遮罩此属性生成的陨石坑。通常为0到1之间的值,其中1表示完全强度无遮罩的陨石坑,0表示此属性不改变任何内容。

trans-unit.source: The exponent applied to the crater positional noise. This is used to help prevent seams between craters.
trans-unit.target: 应用于陨石坑位置噪声的指数。这用于帮助防止陨石坑之间的接缝。

trans-unit.source: The strength of the crater shape noise. This noise adds variation to crater shapes so they aren't perfectly circular. The crater shape noise is highly configurable, and this value provides an easy way to adjust its final strength.
trans-unit.target: 陨石坑形状噪声的强度。此噪声为陨石坑形状添加变化,使它们不是完美的圆形。陨石坑形状噪声可高度配置,此值提供了一种简单的方法来调整其最终强度。

trans-unit.source: The number of crater passes to perform. Crater passes are expensive, so use them sparingly; however, multiple crater passes are cheaper than the same number of single-pass crater modifiers for a similar effect. Craters within a pass can't overlap, but craters in different passes can.
trans-unit.target: 要执行的陨石坑通道数量。陨石坑通道成本较高,因此请谨慎使用;但是,多个陨石坑通道比相同数量的单通道陨石坑属性的开销更小,效果相似。通道内的陨石坑不能重叠,但不同通道的陨石坑可以重叠。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that generates terrain crater features.
trans-unit.target: 生成地形陨石坑特征的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: The data output that, if used, holds the summed crater height noise from all passes. Multiplied by the crater max depth and the final crater strength, it gives the final height adjustment this modifier applies. Not always useful, but it can be. For example, with a single-pass crater, this value can pinpoint where craters are, so you can feed it into a biome modifier to generate biomes inside and outside craters.
trans-unit.target: 如果使用,此数据输出保存所有通道的加总陨石坑高度噪声。乘以陨石坑最大深度和最终陨石坑强度后,给出此属性应用的高度调整最终值。并非总是有用,但可以有用。例如,对于单通道陨石坑,此值可以精确定位陨石坑位置,因此可以将其输入到群系属性中,以在陨石坑内外生成群系。

trans-unit.source: The red, green, and blue color values (0 to 1) to add to the terrain color as the crater extends above the planet's surface. Useful for adding a bit of color variation to the crater rims.
trans-unit.target: 当陨石坑高于星球表面时,添加到地形颜色的红,绿,蓝颜色值(0到1)。用于为陨石坑边缘添加一点颜色变化。

trans-unit.source: The red, green, and blue color values (0 to 1) to subtract from the terrain color as it reaches the craters' minimum height. Useful for adding a bit of color variation to the deep centers of craters.
trans-unit.target: 当达到陨石坑最小高度时,从地形颜色中减去的红,绿,蓝颜色值(0到1)。用于为陨石坑最深中心添加一点颜色变化。

trans-unit.source: The first crater shape noise input data. Each crater pass can choose a value by which this noise input and the other are linearly interpolated to generate that pass's crater shape noise value. This adds variation so craters don't all appear as perfect circles. Lower frequency noise (relative to the crater size) can create some very interesting non-crater-like terrain.
trans-unit.target: 第一个陨石坑形状噪声输入数据。每个陨石坑通道可以选择一个值,用于线性插值此噪声输入和另一个噪声输入,以生成该通道的陨石坑形状噪声值。这增加了变化,使陨石坑不会都呈现完美的圆形。相对于陨石坑大小,较低频率的噪声可以创建一些非常有趣的类陨石坑地形。

trans-unit.source: The second crater shape noise input. Each crater pass picks a value used to linearly interpolate this noise input and the other to generate that pass's crater shape noise. This noise adds variation so craters don't all look like perfect circles. Lower frequency noise (relative to crater size) can create some very interesting non-crater-like terrain.
trans-unit.target: 第二个陨石坑形状噪声输入。每个陨石坑通道选择一个值,用于线性插值此噪声输入和另一个噪声输入,以生成该通道的陨石坑形状噪声。此噪声增加了变化,使陨石坑不会都看起来像完美的圆形。相对于陨石坑大小,较低频率的噪声可以创建一些非常有趣的类陨石坑地形。

trans-unit.source: The default curve that craters resemble. Individual passes can override this; passes without a custom curve fall back to it. Typically mapped between (0,-1) and (1,0). The x-axis is distance from the crater center, the y-axis is crater depth. The left side, starting at 0, is the crater center; the right side, typically ending at 1, is the end of the crater rims. The bottom, starting at -1, is the deepest part; the top, ending at 0, is the planet's regular surface.
trans-unit.target: 陨石坑相似的默认曲线。单个通道可以覆盖此值;没有自定义曲线的通道回退到此值。通常映射在(0,-1)和(1,0)之间。x轴是到陨石坑中心的距离,y轴是陨石坑深度。左侧从0开始是陨石坑中心;右侧通常以1结束是陨石坑边缘。底部从-1开始是最深处;顶部以0结束是星球的常规表面。

trans-unit.source: A fast planet modifier that generates terrain crater features.
trans-unit.target: 生成地形陨石坑特征的快速星球属性。

trans-unit.source: An optional data output that stores the minimum noise output used for the height of the craters.

trans-unit.source: Prevents the seed from being randomized when the randomize button is clicked.

trans-unit.source: The red, green, and blue color values (typically 0 to 1) to add to the terrain color as the crater rises above the planet's surface. Useful for adding a bit of color variation to crater rims.
trans-unit.target: 当陨石坑高于星球表面时,添加到地形颜色的红,绿,蓝颜色值(通常为0到1)。用于为陨石坑边缘添加一点颜色变化。

trans-unit.source: The red, green, and blue color values (typically 0 to 1) to subtract from the terrain color as it reaches the craters' minimum height. Useful for adding a bit of color variation to the deep centers of craters.
trans-unit.target: 当达到陨石坑最小高度时,从地形颜色中减去的红,绿,蓝颜色值(通常为0到1)。用于为陨石坑最深中心添加一点颜色变化。

trans-unit.source: Allows multiple, unlocked Noise elements to obtain the same seed when the randomize button is clicked.

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that reads data from a cubemap texture for the celestial body and stores an output value based on that data. The cubemap texture should be in horizontal format (X+, X-, Y+, Y-, Z+, Z-).
trans-unit.target: 从天体立方体贴图纹理读取数据并根据该数据存储输出值的星球属性。立方体贴图纹理应为水平格式(X+,X-,Y+,Y-,Z+,Z-)。

trans-unit.source: The interpolation method used when sampling the texture data. Bilinear should be much faster. Bicubic should be smoother, but won't always look better than bilinear, since the look depends heavily on the texture content and resolution. Stick with bilinear for performance unless bicubic offers a far better visual result.
trans-unit.target: 采样纹理数据时使用的插值方法。双线性应该快得多。双三次应该更平滑,但并不总是比双线性看起来更好,因为外观很大程度上取决于纹理内容和分辨率。除非双三次提供明显更好的视觉效果,否则请坚持使用双线性以提高性能。

trans-unit.source: The color gradient used in planet studio when using a brush on this cubemap.
trans-unit.target: 在星球工作室中使用此立方体贴图时使用的颜色渐变。

trans-unit.source: The cubemap display name associated with this modifier (if any). This is required for using the brush flyout with this cubemap modifier.
trans-unit.target: 与此属性关联的立方体贴图显示名称(如果有)。使用此立方体贴图属性时需要此名称才能使用画笔弹出菜单。

trans-unit.source: The output value is linearly interpolated between the min and max values based on the texture data's pixel value. This also sets the maximum value of the source data when generating a default cubemap.
trans-unit.target: 输出值根据纹理数据的像素值在最小值和最大值之间线性插值。这也在生成默认立方体贴图时设置源数据的最大值。

trans-unit.source: The output value is linearly interpolated between the min and max value based on the texture data's pixel value. This also defines the minimum value of the source data when generating a default cubemap.

trans-unit.source: The bits per pixel used at runtime to represent the texture data. A value of 32 can be slightly more efficient on the CPU but uses far more memory at runtime, especially for large textures. It's recommended to leave this at 8 bits per pixel.
trans-unit.target: 在运行时表示纹理数据使用的每像素位数。值为32可能在CPU上稍高效,但在运行时使用更多内存,特别是对于大纹理。建议将此值保留为每像素8位。

trans-unit.source: The texture channel from which values should be used for this texture.

调试可视化 (立方体贴图)

trans-unit.source: The input data to visualize. This value will be linearly interpolated between the min and max values specified by this modifier, then color will be applied based on the specified gradient.
trans-unit.target: 要可视化的输入数据。此值将在由此属性指定的最小值和最大值之间线性插值,然后根据指定的渐变应用颜色。

trans-unit.source: The amplitude of the domain warping noise.
The domain warping type. Domain warping adjusts the input position before generating the actual noise, thus 'warping' it. Some types use additional noise to perform the warping.
trans-unit.target: 域扭曲的类型。域扭曲在生成实际噪声之前调整输入位置,从而"扭曲"它。某些类型使用额外的噪声来执行扭曲。

trans-unit.source: The frequency of the domain warping noise.
The gain of the domain warping noise.
The interpolation method of the domain warping noise. Linear is the fastest and lowest quality. Quintic is the slowest and best quality.
trans-unit.target: 域扭曲噪声的插值方法。线性是最快且质量最低的。五次是最慢且质量最好的。

trans-unit.source: The lacunarity of the domain warping noise.
The number of octaves for the domain warping noise.

trans-unit.note: Fits 386px at 14px. part modifier spinner property label

trans-unit.source: The X,Y,Z offset to apply to the input position before generating the noise value for that position.
trans-unit.target: 在生成该位置噪声值之前,要应用于输入位置的X,Y,Z偏移量。

trans-unit.source: The euler angles, in degrees, to rotate the input position before generating the noise value for that position.
trans-unit.target: 在生成该位置噪声值之前,要应用于输入位置的欧拉角(以度为单位)。

trans-unit.source: The noise seed value used for the domain warping noise.
trans-unit.target: 用于域扭曲噪声的噪声种子值。

trans-unit.source: The amount of twist (in degrees) to apply to the lines in a single hemisphere.
trans-unit.target: 要应用于单个半球的线条的扭曲量(以度为单位)。

trans-unit.source: The axis around which to apply the twisting.
The exponent to apply to the twist amount. Increasing this can reduce the twisting near the equator and increase the twisting near the poles.
trans-unit.target: 要应用于扭曲量的指数。增加此值可以减少赤道附近的扭曲,并增加两极附近的扭曲。

trans-unit.source: How the twist strength at a given position is determined. Distance On Axis - twisting increases as distance along the axis increases. Distance On Axis Inverse - twisting decreases as distance along the axis increases. Distance From Axis - twisting increases as distance from the axis increases. Distance From Axis Inverse - twisting decreases as distance from the axis increases.
trans-unit.target: 如何确定给定位置的扭曲强度。沿轴距离 - 扭曲随沿轴距离增加而增加。沿轴距离(反向)- 扭曲随沿轴距离增加而减少。距轴距离 - 扭曲随距轴距离增加而增加。距轴距离(反向)- 扭曲随距轴距离增加而减少。

trans-unit.source: The X,Y,Z scale to apply to the input position before generating the noise value for that position.
trans-unit.target: 在生成该位置噪声值之前,要应用于输入位置的X,Y,Z缩放比例。

A planet modifier that evaluates a mathematical expression using data values as inputs.
trans-unit.target: 使用数据值作为输入来评估数学表达式的星球属性。

从最小值线性插值到最大值

trans-unit.source: How the data input is interpreted to generate a height output. Lerp Min To Max: height is linearly interpolated from minimum to maximum based on the input value and its specified range. Lerp To/From Zero: height is linearly interpolated from minimum to zero if the input is negative, or from zero to maximum if positive. Don't use this if the minimum and maximum heights don't span across zero.

trans-unit.source: The minimum height (in meters) generated by this modifier.

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that flattens terrain radially around a point.

trans-unit.source: The falloff power used when interpolating between the target elevation and original elevation.

trans-unit.target: 要平整的地形的内半径(以米为单位)。此半径内的所有地形都设置为指定海拔。内半径到外半径之间,海拔从平整逐渐过渡回未平整。

trans-unit.source: The latitude and longitude of the center point of the radial flatten.
trans-unit.target: 径向平整中心点的纬度和经度。

trans-unit.source: The outer radius, in meters, of the terrain to flatten. All terrain beyond it is unaffected by this modifier. Elevation is interpolated from flattened to non-flattened terrain between the inner and outer radius.
trans-unit.target: 要平整的地形的外半径(以米为单位)。超出此半径的所有地形不受此属性影响。内半径和外半径之间,海拔从平整逐渐过渡到未平整。

trans-unit.source: Use the Smooth Step function instead of a falloff power curve. If selected, then Falloff Power will be ignored.
trans-unit.target: 使用平滑阶梯函数而不是衰减力度曲线。如果选中,则衰减力度将被忽略。

trans-unit.source: The data input values to be remapped.

trans-unit.source: The output results of the modifier.

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier that linearly remaps a data value from one range to another.

trans-unit.source: The maximum value of the range to which values are remapped. Input values at or beyond 'From Max Value' remap to this. Input values between 'From Min Value' and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between 'To Min Value' and this.

trans-unit.source: The minimum value of the range that values are remapped to. Input values at or below 'From Min Value' remap to this. Input values between 'From Min Value' and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between this and 'To Max Value'.
trans-unit.target: 值被重新映射到的范围的最小值。等于或低于"从最小值"的输入值重新映射到此值。介于"从最小值"和"从最大值"之间的输入值在此值和"到最大值"之间线性插值。

trans-unit.source: The maximum value of the range from which values are remapped. Input values at or beyond this are remapped to 'To Max Value'. Input values between 'From Min Value' and this are linearly interpolated between 'To Min Value' and 'To Max Value'. These results are mirrored about zero when the input is below zero.

trans-unit.source: The minimum value of the range being remapped from. Input values at or below this are remapped to 'To Min Value'. trans-unit.source: The minimum value of the range that values are remapped to. Input values at or below 'From Min Value' remap to this. Input values between 'From Min Value' and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between this and 'To Max Value'. Results are mirrored about zero when the input is below zero.

trans-unit.source: Marks which data slot holds the ISRU resource patchiness field (0..1). Author the value upstream with the normal noise/remap/combine modifiers; each sub-biome's Noise Strength slider then chooses how much of it to apply.

trans-unit.source: The data input value that, along with the biome range values, determines the biome(s) to which the source biome's strength should be re-assigned.

trans-unit.source: If enabled, input values beyond the final terrace section's 'Start Value' are clamped to that 'Start Value'. If disabled, input values exceeding the final 'Start Value' pass through untouched to the output.

A planet modifier that generates terraced terrain features.
trans-unit.target: 生成梯田地形特征的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: The percentage of this terrace section that will be completely flat. The section extends from its start value to the next section's start value. This defines the percentage of that range where output is always set to this section's start value. The rest is the slope to the next terrace section.
trans-unit.target: 此梯田部分完全平坦的百分比。该部分从其起始值延伸到下一个部分的起始值。这定义了输出始终设置为该部分起始值的范围百分比。其余部分是从该梯田部分到下一个的斜坡。

trans-unit.source: The exponent defining how this terrace section's slope is interpolated from its start value to the next section's start value. A value of 1 results in linear interpolation of the slope from this section to the next.
trans-unit.target: 定义此梯田部分的斜坡如何从其起始值插值到下一个部分起始值的指数。值为1会得到从此部分到下一个部分的线性斜坡插值。

trans-unit.source: The data input value at which this terrace section starts.

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier used to read data from a specific face of a cubemap texture and project it onto the planet surface.

纹理数据 (立方体贴图面)
纹理数据 (立方体贴图面)

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier used to read data from a texture and project it onto the planet surface using latitude/longitude coordinates.
trans-unit.target: 用于从纹理读取数据并使用经纬度坐标将其投影到星球表面的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: The cube face of the texture's center position.
trans-unit.target: 纹理中心位置的立方体面。

trans-unit.source: The interpolation method used when sampling the texture data. Bilinear should be much faster. Bicubic should be smoother, but won't always look better than bilinear, since the look depends heavily on the texture content and resolution as well as the texture's size on the celestial body. Stick with bilinear for performance unless bicubic offers a far better visual result.
trans-unit.target: 采样纹理数据时使用的插值方法。双线性应该快得多。双三次应该更平滑,但并不总是比双线性看起来更好,因为外观很大程度上取决于纹理内容和分辨率以及纹理在天体上的大小。除非双三次提供明显更好的视觉效果,否则请坚持使用双线性以提高性能。

trans-unit.source: The maximum value this texture generates, added to the modifier output for a max-value pixel. For example, if this is 100 and pixels range from 0 to 255, then a pixel of 0 generates 0, a pixel of 102 generates 40, and a pixel of 255 generates 100.
trans-unit.target: 此纹理生成的最大值,添加到最大像素值的属性输出。例如,如果这是100且像素范围从0到255,则像素0生成0,像素102生成40,像素255生成100。

trans-unit.source: The position of the center of the texture on the cube face. Coordinates are unit cube space, from -0.5 to 0.5.
trans-unit.target: 纹理在立方体面上的中心位置。坐标为单位立方体空间,从-0.5到0.5。

trans-unit.source: The rotation of the texture in degrees. NOTE: Only increments of 90 degrees will work.
trans-unit.target: 纹理以度为单位的旋转。注意:只有90度的增量才有效。

trans-unit.source: The size of the texture relative to the cube face. Coordinates are unit cube space with a size value of 1 filling the entire cubemap face.
trans-unit.target: 纹理相对于立方体面的尺寸。坐标为单位立方体空间,大小值为1时填充整个立方体贴图面。

trans-unit.source: The interpolation method used when sampling the texture data. Bilinear should be much faster. Bicubic should be smoother, but won't always look better than bilinear, since the look depends heavily on the texture content and resolution as well as the projected texture size. Stick with bilinear for performance unless bicubic offers a far better visual result.
trans-unit.target: 采样纹理数据时使用的插值方法。双线性应该快得多。双三次应该更平滑,但并不总是比双线性看起来更好,因为外观很大程度上取决于纹理内容和分辨率以及投影纹理的大小。除非双三次提供明显更好的视觉效果,否则请坚持使用双线性以提高性能。

trans-unit.source: The latitude at which this texture data should be centered and projected onto the celestial body.
trans-unit.target: 此纹理数据应居中并投影到天体上的纬度。

trans-unit.source: The longitude at which this texture data should be centered and projected onto the celestial body.
trans-unit.target: 此纹理数据应居中并投影到天体上的经度。

trans-unit.source: The texture data to be projected onto the celestial body.
trans-unit.target: 要投影到天体上的纹理数据。

trans-unit.source: The rotation of the projected texture in degrees.
trans-unit.target: 投影纹理以度为单位的旋转。

trans-unit.source: The size of the texture projected onto the planet, relative to a unit sphere. This size is not related to or affected by the radius of the celestial body.
trans-unit.target: 投影到星球上的纹理大小,相对于单位球体。此大小与天体的半径无关或不受其影响。

trans-unit.target: 将数据值作为对最终地形高度的更新来应用的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: May need more battery to operate.
trans-unit.target: 可能需要更多电量才能运行。

trans-unit.target: 此子群系的值范围,定义为定义它的输入数据的最小和最大 values。最小/最大值应与相邻子群系重叠,以便在它们之间平滑过渡。

trans-unit.source: The method used to calculate distance when using cellular noise.
trans-unit.target: 使用单元噪声时用于计算距离的方法。

trans-unit.source: When using cellular noise, this determines what kind of values will be stored as the output of this modifier.
trans-unit.target: 使用单元噪声时,这决定了什么样的值将被存储为该属性的输出。

trans-unit.source: The output of this noise modifier. Many noise methods are capped between -1 and 1, but that is not always the case.
trans-unit.target: 此噪声属性的输出。许多噪声方法限制在-1到1之间,但并不总是如此。

trans-unit.source: A highly configurable planet modifier that can be used to generate all sorts of noise.
trans-unit.target: 可用于生成各种噪声的高度可配置的星球属性。

trans-unit.source: Typically each octave scales the previous octave's amplitude by the 'Gain' value. If set to manual, the amplitude at each octave can be set to a specific value. This is an advanced technique, generally not recommended, but it can be very useful in some scenarios.
trans-unit.target: 通常每个倍频按"增益"值缩放前一个倍频的振幅。如果设置为手动,每个倍频的振幅可以设置为特定值。这是一项高级技术,通常不推荐,但在某些情况下非常有用。

trans-unit.source: Typically each octave of noise scales the previous octave's frequency by the 'Lacunarity' value. If set to manual, the frequency at each octave can be set to a specific value. This is an advanced technique, generally not recommended, but it can be very useful in some scenarios.
trans-unit.target: 通常每个噪声倍频按"空缺度"值缩放前一个倍频的频率。如果设置为手动,每个倍频的频率可以设置为特定值。这是一项高级技术,通常不推荐,但在某些情况下非常有用。

trans-unit.source: For fractal-based noise, this sets the fractal type. They each behave in different, interesting ways. It's best to just experiment with each to get a feel for what they do and how the various settings affect them. Good luck!
trans-unit.target: 对于基于分形的噪声,这设置分形类型。它们各自以不同的,有趣的方式运行。最好尝试每个以了解它们的作用以及各种设置如何影响它们。祝你好运!

trans-unit.source: If using fractal-with-derivative-based noise, this sets the type used. These all behave in different and interesting ways. It's best to experiment with each to get a feel for what they do and how the various settings affect them. Good luck!
trans-unit.target: 如果使用基于分形导数的噪声,这设置使用的类型。这些都以不同且有趣的方式运行。最好尝试每个以了解它们的作用以及各种设置如何影响它们。祝你好运!

trans-unit.source: The number of cycles per unit length.
A multiplier that determines how the strength changes with each successive octave.
trans-unit.target: 决定每个连续倍频强度如何变化的乘数。

trans-unit.source: The interpolation method used by the noise. Linear is the fastest and lowest quality. Quintic is the slowest and best quality.
trans-unit.target: 噪声使用的插值方法。线性是最快且质量最低的。五次是最慢且质量最好的。

trans-unit.source: A multiplier that determines how quickly the frequency increases for each successive octave.
trans-unit.target: 决定每个连续倍频频率增加速度的乘数。

trans-unit.source: This is the color gradient that will be used on the brush painting flyout if a custom map is painted for this modifier.
trans-unit.target: 如果为此属性绘制了自定义地图,这是画笔弹出菜单中将使用的颜色渐变。

trans-unit.source: If enabled, this will ignore any custom map that has been created (using the brush flyout) for this modifier.
trans-unit.target: 如果启用,这将忽略为此属性创建的任何自定义地图(使用画笔弹出菜单)。

trans-unit.source: The maximum value represented by map pixel data.
trans-unit.target: 地图像素数据表示的最大值。

trans-unit.source: The minimum value represented by map pixel data.
trans-unit.target: 地图像素数据表示的最小值。

trans-unit.source: Adjust these settings to fine-tune how the auto-pilot controls the craft.
trans-unit.target: 以微调自动驾驶仪控制载具的方式调整这些设置.

trans-unit.source: Auto-pilot uses a "PID" controller with 3 components: Proportional, Integral, and Derivative. Adjust them in-flight to find optimal values (View Panel->Auto-Pilot), then set them here to save with the craft. The hard part of PID tuning is controlling oscillation when the craft is nearly on-target. Values should be large enough to produce the desired response rate without introducing oscillation, across a range of airspeeds. Any value, if too high, can cause oscillation. To start tuning in flight: set integral and derivative to zero. Raise proportional until you reach the desired response rate with minimal oscillation (you may not eliminate it). Raise derivative until overshoot/oscillation is minimized. Add integral to fix any persistent error while keeping oscillation low. Tip: Display input sliders to monitor oscillation in inputs.
trans-unit.target: 自动驾驶仪使用一个包含三个部分的"PID"控制器:比例,积分和微分。在飞行中调整它们以找到最优值(视图面板->自动驾驶仪),然后在此处设置它们以与载具一起保存。PID调谐的难点在于当载具接近目标位置时,如何控制振荡。参数值应足够大,以便在各种空速范围内产生所需的响应速率,同时不引入振荡。任何过高的值都可能导致振荡。在飞行中开始调谐:将积分和微分设置为零。提高比例,直到达到所需的响应速率且振荡最小(可能无法完全消除振荡)。提高微分,直到过冲/振荡最小化。增加积分以修正任何持续存在的误差,同时保持振荡较低。提示:显示输入滑块以监控输入中的振荡。

trans-unit.source: Used to reduce overshooting/oscillations, although excessive amounts will introduce oscillation. Highly maneuverable crafts will not tolerate much if any derivative without introducing oscillation.
trans-unit.target: 用于减少过冲/振荡,但过量使用会导致振荡。高度灵活的载具在无任何微分的情况下也无法承受过多,否则会引起振荡。

trans-unit.source: Attempts to compensate for cases where the proportional is not sufficient to maintain the target. Not typically recommended for roll.
trans-unit.target: 尝试在比例不足以维持目标的情况下进行补偿。通常不建议用于滚转输入.

trans-unit.source: The primary value dictating how strongly the auto-pilot reacts to errors. Craft with large control lag need proportional reduced considerably below the craft's maximum rate to bring oscillation to an acceptable level.
trans-unit.target: 决定自动驾驶系统对误差反应强度的主要参数。对于控制滞后较大的载具,需要将比例大大降低至最大变化率以下,才能使振荡降至可接受水平。

trans-unit.source: A set of one, two, or three comma-separated numbers defining the input axis value range and how it remaps into the -1 to 1 range. {max} - Input axis values <= 0 are remapped to zero. Values >= {max} are remapped to 1. Values between 0 and {max} are lerped between 0 and 1. {min},{max} - Input axis values <= {min} are remapped to -1. Values >= {max} are remapped to 1. Values between {min} and {max} are lerped between -1 and 1. {min},{zero},{max} - Input axis values <= {min} are remapped to -1. Values >= {max} are remapped to 1. Values between {min} and {zero} are lerped between -1 and 0. Values between {zero} and {max} are lerped between 0 and 1. If {min} and {zero} are equal, inputs <= {min} are remapped to 0. If {zero} and {max} are equal, inputs >= {max} are remapped to 0.
trans-unit.target: 一组由一,二或三个逗号分隔的数字,定义输入轴的值范围及其如何映射到-1到1的范围。 {max} - 输入轴值小于等于0时映射为0,大于等于{max}时映射为1,0到{max}之间的值在0到1之间线性插值。 {min},{max} - 输入轴值小于等于{min}时映射为-1,大于等于{max}时映射为1,{min}到{max}之间的值在-1到1之间线性插值。 {min},{zero},{max} - 输入轴值小于等于{min}时映射为-1,大于等于{max}时映射为1,{min}到{zero}之间的值在-1到0之间线性插值,{zero}到{max}之间的值在0到1之间线性插值。若{min}与{zero}相等,小于等于{min}的输入映射为0;若{zero}与{max}相等,大于等于{max}的输入映射为0。

A negative axis will be multiplied by the min value. \n\nLerp Full Axis - The output value will be linearly interpolated between the min and max values assuming an input axis of -1 to 1. Lerp Positive Axis - The output value will be linearly interpolated between the min and max values assuming an input axis of 0 to 1. trans-unit.source: Select the planet map to edit. Planet maps allow you to manually paint certain details directly onto the celestial body's surface.

trans-unit.source: The number of noise octaves to skip when combining noise with a planet map. The first few octaves are typically the strongest, and it's usually best to skip these; otherwise they can greatly impact the result, possibly clobbering the look of the custom map. Including the later octaves can be very helpful to provide finer details the planet map's resolution can't handle.
trans-unit.target: 将噪声与星球地图组合时跳过的噪声倍频数。前几个倍频通常最强,通常最好跳过它们;否则它们可能对结果产生很大影响,可能破坏自定义地图的外观。包含后面的倍频可以提供星球地图分辨率无法处理的更精细细节,这非常有帮助。

The grayscale color value applied at the brush strokes. The data itself is grayscale, but the color gradient above is used to represent it.
trans-unit.target: 笔刷笔触应用的灰度颜色值。数据本身是灰度的,但上面的颜色渐变用于表示它。

trans-unit.source: The color gradient used to represent the values of the planet map. Ultimately, the planet map is like a single-channel texture; what it does depends entirely on the specific planet map for the current celestial body. Some maps represent continents, biomes, mountains, or anything else, and some gradients depict the result better than simple grayscale. This gradient has no real impact on the map's data; it's simply a tool for visualizing it.
trans-unit.target: 用于表示星球地图数值的颜色渐变。归根结底,星球地图就像单通道纹理;它的作用完全取决于当前天体的特定星球地图。有些地图代表大陆,生物群系,山脉或其他任何东西,有些渐变比简单的灰度更好地描绘结果。此渐变对地图数据没有实际影响;它只是可视化工具。
