trans-unit.source: The Biomes flyout panel customizes the look of specific regions of your planet. Each biome is split into one or more sub-biomes, which define the visual style for different altitudes within the same biome. For example, imagine a grassland biome split into three sub-biomes that define how it changes visually as altitude increases. The first could start at -500 meters, well below sea level, and extend to 10 meters above it, with a sandy color and texture to represent beaches near sea level. The next could extend to 500 meters with a grassy color and texture. The last could run from 500 to 10,000 meters with a gray color and rocky texture to represent mountains.
trans-unit.target: 生物群系弹出面板用于自定义星球特定区域的外观。每个生物群系分为一个或多个子生物群系,它们定义同一生物群系内不同海拔高度的视觉风格。例如,想象一个草原生物群系分为三个子生物群系,定义随着海拔升高视觉风格如何变化。第一个可以从海平面以下500米开始,延伸到海平面以上10米,使用沙色和纹理代表近海平面的海滩。下一个可以延伸到500米,使用草绿色和纹理。最后一个可以从500米到10,000米,使用灰色和岩石纹理代表山脉。

trans-unit.source: Looking closely at the diagram above, you'll notice each sub-biome overlaps by some amount. This overlap lets sub-biomes blend smoothly as they transition from one to another; the larger the overlap, the more gradual the transition. Each sub-biome can also define a different visual style based on slope. This is useful for something like a mountain where steep faces are gray but flat spots are white. View each sub-biome's settings via the Flat Style and Slope Style buttons. The Flat End Angle and Slope Start Angle define the range over which those styles blend together.
trans-unit.target: 仔细观察上图,您会注意到每个子生物群系都有一定程度的重叠。这种重叠使子生物群系在过渡时能够平滑混合;重叠越大,过渡越渐进。每个子生物群系还可以根据坡度定义不同的视觉风格。这对山脉很有用,例如陡峭面是灰色而平坦处是白色。通过"平面样式"和"坡度样式"按钮查看每个子生物群系的设置。平面结束角和坡度起始角定义了这两种样式混合的范围。

trans-unit.source: Some planets define their sub-biomes by a value instead of a height, which requires the Sub-Biomes (Value Based) planet modifier for each biome. This can be more flexible and makes it easier to scale your planet's terrain features without changing sub-biome ranges, but it's harder to set up and less intuitive to work with.
trans-unit.target: 有些星球通过数值而非高度来定义子生物群系,这要求每个生物群系使用"子生物群系(基于数值)"星球属性。这可以更灵活,更容易在不改变子生物群系范围的情况下缩放星球地形特征,但设置更复杂,操作不够直观。

trans-unit.source: The Celestial Body Designer is where you build custom celestial bodies (aka planets). Several flyout panels let you customize different parts of your planet. The Properties flyout holds general info such as radius, gravity, atmosphere settings, and more. Settings are extensively tool-tipped, so read those for details on a particular setting. Some settings apply immediately, but others require "rebuilding the planet," done via the Rebuild button in the Celestial Body inspector panel at the top right of the screen. When a rebuild is needed, the button turns blue, as shown below.
trans-unit.target: 天体设计器是您构建自定义天体(即星球)的地方。多个弹出面板让您自定义星球的不同部分。属性弹出面板包含一般信息,如半径,重力加速度,大气设置等。设置有详细的工具提示,请阅读以了解特定设置的详情。某些设置会立即生效,但其他设置需要"重建星球",通过屏幕右上角天体检查器面板中的重建按钮完成。当需要重建时,按钮会变蓝,如下所示。

trans-unit.source: A planet modifier can pass data to another by writing it to a data slot. There are only 10 slots, and writing to one overwrites whatever was there. In Advanced View, toggle the Data Flow panel to see how data flows between modifiers. In the example below, the Noise modifier writes to slot 3; the next modifier, BasicArithmetic, reads from slot 3 and writes its output to slot 4. Slot 3's data persists since BasicArithmetic didn't overwrite it. Blue blocks are outputs; U-shaped blocks are inputs.
trans-unit.target: 一个星球属性可以通过将数据写入数据槽来传递给另一个属性。只有10个槽位,写入一个会覆盖其中的任何内容。在高级视图中,切换数据流面板以查看属性之间的数据流向。在下面的示例中,噪声属性写入槽位3;下一个属性,基础算术,从槽位3读取并将其输出写入槽位4。槽位3的数据保持不变,因为基础算术没有覆盖它。蓝色块是输出;U形块是输入。

trans-unit.source: Change which data slot a modifier uses for inputs and outputs by clicking and dragging its icons in the Data Flow panel. You can also change a modifier's inputs and outputs by selecting it and using the Data Slots section at the bottom of the inspector window.
trans-unit.target: 通过在数据流面板中点击并拖动其图标来更改属性用于输入和输出的数据槽。您也可以通过选择属性并使用检查器窗口底部的数据槽部分来更改其输入和输出。

trans-unit.source: There are two types of data slots: common and biome. During common passes, all planet modifiers write to and read from common data slots. In a biome pass, data is written to and read from a temporary set of slots that reset after each biome pass. A biome pass cannot write to common data slots, but it can read them with a GetCommonData modifier, which reads from a common data slot and outputs into a biome data slot.
trans-unit.target: 有两种类型的数据槽:通用和生物群系。在通用通道期间,所有星球属性写入和读取通用数据槽。在生物群系通道中,数据写入和读取一组临时槽位,每次生物群系通道后重置。生物群系通道无法写入通用数据槽,但可以通过获取通用数据属性读取它们,该属性从通用数据槽读取并输出到生物群系数据槽。

trans-unit.source: A few planet modifiers help troubleshoot terrain generation. The Debug Visualization (Biomes) modifier overrides terrain color to show a distinct color per biome. Just place it at the end of the Final Pass and rebuild the planet. The Debug Visualize (Data) modifier outputs color based on its input, using that input to look up a value in the customizable color gradient in its inspector panel. The input can come from any modifier, but often displays a Noise modifier's output. To use it, place it directly after a Noise modifier and set its input data slot to match the Noise modifier's output data slot. Here's an example showing output from a Noise modifier with a Perlin Fractal noise type.
trans-unit.target: 有几个星球属性可以帮助排查地形生成问题。调试可视化(生物群系)属性会覆盖地形颜色以显示每个生物群系的不同颜色。只需将其放在最终通道的末尾并重建星球。调试可视化(数据)属性根据其输入输出颜色,使用该输入在其检查器面板中可自定义的颜色渐变中查找值。输入可以来自任何属性,但通常显示噪声属性的输出。要使用它,直接将其放在噪声属性之后,并将其输入数据槽设置为与噪声属性的输出数据槽匹配。以下是一个示例,显示使用柏林分形噪声类型的噪声属性的输出。

trans-unit.source: It's also wise to watch your planet's performance via the Performance section of the Celestial Body inspector panel, noting the Quad Build Times, especially the average. Faster average build times improve the experience for players who download your planet. Load up the stock planets and note their average quad build times on your device, then compare. If your planet is considerably slower, it may be worth cutting back on the complexity of your planet modifiers. You can also tweak Properties -> Terrain Quality Modes to reduce the subdivisions and Terrain Vertices per quad.
trans-unit.target: 通过天体检查器面板的性能部分关注您星球的性能也是明智的,注意四边形构建时间,尤其是平均值。更快的平均构建时间可以改善下载您星球的玩家的体验。加载原版星球并注意它们在您设备上的平均四边形构建时间,然后进行比较。如果您的星球明显更慢,可能值得削减星球属性的复杂性。您还可以调整属性 -> 地形质量模式来减少细分和每个四边形的地形顶点数。

trans-unit.source: Welcome to Planet Studio! Here you can build custom planets and planetary systems, then upload and share them with the community. Planet Studio has two parts: the Celestial Body Designer and the Planetary System Designer. The Celestial Body Designer is where you build any celestial body — planets, suns, moons, dwarf planets, etc. Enter it via the Create Planet or Load Planet buttons in the menu. The Planetary System Designer is where you build a solar system from celestial bodies saved on your device. Define their orbits and parent/child relationships. Once complete, upload your system to the website and share it with the community. Enter it via the Load System button in the menu. Both Designers have configurable inputs for camera movement and more, which you can view and configure under Settings -> Control Settings -> Planet Studio. Note: We often say planet instead of the more correct "celestial body" because it's easier and our fingers are tired from all the typing.
trans-unit.target: 欢迎来到星球工作室!在这里您可以构建自定义星球和行星系统,然后上传并与社区分享。星球工作室有两个部分:天体设计器和行星系统设计器。天体设计器是您构建任何天体的地方——行星,太阳,卫星,矮行星等。通过菜单中的"创建星球"或"加载星球"按钮进入。行星系统设计器是您使用设备上保存的星球构建太阳系的地方。定义它们的轨道和父子关系。完成后,将您的星系上传到网站并与社区分享。通过菜单中的"加载星系"按钮进入。两个设计器都有可配置的相机移动等输入,您可以在设置 -> 控制设置 -> 星球工作室中查看和配置。注意:我们经常说"星球"而不是更准确的"天体",因为更简单,而且我们的手指已经打字打累了。

trans-unit.source: The Noise modifier generates a value using one of several gradient noise functions. This value can set a vertex's height, set a biome's strength, or serve as a mask input to another Noise modifier. The possibilities are endless. Noise functions are a very complex topic, beyond the scope of this help text. The basics are below, but one of the best ways to learn is to experiment with the different noise types. Most noise functions use five basic properties: Strength, Frequency, Octaves, Lacunarity, and Gain. Strength Strength is the amplitude of the noise, probably the most intuitive setting. Increasing it makes the noise bolder (ie - it outputs larger values). Frequency Frequency sets the number of cycles per unit length. In other words, small terrain details need a higher frequency and large details need a lower one. Octaves Available for fractal noise, octaves define how many times the noise function runs. With each run, Strength is multiplied by Gain and Frequency by Lacunarity. A common setup is Gain at 0.5 and Lacunarity at 2, so each run halves the strength and doubles the frequency, adding more refined detail at less strength. Increasing octaves can make terrain look great, especially up close, but can also hurt performance, so use them with a hint of caution. Gain As noted above, gain multiplies strength for each successive octave. Typically gain is less than one, since you want strength to drop per octave, but working with noise is an art form and sometimes you must break the rules to create truly unique terrain. Experiment and see what looks best! Lacunarity Lack-You-Nare-Itty. At least that's how I say it. This multiplies frequency with each octave. Typically you want it above one, so frequency increases per octave and details become tinier and more refined.
trans-unit.target: 噪声属性使用几种梯度噪声函数之一生成一个值。这个值可以设置顶点的高度,设置生物群系的强度,或作为另一个噪声属性的遮罩输入。可能性是无限的。噪声函数是一个非常复杂的话题,超出了此帮助文本的范围。以下是基础知识,但最好的学习方法之一是尝试不同的噪声类型。大多数噪声函数使用五个基本属性:强度,频率,倍频数,空隙度和增益。强度强度是噪声的振幅,可能是最直观的设置。增加它使噪声更显著(即输出更大的值)。频率频率设置每单位长度的周期数。换句话说,小地形细节需要更高的频率,大细节需要更低的频率。倍频数可用于分形噪声,倍频数定义噪声函数运行的次数。每次运行时,强度乘以增益,频率乘以空隙度。常见的设置是增益0.5和空隙度2,因此每次运行将强度减半并将频率加倍,以更低的强度添加更精细的细节。增加倍频数可以让地形看起来更好,尤其是近距离,但也会影响性能,所以请谨慎使用。增益如上所述,增益为每个连续倍频数乘以强度。通常增益小于1,因为您希望每倍频数的强度下降,但使用噪声是一门艺术,有时必须打破规则才能创造真正独特的地形。实验并看看什么效果最好!空隙度Lack-You-Nare-Itty。至少我是这么读的。这会在每个倍频数中乘以频率。通常您希望它大于1,因此频率随倍频数增加,细节变得更小更精细。

trans-unit.source: Planet modifiers are grouped into passes. Each pass runs its planet modifiers one at a time before the next pass starts. Passes have different purposes and different input data available. Biome Pass The first pass to run. It sets up the biome strength values, laying out where each biome sits on your planet. For example, an earth-like planet would give high biome strength to arctic biomes at the poles and higher strength to deserts and grasslands near the equator. Height Pass Runs next, mainly responsible for setting the vertex's height value. Height Biomes Pass Runs next for each biome identified in the Biome Pass. If multiple biomes have strength values, they're blended automatically based on their individual strengths. Being biome-specific, this pass is meant for biome-specific modifiers. Height Final Pass Runs next, useful for common modifiers that must run after the biome-specific ones. A great place for the RadialFlatten modifier to smooth terrain for structures and launch locations. Not run for individual biomes. Final Pass The last pass for the terrain, running after all other terrain passes. It sets any remaining unset vertex data, such as color. This is the only pass where the normal vector is available, and it should not modify the height. Final Biomes Pass The Final Pass for biome-specific modifiers. Values are blended based on the strengths from the Biome Pass. Water Pass Runs last. Sets water-related data such as color, wave intensity, etc. Water Biomes Pass The Water Pass for biome-specific modifiers, with water properties blended based on the strengths from the Biome Pass. This is the last pass to run.
trans-unit.target: 星球属性被分组为通道。每个通道在下一个通道开始前逐个运行其属性。通道有不同的用途和不同的可用输入数据。生物群系通道第一个运行的通道。它设置生物群系强度值,确定每个生物群系在星球上的位置。例如,一个类似地球的星球会在极地给极地生物群系高强度值,在赤道附近给沙漠和草原更高的强度值。高度通道接下来运行,主要负责设置顶点的高度值。高度生物群系通道接下来为生物群系通道中识别的每个生物群系运行。如果多个生物群系有强度值,它们会根据各自的强度自动混合。由于是生物群系特定的,此通道用于生物群系特定的属性。高度最终通道接下来运行,适用于必须在生物群系特定属性之后运行的通用属性。是径向扁平属性平滑建筑和发射位置地形的理想位置。不为单个生物群系运行。最终通道地形的最后一个通道,在所有其他地形通道之后运行。它设置任何剩余的未设置顶点数据,如颜色。这是唯一法向量可用的通道,不应修改高度。最终生物群系通道生物群系特定属性的最终通道。值根据生物群系通道中的强度进行混合。水体通道最后运行。设置水体相关数据,如颜色,波浪强度等。水体生物群系通道生物群系特定属性的水体通道,水体属性根据生物群系通道中的强度进行混合。这是最后运行的通道。

trans-unit.source: Here you can build a system using planets saved on your device. Select a planet to tweak its orbital parameters, adjusting the shape and size of its orbit. You can also add a child planet that orbits the selected one as a satellite. The time panel in the top right corner lets you advance and reverse time to view how your planets move through their orbits. The Locations flyout panel shows all locations on planets as they're added to the system. However, if you edit a planet's launch locations after adding it, they won't appear in the System's launch location list. Click the RESET button at the bottom of that panel to search all planets in the system and rebuild the list.
trans-unit.target: 在这里您可以使用设备上保存的星球构建星系。选择一个星球以调整其轨道参数,调整轨道的形状和大小。您还可以添加一个围绕选定星球运行的子星球作为卫星。右上角的时间面板让您前进和倒退时间以查看星球在轨道中的移动。位置弹出面板显示添加到星系中的所有星球上的位置。但是,如果您在添加星球后编辑其发射位置,它们不会出现在星系的发射位置列表中。点击该面板底部的重置按钮以搜索星系中的所有星球并重建列表。

trans-unit.source: The Brush flyout lets you add custom maps to your planet. These maps can work alongside Noise modifiers or override the Noise output completely. For example, this is useful for painting continent locations by hand. Note that the planet must be configured to use a Planet Brush Map.
trans-unit.target: 笔刷弹出面板允许您为星球添加自定义地图。这些地图可以与噪声属性一起使用,或完全覆盖噪声输出。例如,这对于手绘大陆位置很有用。注意星球必须配置为使用星球笔刷地图。

trans-unit.source: To make truly unique planets, you'll likely need the Terrain Generation flyout panel. It's the most complicated part of Planet Studio, but also the most powerful. Terrain generation runs a list of planet modifiers for each terrain vertex. These modifiers calculate the vertex's height, color, texture data, etc. Terrain Generation has two views: Basic and Advanced. Basic shows only a subset of modifiers, with a simplified inspector panel when selected. Advanced shows all modifiers and all their properties in the inspector. You can also view the Data Flow, which shows how data passes between modifiers; see the Data Flow section for details. Basic is selected by default, but you can switch modes by tapping the button at the top left of the flyout panel.
trans-unit.target: 要创造真正独特的星球,您可能需要地形生成弹出面板。它是星球工作室中最复杂的部分,但也是最强大的。地形生成会为每个地形顶点运行一系列星球属性。这些属性计算顶点的高度,颜色,纹理数据等。地形生成有两种视图:基础和高级。基础只显示部分属性,选中时显示简化的检查器面板。高级显示所有属性及其所有属性。您还可以查看数据流,显示数据如何在属性之间传递;详情请参阅数据流部分。默认选择基础视图,但您可以点击弹出面板左上角的按钮切换模式。

trans-unit.source: The constant value to add to or subtract from every pixel. Ideally, every texture should average 0.5 (from 0 to 1). A lower or higher average can greatly impact the average brightness of the terrain using that texture. This setting adjusts that average color if the source texture is too bright or dim.

trans-unit.source: Detail textures brighten or darken the terrain when above or below the 0.5 color value (range 0 to 1). This setting multiplies the difference between the pixel value and 0.5, effectively magnifying the texture's details.
trans-unit.target: 细节纹理在颜色值高于或低于0.5时(范围0到1)会亮化或暗化地形。此设置将像素值与0.5之间的差值相乘,有效地放大纹理的细节。

trans-unit.source: Convert the texture to grayscale before sampling the red channel for the detail texture value used at runtime.
trans-unit.target: 在采样红色通道作为运行时使用的细节纹理值之前,将纹理转换为灰度。

trans-unit.source: Planet has multiple splatmaps, which is not currently supported for editing.
trans-unit.target: 星球拥有多个 splatmap,目前不支持编辑。

trans-unit.source: Planet does not support terrain textures
Please confirm that you want to remove the last terrain texture from this celestial body.
trans-unit.target: 请确认您要从此天体移除最后一个地形纹理。

trans-unit.source: Removes the last texture from this celestial body.
trans-unit.target: 从此天体移除最后一个纹理。

trans-unit.source: The base UV scale for the celestial body when the camera is near the surface. This shared setting affects both terrain and water. Texture mapping uses two UV sets: scaled UVs near the surface and non-scaled UVs farther away. The tiling level for non-scaled UVs is how many times the texture repeats over each of the planet's six faces. For scaled UVs, the tiling level is multiplied by this scaled UV size to get the repeat count. So if this is 256 and a scaled UV level's tiling is 2, the actual tiling for that level is 512.
trans-unit.target: 相机靠近表面时天体的基础UV缩放。此共享设置同时影响地形和水体。纹理映射使用两组UV:靠近表面时的缩放UV和较远时的非缩放UV。非缩放UV的平铺级别是纹理在星球每个面上的重复次数。对于缩放UV,平铺级别乘以该缩放UV尺寸得到重复次数。因此如果此值为256且某缩放UV级别的平铺为2,则该级别的实际平铺为512。

trans-unit.source: The strength of the texture at this level (typically from 0 to 1).
trans-unit.target: 此级别纹理的强度(通常为0到1)。

trans-unit.source: One of the terrain textures used by the celestial body — up to 8 per body. Textures must be added here first, then selected on the Biomes flyout to choose where they're used on the surface. They act as detail textures, brightening and darkening the surface's base color. Only a single channel (red) is used: red values above 0.5 (on a 0 to 1 scale) brighten the terrain color, and values below darken it.
trans-unit.target: 天体使用的地形纹理之一——每个天体最多8个。纹理必须首先在此添加,然后在生物群系弹出面板中选择它们在表面的使用位置。它们作为细节纹理,通过亮化和暗化表面的基础颜色来工作。只使用单个通道(红色):红色值高于0.5(0到1范围内)时亮化地形颜色,低于0.5时暗化。

trans-unit.source: The distance adjustment value added to the distance that determines the tiling level. It is applied after the distance scalar. Example: If the first tiling level lasts until about 100 meters and this adjustment is -500, the first tiling level will last until about 600 meters.
trans-unit.target: 加到决定平铺级别的距离上的距离调整值。它在距离缩放之后应用。示例:如果第一级平铺持续约100米,且此调整为-500,则第一级平铺将持续到约600米。

trans-unit.source: The distance scalar used to adjust the distance at which tiling levels begin. Doubling this value makes tiling levels begin twice as early as normal.
trans-unit.target: 用于调整平铺级别开始距离的距离缩放。将此值加倍会使平铺级别比正常情况早一倍开始。

trans-unit.source: Regenerates the tiling numbers in the table below.
trans-unit.target: 重新生成下表中的平铺数值。

trans-unit.source: This will reset all tiling levels in the table below.
trans-unit.target: 这将重置下表中的所有平铺级别。

trans-unit.source: The tiling level at which textures switch from regular UVs to scaled UVs. Texture mapping uses two UV sets: scaled UVs closer to the surface and non-scaled UVs farther away. The non-scaled tiling level is how many times the texture repeats over each of the planet's six faces. The scaled tiling level is multiplied by the scaled UV size to give how many times the texture repeats.
trans-unit.target: 纹理从常规UV切换到缩放UV的平铺级别。纹理映射使用两组UV:靠近表面时的缩放UV和较远时的非缩放UV。非缩放平铺级别是纹理在星球每个面上的重复次数。缩放平铺级别乘以缩放UV尺寸得到纹理的重复次数。

trans-unit.source: The amount of tiling to apply to textures at this level. Lower levels are shown closer to the ground so more tiling is needed.
trans-unit.target: 此级别应用于纹理的平铺量。较低级别在更靠近地面的位置显示,因此需要更多平铺。

trans-unit.source: Toggles water on/off for the celestial body.
trans-unit.target: 为天体切换水体的开启/关闭。

trans-unit.source: The sea level of the planet, relative to the planet radius.
trans-unit.target: 星球的海平面,相对于星球半径。

trans-unit.source: The scalar applied to the specularity at this level.
trans-unit.target: 此级别应用的高光缩放值。

trans-unit.source: The specularity scale of the water, typically between 0 and 1. It can change as the camera nears the surface. Each entry in this table, from bottom to top, represents the camera getting closer to the surface, with the top entry being the closest.
trans-unit.target: 水体的高光缩放,通常在0到1之间。当相机靠近表面时,它可以改变。此表中的每个条目,从下到上,代表相机逐渐靠近表面,最上面的条目是最近的。

trans-unit.source: The strength of the texture at this level.

The strength of the water's normal map textures, typically 0 to 1. Strength can change as the camera nears the surface. Each entry in this table, from bottom to top, represents the camera getting closer, with the top being closest.
trans-unit.target: 水体法线贴图纹理的强度,通常为0到1。当相机靠近表面时,强度可以改变。此表中的每个条目,从下到上,代表相机逐渐靠近,最上面是最近的。

trans-unit.source: The texture tiling level for the water's normal map textures. Tiling changes as the camera nears the surface. Each entry in this table, from bottom to top, represents the camera getting closer, with the top being closest. Somewhere in the middle, based on the terrain splatmap's setting, the UV scale changes, so the tiling levels here must change too to compensate.
trans-unit.target: 水体法线贴图纹理的纹理平铺级别。当相机靠近表面时,平铺会改变。此表中的每个条目,从下到上,代表相机逐渐靠近,最上面是最近的。在中间某处,基于地形 splatmap 的设置,UV缩放会改变,因此此处的平铺级别也必须相应改变。

trans-unit.source: The movement speed of the texture at this level.
trans-unit.target: 此级别纹理的移动速度。

trans-unit.source: The speed of the water's normal map textures (not the actual waves). Speed can change as the camera nears the surface. Each entry in this table, from bottom to top, represents the camera getting closer to the surface, with the top entry being closest.
trans-unit.target: 水体法线贴图纹理的移动速度(不是实际的波浪)。当相机靠近表面时,速度可以改变。此表中的每个条目,从下到上,代表相机逐渐靠近表面,最上面的条目是最近的。

trans-unit.source: Sets the depth in meters at which the color gradient evaluates at its max value (on the right of the gradient).
trans-unit.target: 设置颜色渐变在其最大值处(渐变的右侧)评估的深度(以米为单位)。

trans-unit.source: The color gradient of the water. Water color is a gradient based on depth. The max depth for the gradient is configured with the setting below.
trans-unit.target: 水体颜色渐变。水体颜色是基于深度的渐变。渐变的最大深度通过下面的设置配置。

trans-unit.source: The intensity of the underwater color.
The underwater color used when the light is no longer visible.
trans-unit.target: 光线不再可见时使用的暗色水下颜色。

trans-unit.source: Sets the density of the fluid in kg per m3.
trans-unit.target: 设置流体的密度,单位为千克每立方米。

trans-unit.source: The emissivity of the water. At 100% emissiveness, the water is unaffected by light.
trans-unit.target: 水体的自发光度。自发光度为100%时,水体不受光照影响。

trans-unit.source: The color of the water foam which is applied on top of reflection/refraction in very shallow water.
trans-unit.target: 水体泡沫的颜色,应用于极浅水区的反射/折射之上。

trans-unit.source: The maximum depth at which foam is applied.
The strength of the foam color.
The higher this value, the stronger the reflections will be at a given viewing angle.
trans-unit.target: 此值越高,在给定视角下的反射越强。

trans-unit.source: The depth in meters at which the light from the sun can no longer pass.
trans-unit.target: 太阳光线无法再穿透的深度(以米为单位)。

trans-unit.source: The distance in meters from the camera at which underwater vision fades.
trans-unit.target: 从相机到水下视野开始衰减的距离(以米为单位)。

trans-unit.source: The metallicness of the water from a visual standpoint.
trans-unit.target: 从视觉角度来看水体的金属度。

trans-unit.source: The higher the value, the more distortion in the water's reflections.
trans-unit.target: 值越高,水体反射中的扭曲越大。

trans-unit.source: Controls the strength of the terrain and craft reflections on the water's surface.
trans-unit.target: 控制地形和载具在水体表面的反射强度。

trans-unit.source: The higher the value, the more distortion in transparent water due to refraction.
trans-unit.target: 值越高,透明水体因折射产生的扭曲越大。

trans-unit.source: How much to scale in-game distances to map-view space. It does not change apparent/relative sizes or distances. The default works for most systems, but very large or very small systems may need a different value. It's always a trade-off between extremes. For instance, decreasing it allows larger systems but may cause camera jitter when viewing a small planet up close. Increasing it gives more stable viewing of smaller planets, but camera rendering may become unstable at very large viewing distances.
trans-unit.target: 将游戏中的距离缩放到地图视图空间的比例。它不会改变表观/相对大小或距离。默认值适用于大多数星系,但非常大或非常小的星系可能需要不同的值。这始终是在极端情况之间的权衡。例如,降低它允许更大的星系,但在近距离观察小行星时可能会导致相机抖动。增加它使较小行星的视图更稳定,但在非常大的观察距离下相机渲染可能会变得不稳定。

trans-unit.source: The mineable resources present in this sub-biome. Each entry pairs a fuel id with a 0..1 concentration that the drill harvest rate is multiplied by. Multiple entries form a mixture — concentrations are independent multipliers, not a partition that must sum to 1.

trans-unit.source: The range over which terrain blends from the primary sub-biome data to the slope sub-biome data. The minimum value is where the slope data begins transitioning in and the primary data begins transitioning out. The maximum value is where the slope data reaches 100% strength and the primary data is no longer used. These values equal one minus the dot product of the normalized planet position (on a unit sphere) and the terrain's normal vector.
trans-unit.target: 地形从主群系数据混合到坡度群系数据的范围。最小值是坡度数据开始过渡进入,主数据开始过渡退出的位置。最大值是坡度数据达到100%强度,主数据不再使用的位置。这些值等于归一化行星位置(在单位球面上)与地形法向量之间的点积的一减。

trans-unit.source: Move the view around by side-scrolling the mouse wheel.
trans-unit.target: 通过水平滚动鼠标滚轮来移动视图。

trans-unit.source: Now try moving the view by side-scrolling the mouse wheel.
trans-unit.target: 现在尝试通过水平滚动鼠标滚轮来移动视图。

trans-unit.source: Now try moving the view with a two-finger drag on the background.

You can also zoom in and out by holding down the {0} mouse button and dragging up or down.

StagingStep instruction shown while the user drags a part toward a stage; {0} is the target stage number

trans-unit.target: 按住{0}然后将其拖到第{1}分级
trans-unit.note: StagingStep mobile instruction; {0} is part name, {1} is target stage number

trans-unit.source: Left click and drag the {0} and drop it in Stage {1}
trans-unit.target: 左键点击并拖动{0},将其放入第{1}分级
trans-unit.note: StagingStep desktop instruction; {0} is part name, {1} is target stage number

trans-unit.source: [Left click|Tap] on the {0} category to expand it.
trans-unit.target: [左键点击|轻触]{0}类别以展开它。
trans-unit.note: StagingStep instruction prompting the user to expand a category; {0} is the category node text

trans-unit.note: StagingStep instruction prompting the user to expand a stage; {0} is the stage number

trans-unit.source: One last step before we call it a day: let's look at this rocket's staging. Staging just means the order parts activate. Stage 1 activates first, then Stage 2, etc. Typically your big engines should activate first and burn their fuel. Once empty, use interstages to jettison them and lighten the load for later stages.
trans-unit.target: 在结束之前还有最后一步:让我们看看这枚火箭的分级。分级只是部件激活的顺序。第1分级先激活,然后第2分级,依此类推。通常你的大型引擎应该先激活并燃烧它们的燃料。一旦耗尽,使用级间段抛弃它们,为后续分级减轻负载。
trans-unit.note: StagingStep long introductory step text before the staging editor is open

trans-unit.source: Click the Staging Editor button on the left.
trans-unit.target: 点击左侧的分级编辑器按钮。

trans-unit.source: Click the red button to show the Center of Mass indicator as a red ball.
trans-unit.target: 点击红色按钮以红色球显示质心指示器。
trans-unit.note: CenterIndicators instruction prompting the user to enable the Center of Mass indicator

trans-unit.note: CenterIndicators instruction prompting the user to enable the Center of Lift indicator

trans-unit.source: Tap the Finger Tool button in the bottom right.
trans-unit.target: 点击右下角的手指工具按钮。
trans-unit.note: FingerToolStep instruction prompting the mobile user to enable the Finger Tool

trans-unit.source: Congratulations on starting your own aerospace company! It's a tough business, but with my connections I can help you succeed. Please, allow me to introduce myself: I am Algernon Fizzlebottom.
trans-unit.target: 恭喜你创办了自己的航空航天公司!航天事业总是困难重重,但凭借我的人脉,我可以帮助你成功。请允许我自我介绍:我是Algernon Fizzlebottom。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial intro step 0 - welcome from Algernon Fizzlebottom

trans-unit.source: I recently inherited my grandfather's research company and own many technology patents. I don't have time to chase the stars myself, so I'm offering incentives to help new aerospace companies get started. Let's go to the Tech Tree and see what I can offer you.
trans-unit.target: 我最近继承了我祖父的研究公司,并拥有许多技术专利。我没有时间亲自追逐星辰,所以我提供激励措施来帮助新的航空航天公司起步。让我们去科技树看看我能为你提供什么。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial intro step 1 - directs user to the Tech Tree

trans-unit.source: Welcome to the Tech Tree. Click '{0}' to see what technologies it contains, then click Unlock. This one won't cost any Tech Points, so it's a great bargain.
trans-unit.target: 欢迎来到科技树。点击"{0}"查看它包含哪些技术,然后点击解锁。这个不需要花费任何科技点,所以非常划算。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial tech-tree first node prompt; {0} is the first node display name (e.g. Crew)

trans-unit.source: Fantastic! Now unlock '{0}'. It is also free.
trans-unit.target: 太棒了!现在解锁"{0}"。它也是免费的。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial tech-tree second node prompt; {0} is the second node display name

trans-unit.source: Now it's up to you to choose your path. Start with '{0}' and build rockets, or start with '{1}' and build cars and planes? You only have enough Tech Points for one, so choose wisely!
trans-unit.target: 现在由你选择你的道路。你愿意从"{0}"开始建造火箭,还是从"{1}"开始建造汽车和飞机?你的科技点只够选择一个,所以要明智选择!
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial tech-tree branching choice prompt; {0} is rockets node name, {1} is cars node name

trans-unit.source: You don't have access to any more technologies for now, so let me show you how to get more Tech Points. Click the back button at the top left to exit the Tech Tree.
trans-unit.target: 你暂时无法解锁更多节点了,所以让我向你展示如何获得更多科技点。点击左上角的返回按钮退出科技树。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial tech-tree exit prompt after all initial nodes are researched
MenuTutorial prompt directing the user to open the Career dialog from the main menu

trans-unit.source: Let's go back to Contracts and accept a contract. It's time to start your career!
trans-unit.target: 让我们回到合同并接受一个合同。是时候开始你的生涯了!
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial prompt directing the user back to the Contracts tab

trans-unit.source: This is where you'll find contracts. Completing them earns the money you need to launch new crafts and unlock better launch locations. Your available funds show at the top of the screen.
trans-unit.target: 这是你查找合同的地方。完成它们可以赚取发射新载具和解锁更好发射场所需的资金。你的可用资金显示在屏幕顶部。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial step 0 explanation shown when the Contracts tab is open
MenuTutorial prompt directing the user to click the Contracts tab

trans-unit.source: To use my patents, I need you to prove you deserve them. So I've set up these Milestones. Reaching them earns Tech Points, which you can spend to unlock new technology in the Tech Tree. Your Tech Point total is shown at the top of the screen.
trans-unit.target: 要使用我的专利,我需要你证明你值得它们。所以我设置了这些里程碑。达成它们可以赚取科技点,你可以用来在科技树中解锁新技术。你的科技点总数显示在屏幕顶部。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial step 1 explanation shown when the Milestones tab is open
MenuTutorial prompt directing the user to click the Milestones tab

trans-unit.source: Here are the landmarks you can visit and additional milestones you can do in each Celestial Body. You can click them to see more details.
trans-unit.target: 这是你可以参观的地标和每个天体中可以完成的额外里程碑。你可以点击它们查看更多详情。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial step 2 explanation shown after the user selects Droo in Exploration

trans-unit.source: Here you can find the exploration related milestones. Click on Droo.
trans-unit.target: 在这里你可以找到与探索相关的里程碑。点击Droo。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial prompt directing the user to click the Droo entry in Exploration
MenuTutorial prompt directing the user to click the Exploration tab

trans-unit.source: Select the {0} contract and then click Start Tutorial to accept this contract and begin a designer tutorial.
trans-unit.target: 选择{0}合同,然后点击开始教程以接受此合同并开始设计器教程。
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial step 3 prompt asking user to select a specific contract; {0} is the contract name

trans-unit.source: Fantastic! I highly recommend doing the tutorial for this contract. Otherwise, click Build in the bottom left to enter the designer and start building your craft. Click Okay and get started! Good luck!
trans-unit.target: 太棒了!我强烈建议做这个合同的教程。要是不想做教程,点击左下角的建造按钮进入设计器并开始建造你的载具。点击确定并开始吧!祝你好运!
trans-unit.note: MenuTutorial final step 3 message shown after a contract is accepted

trans-unit.source: Would you like to back up your current craft before starting the tutorial?
trans-unit.target: 在开始教程之前,你是否要备份当前的载具?
trans-unit.note: DesignerTutorial intro confirmation prompt for backing up the user's craft

trans-unit.source: Welcome to the Designer! First, let me show you how to move the view around.
trans-unit.target: 欢迎来到设计器!首先,让我向你展示如何移动视图。
trans-unit.note: DesignerTutorial welcome message; reused for rotate/pan camera intro steps

trans-unit.source: This is the Command Pod and it's the brain of your rocket. Try to keep it safe. You can't control your rocket without it.
trans-unit.target: 这是指令舱,它是你火箭的大脑。尽量保护它,没有它你就无法控制火箭。

trans-unit.source: Before we add a part, let's turn on the Finger Tool. It makes placing parts with precision much easier. It can also help you clone parts, but we'll cover that later.
trans-unit.target: 在添加部件之前,让我们打开手指工具。它使精确放置部件变得容易得多。它还可以帮助你复制部件,我们稍后会介绍。

trans-unit.source: I've started with the car from The Jump tutorial but I've made some tweaks to make room for some wings.
trans-unit.target: 我从教程中的汽车开始,但做了一些调整以便为机翼腾出空间。

trans-unit.source: First, we'll need to add the main wings that will provide the lift to get this beauty off the ground.
trans-unit.target: 首先,我们需要添加主翼,它们将提供升力使这个美丽的载具离开地面。

trans-unit.source: Now, add a control surface to this wing so the craft will be able to roll and turn while flying through the air.
trans-unit.target: 现在,为这个机翼添加一个控制面,这样载具在空中飞行时能够滚转和转弯。
trans-unit.note: FirstFlightTutorial step 3: add control surface to main wing

trans-unit.source: Use the Symmetry Tool and duplicate our work to the other side.
trans-unit.target: 使用对称工具,将我们的工作复制到另一侧。

trans-unit.source: Now add the elevator, which will allow the craft to pitch upwards and downwards to change its altitude. It's quite important for airplanes.
trans-unit.target: 现在添加升降舵,它允许载具向上和向下俯仰以改变高度。对于飞机来说,这非常重要。

trans-unit.source: The elevator's control surface should respond to Pitch input. Note to self: the wheels are also set to Pitch, so we'll change those later.
trans-unit.target: 升降舵的控制面应该响应俯仰输入,顺便一提:车轮也设置为俯仰,所以我们稍后会更改它们。

trans-unit.source: Use the Symmetry Tool and duplicate our work to the other side.
trans-unit.target: 使用对称工具,将我们的工作复制到另一侧。
trans-unit.note: FirstFlightTutorial step 7: elevator symmetry (same English as Step4 but separate key for translator flexibility)

trans-unit.source: Now add the rudder, which provides stability on the yaw axis. It's a common misconception that the rudder is for turning — that's actually the job of the main wings rolling into the turn. The rudder is for minor corrections.
trans-unit.target: 现在添加尾翼,它提供偏航轴上的稳定性。一个常见的误解是使用尾翼用于转弯——实际上那是靠主翼滚转实现的,而尾翼用于微调。

trans-unit.source: The rudder's control surface should respond to Yaw input.
trans-unit.target: 尾翼的控制面应该响应偏航输入。

trans-unit.source: Since the elevators use the Pitch input, we'll change the wheels' motor input to Throttle. Otherwise, pulling back on the stick to pitch up would also decrease the motor input.
trans-unit.target: 由于升降舵使用俯仰输入,我们将车轮的电机输入更改为节流阀。否则,向后拉杆以抬头俯仰也会降低电机输入。
trans-unit.note: FirstFlightTutorial step 10: configure motor input on wheels

trans-unit.source: When designing an airplane, the relationship between the Center of Mass (CoM) and the Center of Lift (CoL) is very important. We can visualize their positions using the View Panel.
trans-unit.target: 设计飞机时,质心(CoM)与升力中心(CoL)之间的关系非常重要。我们可以使用视图面板来可视化它们的位置。

trans-unit.source: As you can see, the red Center of Mass is slightly in front of the blue Center of Lift, so this craft should be aerodynamically stable. The further the CoM is in front of the CoL, the more stable it becomes, but it loses some maneuverability and pitch response. The closer they are, the more aerobatic it becomes, but too close and it can turn unstable. CoM behind the CoL would be like trying to shoot an arrow backwards, feathers first. To simplify: the red ball is in front of the blue ball, so this craft is good to go.
trans-unit.target: 如你所见,红色质心略微位于蓝色升力中心前方,因此该载具在空气动力学上应该是稳定的。质心越靠前于升力中心,稳定性越强,但会失去一些机动性和俯仰响应。它们越接近,载具越具有特技飞行能力,但太接近可能会变得不稳定。质心位于升力中心后方就像试图倒射一支箭,羽毛在前。简单来说:红球在蓝球前面,所以这个载具可以起飞了。

trans-unit.source: Great job! Even the Wright Brothers would be proud!
trans-unit.target: 干得好!连莱特兄弟都会为你骄傲!

trans-unit.source: Now launch this magnificent creation from the Juno Village Runway. Let's see if this thing can fly!
trans-unit.target: 现在从Juno村跑道发射这个宏伟的杰作。让我们看看这东西能不能飞!

trans-unit.source: We have a craft ready for you, but its engines need a few tweaks to improve performance so it can achieve orbit.
trans-unit.target: 我们为你准备了一艘载具,但它的引擎需要一些调整以提高性能,使其能够进入轨道。

trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 2: open Design Info panel

trans-unit.source: This is the craft's total Delta V, meaning change in velocity. Theoretically, it's how fast the craft could go in a perfect environment with no gravity and no drag.
trans-unit.target: 这是载具的总速度增量,即速度的变化量。理论上,它是在没有重力和阻力的完美环境中载具能达到的速度。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 2 DeltaV all-stages metric text

trans-unit.source: Realistically, we need at least 4,500m/s to reach low orbit around Droo. It looks like we have more than enough, but remember that engine performance is affected by atmospheric pressure, which changes with altitude.
trans-unit.target: 实际上,我们需要至少4500m/s才能进入Droo周围的低轨道。看起来我们绰绰有余,但请记住,引擎性能会受到大气压强的影响,而大气压强随高度变化。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 3: explanation about DeltaV requirement

trans-unit.source: We have some work to do. We'll look at each stage to see what we can do to improve performance. Don't worry, it's just rocket science.
trans-unit.target: 我们还有一些工作要做。我们将查看每个分级,看看能做些什么来提高性能。别担心,这只是火箭科学。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 3 metric text after DeltaV at sea level

trans-unit.source: Let's look at the first stage, which consists of five solid rocket motors.
trans-unit.target: 让我们看看第一分级,它由五个固体火箭发动机组成。

trans-unit.source: The Delta V looks okay for this stage. We just want it to gain some altitude before starting the more efficient engines, which need a thinner atmosphere to work.
trans-unit.target: 这一分级的速度增量看起来还可以。我们只想让它在启动更高效的引擎之前获得一些高度,这些引擎需要更稀薄的大气才能工作。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 4 stage 1 DeltaV metric text

trans-unit.source: Another important metric is TWR, or Thrust to Weight Ratio. If it's less than 1, the craft can't overcome gravity during liftoff. This stage has plenty of TWR for launch.
trans-unit.target: 另一个重要指标是推重比(TWR)。如果它小于1,载具在起飞时无法克服重力。这一分级有足够的推重比用于发射。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 5 stage 1 Starting TWR metric text

trans-unit.source: Notice the Ending TWR is higher than the Starting TWR. That's because the engines burn fuel mass throughout the stage, so the craft loses mass. This means the rocket's acceleration actually increases throughout the stage.
trans-unit.target: 注意结束推重比高于起始推重比。这是因为引擎在整个分级中燃烧燃料质量,所以载具质量减少。这意味着火箭的加速度在整个分级中实际上在增加。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 6 stage 1 Ending TWR metric text

trans-unit.source: One last thing: the Isp, or Specific Impulse. It's kinda like gas mileage for rocket engines, and higher is better. These solid rocket motors aren't very efficient, but they're cheap and get the job done.
trans-unit.target: 最后一点:比冲(Isp)。它有点像火箭引擎的油耗,越高越好。这些固体火箭发动机效率不高,但它们便宜且能完成任务。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 7 stage 1 Isp metric text

trans-unit.source: Let's look at the second stage. From our previous launches we have found that this stage will ignite around 8km altitude.
trans-unit.target: 让我们看看第二分级。根据我们之前的发射经验,这一分级将在约8公里高度点火。

trans-unit.source: The Delta V and Starting TWR are terrible for this stage. That's because the Gnome Engine is optimized for a vacuum, but don't worry! We can do some rocket surgery here to improve its performance inside an atmosphere.
trans-unit.target: 这一分级的速度增量和起始推重比都很糟糕。这是因为"侏儒"引擎针对真空优化,但别担心!我们可以在这里做一些修改来提高它在大气中的性能。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 8 stage 2 DeltaV metric text

trans-unit.source: This engine is suffering from severe over-expansion, which happens when the exhaust Exit Pressure is below Air Pressure. Over-expansion is what causes shock diamonds in the exhaust. The closer Exit Pressure is to Air Pressure, the more efficient the engine.
trans-unit.target: 这台引擎正遭受严重的过膨胀,当排气出口压力低于大气压时就会发生。过膨胀是导致尾焰中出现钻石激波的原因。出口压力越接近大气压,引擎效率越高。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 9 stage 2 ExitPressure metric text

trans-unit.source: We can shorten the nozzle and crank up the power to raise this engine's Exit Pressure closer to the Air Pressure at this altitude.
trans-unit.target: 我们可以缩短喷管并提高推力,使这台引擎的出口压力更接近该高度的大气压力。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 10: stage 2 configure rocket engine step

trans-unit.source: Let's take a look and see how things have changed.
trans-unit.target: 让我们看看情况有什么变化。

trans-unit.source: That's a huge improvement in Delta V and TWR! Now let's take a look at the third stage.
trans-unit.target: 速度增量和推重比都有了巨大的提升!现在让我们看看第三分级。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 11 stage 2 review metric text

trans-unit.source: The third stage engine will mostly be working in the upper atmosphere and in space.
trans-unit.target: 第三级引擎将主要在大气层上层和太空中工作。

trans-unit.source: The Delta V is pretty good for this stage, but we can improve it by lengthening the nozzle.
trans-unit.target: 这一分级的速度增量相当不错,但我们可以通过加长喷管来改进它。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 12 stage 3 DeltaV metric text

trans-unit.source: Ideally, Exit Pressure would be 0 for a rocket engine built to work in space, but that would need an infinitely large nozzle. We'll settle for something a little shorter than that.
trans-unit.target: 理想情况下,针对太空工作的火箭引擎的出口压力应为0,但这需要一个无限大的喷管。我们会选择一个比那稍微短一点的。
trans-unit.note: FirstOrbitTutorial step 13: stage 3 configure rocket engine step

trans-unit.source: Great work! Now this rocket is ready for launch!
trans-unit.target: 干得好!现在这枚火箭准备发射了!

trans-unit.source: Click the launch button at the top right and launch from the Juno Village Pad.
trans-unit.target: 点击右上角的启动按钮,从Juno村发射台发射。

trans-unit.source: Let's start with the same rocket we built for the Vertical Shot contract, minus the nose cone.
trans-unit.target: 让我们从为"垂直发射"合同建造的同一枚火箭开始,去掉鼻锥。

trans-unit.source: First, let's attach the payload. This is what the customer wants us to bring to space, so be careful with it and try not to damage it.
trans-unit.target: 首先,让我们连接载荷。这是客户希望我们带到太空的东西,所以要小心处理,尽量不要损坏它。

trans-unit.source: Now, let's add an 'Interstage'. It splits the rocket into multiple 'stages' but more on that later.
trans-unit.target: 现在,让我们添加一个"级间段"。它将火箭分成多个"分级",但稍后再详细介绍。

trans-unit.source: Now let's add another fuel tank below this, but we will make it a bit fatter so it can hold more fuel.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们在这下面添加另一个燃料箱,但我们会把它做得更粗一些,以便容纳更多燃料。
trans-unit.note: FirstPayloadTutorial step 4: add fatter fuel tank

trans-unit.source: Now let's connect an engine to this fuel tank.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们为这个燃料箱连接一个引擎。

trans-unit.source: Now let's duplicate this engine because we need more thrust.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们复制这个引擎,因为我们需要更多推力。
trans-unit.note: FirstPayloadTutorial step 6: duplicate engine via symmetry

trans-unit.source: Now let's add some fins to the bottom stage for more stabilization. We can clone the fins from the upper stage to save us some work.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们为底部分级添加一些尾翼以获得更多稳定性。我们可以复制上分级的尾翼来节省一些工作。
trans-unit.note: FirstPayloadTutorial step 7: add fins to bottom stage
FirstPayloadTutorial step 8: enable symmetry on fin

trans-unit.source: Staging is normally calculated automatically, but it's a good idea to check it before launching. The Second Stage Engine should actually be in Stage 2 so it can activate and do its thing before the payload is deployed.
trans-unit.target: 分级通常自动计算,但发射前检查是个好主意。第二级引擎实际上应该在第二分级,这样它可以在载荷部署之前启动并工作。
trans-unit.note: FirstPayloadTutorial step 9 staging step main text

trans-unit.source: Excellent! You have built a multi-stage rocket!
trans-unit.target: 太棒了!你建造了一枚多级火箭!

trans-unit.source: Now click the Launch button and see how it flies.
trans-unit.target: 现在点击启动按钮,看看它飞得怎么样。

trans-unit.source: Great news! We have an airplane for you, all ready to go!
trans-unit.target: 好消息!我们有一架飞机给你,一切准备就绪!

trans-unit.source:
These electric motors spin the propellers to generate thrust. They spin in opposite directions so the torque cancels out.

It's very efficient, but also a bit slow. Later, after you unlock jet engines, you'll be able to build much faster airplanes.
trans-unit.target:
这些电动机旋转螺旋桨以产生推力。它们向相反方向旋转,因此扭矩相互抵消。

效率很高,但速度有点慢。之后,当你解锁喷气引擎后,你将能够建造更快的飞机。
trans-unit.note: FirstRaceTutorial step 2: electric motor explanation; preserves literal <br><br> tags

trans-unit.source: Good luck on your first air race!
trans-unit.target: 祝你在第一次空中竞速中好运!

trans-unit.source: Launch from the Juno Village Runway.
Since we are building a craft that mostly moves horizontally, we'll need to change the Command Disc from Rocket to Plane configuration.
trans-unit.target: 由于我们正在建造一个主要水平移动的载具,我们需要将指令盘从火箭配置更改为飞机配置。
trans-unit.note: TheJumpTutorial step 1: command pod configuration step

trans-unit.source: Let's also increase the battery capacity, which will increase the driving range of this car.
trans-unit.target: 让我们也增加电池容量,这将增加这辆车的行驶里程。

trans-unit.source: Let's start building a car. First, add an empty fuel tank behind the Command Disc. This will serve as the body of the car.
trans-unit.target: 让我们开始建造一辆汽车。首先,在指令盘后面添加一个空燃料箱。这将作为车身。
trans-unit.note: TheJumpTutorial step 2: add fuel tank body

trans-unit.source: Now let's add a nose cone to help reduce drag and make it look cooler too.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们添加一个鼻锥,以帮助减少阻力,也让它看起来更酷。

trans-unit.source: Now let's add a front wheel.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们添加一个前轮。

trans-unit.source: Now let's add a rear wheel
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们添加一个后轮
trans-unit.note: TheJumpTutorial step 5: add rear wheel (intentionally no trailing period)

trans-unit.source: I think cars usually have wheels on both sides, so let's use the Symmetry Tool and duplicate our work to the other side.
trans-unit.target: 我觉得汽车通常两侧都有轮子,所以让我们使用对称工具,将我们的工作复制到另一侧。

trans-unit.source: Now do the same thing for the other wheel.
trans-unit.target: 现在对另一个轮子做同样的事情。

trans-unit.source: Make the front wheels turnable and reduce the engine torque to save money. Since Symmetry Mode is enabled on this wheel, the other side automatically gets any changes we make.
trans-unit.target: 使前轮可转向,并降低发动机扭矩以节省资金。由于对称模式已在此轮上启用,我们做的任何更改另一侧都会自动应用。
trans-unit.note: TheJumpTutorial step 8: front wheel config; original had a paragraph break

trans-unit.source: Crank up the torque on those rear wheels and adjust their gear ratio. Lower gear ratios favor top speed; higher gear ratios favor acceleration.
trans-unit.target: 提高那些后轮的扭矩并调整它们的齿轮比。较低的齿轮比有利于最高速度;较高的齿轮比有利于加速。
trans-unit.note: TheJumpTutorial step 9: rear wheel torque/gear ratio config

trans-unit.source: Change the motor input to use Pitch instead of Throttle. This will allow you to go in reverse in case you get stuck.
trans-unit.target: 将电机输入从节流阀改为俯仰。这将允许你在卡住时倒车。

trans-unit.source: Excellent! I've never seen a better car! I'm really proud of us!
trans-unit.target: 太棒了!我从没见过更好的车!我真为我们骄傲!

trans-unit.source: Now click the launch button at the top right and launch this magnificent creation from the Juno Village Runway.
trans-unit.target: 现在点击右上角的启动按钮,从Juno村跑道发射这个宏伟的杰作。

trans-unit.source: Let's build a rocket! The first step is to add a fuel tank below the Command Disc.
trans-unit.target: 让我们建造一枚火箭!第一步是在指令盘下方添加一个燃料箱。

trans-unit.source: Now let's add a nose cone to help reduce drag.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们添加一个鼻锥,以帮助减少阻力。

trans-unit.source: Now connect an engine to this fuel tank. Engines draw fuel from the fuel tanks directly above them.
trans-unit.target: 现在为这个燃料箱连接一个引擎。引擎从正上方的燃料箱抽取燃料。

trans-unit.source: Now let's add some fins to help stabilize this beautiful creation.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们添加一些尾翼,以帮助稳定这个美丽的杰作。

trans-unit.source: Now we can enable Symmetry Mode on this fin so we can duplicate our work instead of having to add each fin individually.
trans-unit.target: 现在我们可以在这个尾翼上启用对称模式,这样我们就可以复制我们的改动,而不必逐个添加每个尾翼。
trans-unit.note: VerticalShotTutorial step 5: enable symmetry on fin

trans-unit.source: Now let's enable the gyro on the Command Disc. The gyro can help to stabilize the rocket when it's in flight.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们启用指令盘上的陀螺仪。陀螺仪可以帮助稳定飞行中的火箭。
trans-unit.note: VerticalShotTutorial step 6: enable gyro on command disc

trans-unit.source: Excellent! You have built your first rocket!
trans-unit.target: 太棒了!你建造了你的第一枚火箭!

trans-unit.source: Click the launch button at the top right and launch from the Juno Village Pad.
trans-unit.target: 点击右上角的启动按钮,从Juno村发射台发射。

trans-unit.source: Let's start building. The first step is to add a fuel tank below the Command Pod.
trans-unit.target: 让我们开始建造。第一步是在指令舱下方添加一个燃料箱。

trans-unit.source: Now let's connect a small engine to this fuel tank. Engines draw fuel from the fuel tanks directly above them.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们为这个燃料箱连接一个小引擎。引擎从正上方的燃料箱抽取燃料。

trans-unit.source: Now let's connect an 'Interstage'. It splits the rocket into multiple 'stages' but more on that later.
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们连接一个"级间段"。它将火箭分成多个"分级",但稍后再详细介绍。

trans-unit.source: Let's add another, larger fuel tank below the Interstage.
trans-unit.target: 让我们在级间段下方添加另一个更大的燃料箱。
trans-unit.note: SandboxTutorial step 4: add larger fuel tank

trans-unit.source: Connect a more powerful engine to this fuel tank.
trans-unit.target: 为这个燃料箱连接一个更强大的引擎。
trans-unit.note: SandboxTutorial step 5: connect more powerful engine

trans-unit.source: We're going to add side boosters, but first we need to add a 'Side Interstage' that it can connect to.
trans-unit.target: 我们要添加侧助推器,但首先我们需要添加一个"侧级间段"供它连接。

trans-unit.source: Add another fuel tank here. If you have trouble connecting, try dragging your mouse directly on top of the Side Interstage part we just added.
trans-unit.target: 在这里添加另一个燃料箱。如果连接有困难,尝试将鼠标直接拖动到我们刚刚添加的侧级间段部件上。
trans-unit.note: SandboxTutorial step 7: add side fuel tank

trans-unit.source: Add another engine under this side fuel tank.
trans-unit.target: 在这个侧燃料箱下方添加另一个引擎。

trans-unit.source: Let's add a nose cone to help reduce drag.
trans-unit.target: 让我们添加一个鼻锥,以帮助减少阻力。

trans-unit.source: Now we can enable Symmetry Mode on this part so we can duplicate our work over to the other side.
trans-unit.target: 现在我们可以在这个部件上启用对称模式,以便将我们的工作复制到另一侧。
trans-unit.note: SandboxTutorial step 10: enable symmetry on side interstage

trans-unit.source: Solar panels are fun, let's add some of those.
trans-unit.target: 太阳能板很有趣,让我们添加一些。

trans-unit.source: Let's enable Symmetry Mode on this Solar Panel Array to duplicate our work to the other side of the rocket.
trans-unit.target: 让我们在这个太阳能电池板阵列上启用对称模式,将我们的工作复制到火箭的另一侧。
trans-unit.note: SandboxTutorial step 12: enable symmetry on solar panel

trans-unit.source: Like many other parts, the Solar Panel Array is highly customizable.
trans-unit.target: 与许多其他部件一样,太阳能电池板阵列高度可定制。
trans-unit.note: SandboxTutorial step 13: solar panel array customization (original had trailing single newline)

trans-unit.source: Staging is normally calculated automatically, but sometimes you need to re-arrange things. I purposely messed up the staging for this rocket, so we'll need to fix it. The Pixie Engine shouldn't turn on until after the large boosters have jettisoned. To do that, we need to move it to the last stage.
trans-unit.target: 分级通常自动计算,但有时你需要重新排列。我故意弄乱了这枚火箭的分级,所以我们需要修复它。有个小引擎不应该在大型助推器抛弃之前启动。要做到这一点,我们需要将它移到最后一级。
trans-unit.note: SandboxTutorial step 14 staging step main text

trans-unit.source: Excellent! You have built a multi-stage rocket! You should check out the Flight Tutorial next to learn how to fly this masterpiece!
trans-unit.target: 太棒了!你建造了一枚多级火箭!接下来你应该查看飞行教程,学习如何驾驶这个杰作!
trans-unit.note: SandboxTutorial step 15: final info step (also reused for EndStep)

trans-unit.source: Press the '{0}. {1}' button to enable it.
Click on the Activation Panel icon on the right to open the Activation Panel.
trans-unit.target: 点击右侧的激活面板图标以打开激活面板。

trans-unit.source: Click on the highlighted button to show the analog sticks.
trans-unit.target: 点击高亮按钮以显示模拟摇杆。
等待直到轨道远点达到{0}

trans-unit.source: Pull the left stick down to engage the brakes.
trans-unit.target: 将左摇杆向下拉以启用制动。

trans-unit.source: Release the left stick to disengage the brakes.
trans-unit.target: 释放左摇杆以解除制动。

trans-unit.source: Press and hold '|Brake;+|' to engage the brakes.
trans-unit.note: FlightTutorialState.EnsureBrake; |Brake;+| is an input binding marker, do not translate
FlightTutorialState.EnsureBrake; |Brake;+| is an input binding marker, do not translate

trans-unit.source: Great! Now just wait for the docking ports to connect.
trans-unit.target: 太好了!现在只需等待对接口连接。

trans-unit.source: Use the left analog stick to move forward and backward. The right stick moves the craft up/down and left/right.
trans-unit.target: 使用左模拟摇杆前后移动。右摇杆使载具上下左右移动。

trans-unit.source: Press '|Pitch;+|', '|Pitch;-|', '|Yaw;-|', '|Yaw;+|' to move the craft up, down, left, and right. Press '|SwapRollYaw;+|' to swap Roll and Yaw inputs, then '|Yaw;+|' and '|Yaw;-|' move the craft forward and backward.
trans-unit.target: 按"|Pitch;+|",|Pitch;-|",|Yaw;-|",|Yaw;+|"使载具上下左右移动。按"|SwapRollYaw;+|"交换滚转和偏航输入,然后"|Yaw;+|"和"|Yaw;-|"使载具前后移动。
trans-unit.note: FlightTutorialState.EnsureDocked controller, only Yaw is bound

trans-unit.source: Press '|Roll;+|' and '|Roll;-|' to move the craft forward/backward, '|Pitch;+|' and '|Pitch;-|' to move it up/down. Press '|SwapRollYaw;+|' to swap Roll and Yaw inputs, then '|Roll;-|' and '|Roll;+|' to move it left/right.
trans-unit.target: 按"|Roll;+|"和"|Roll;-|"使载具前后移动,"|Pitch;+|"和"|Pitch;-|"使其上下移动。按"|SwapRollYaw;+|"交换滚转和偏航输入,然后"|Roll;-|"和"|Roll;+|"使其左右移动。
trans-unit.note: FlightTutorialState.EnsureDocked controller, only Roll is bound

trans-unit.source: Press '|Roll;+|' and '|Roll;-|' to move the craft forward and backward. Press '|Yaw;-|', '|Yaw;+|', '|Pitch;+|', and '|Pitch;-|' move the craft left, right, up, and down.
trans-unit.target: 按"|Roll;+|"和"|Roll;-|"使载具前后移动。按"|Yaw;-|",|Yaw;+|",|Pitch;+|"和"|Pitch;-|"使载具左右上下移动。

trans-unit.source: Select Fast Forward (in the top right) to speed things up
trans-unit.target: 选择快进(在右上角)以加速进程

trans-unit.source: The atmosphere is thinner at this altitude, so we can throttle back up to 100%
trans-unit.target: 在这个高度大气更稀薄,所以我们可以将节流阀调回100%

trans-unit.source: Turn the throttle down so we don't lose too much speed from high drag forces
trans-unit.target: 降低节流阀,以免因高阻力损失太多速度

trans-unit.source: Click the Lock Heading button to enable Heading Lock.
trans-unit.target: 点击锁定航向按钮以启用航向锁定。

trans-unit.source: Click the Lock Heading button to disable Heading Lock.
trans-unit.target: 点击锁定航向按钮以禁用航向锁定。

trans-unit.source: Click the Lock Velocity Prograde button on the right to lock your heading on your prograde.
trans-unit.target: 点击右侧的锁定速度顺行按钮,将航向锁定在顺行方向上。

trans-unit.source: Click the Lock Velocity Prograde button on the right to unlock your heading from prograde.
trans-unit.target: 点击右侧的锁定速度顺行按钮,解除航向对顺行方向的锁定。

trans-unit.source: Tap the Toggle Map View button in the upper left to enter Map View
trans-unit.target: 点击左上角的切换地图视图按钮进入地图视图

trans-unit.source: Tap the Toggle Map View button in the upper left to exit Map View
trans-unit.target: 点击左上角的切换地图视图按钮退出地图视图

trans-unit.source: Press the '|ToggleMapView|' key to enter Map View
trans-unit.note: FlightTutorialState.EnsureMapView; |ToggleMapView| is an input binding marker

trans-unit.source: Press the '|ToggleMapView|' key to exit Map View
trans-unit.note: FlightTutorialState.EnsureMapView; |ToggleMapView| is an input binding marker

trans-unit.source: Zoom in closer on your craft
trans-unit.target: 放大到更靠近你的载具

trans-unit.source: Click the Select Player button to focus on the player
trans-unit.target: 点击选择玩家按钮以聚焦玩家

trans-unit.source: Click the button on the right to show the Map View Inspector window
trans-unit.target: 点击右侧按钮显示地图视图检查器窗口

trans-unit.source: Click and drag anywhere on the orange nav circle until your heading is set to {0}°.
trans-unit.target: 在橙色导航圆圈上任意位置点击并拖动,直到航向设为{0}°。

trans-unit.source: Click and drag anywhere on the orange nav circle until your heading is set to 90° (East)
trans-unit.target: 在橙色导航圆圈上任意位置点击并拖动,直到航向设为90°(正东)

trans-unit.source: Click the button on the right side of the screen to show the Nav Sphere Panel
trans-unit.target: 点击屏幕右侧按钮显示导航球面板

trans-unit.source: Drag anywhere on the blue nav circle until your pitch is set to {0}°. Just line up the blue triangle with the flashing yellow triangle.

trans-unit.source: Let me show you how to get this craft into orbit. I may pause the game periodically so you'll have time to adjust the controls.
trans-unit.target: 让我来展示如何将这个载具送入轨道。我可能会周期性地暂停游戏,以便你有时间调整控制。

trans-unit.source: The Nav Sphere controls your craft's heading. With Heading Lock enabled, your craft always tries to point toward the blue triangle. The white cone is the direction your craft currently points.
trans-unit.target: 导航球控制载具的航向。启用航向锁定后,载具始终尝试朝向蓝色三角形。白色圆锥是载具当前指向的方向。

trans-unit.source: %ActivateInstruction% to activate your first stage. This will activate your engines.
trans-unit.target: %ActivateInstruction%以激活第一级。这将启动你的引擎。
trans-unit.note: LevelFlightTutorial Step 0 EnsureStage - %ActivateInstruction% placeholder is replaced at runtime

trans-unit.source: Keep going until your altitude is about 1,000m.
trans-unit.target: 继续飞行,直到高度达到约1,000米。

trans-unit.source: Time to start a 'Gravity Turn' so we can start building up lateral speed while we climb.
trans-unit.target: 是时候开始"重力转向"了,这样我们可以在爬升的同时开始积累横向速度。

trans-unit.source: Continue like this until your altitude is about 5,000m
trans-unit.target: 继续这样飞行,直到高度达到约5,000米

trans-unit.source: Adjust your Gravity Turn to help increase our lateral speed.
trans-unit.target: 调整重力转向,以帮助增加横向速度。

trans-unit.source: Continue like this until your altitude is about 15,000m. We need a lot of lateral speed to get into orbit.
trans-unit.target: 继续这样飞行,直到高度达到约15,000米。我们需要大量横向速度才能进入轨道。

trans-unit.source: Adjust your Gravity Turn for even more lateral speed.
trans-unit.target: 进一步调整重力转向以获得更多横向速度。

trans-unit.source: Continue like this until your active engines run out of fuel
trans-unit.target: 继续这样飞行,直到活动引擎耗尽燃料

trans-unit.source: Great! Now it's time to activate the next two stages, which will jettison those empty fuel tanks and then start your next engine.
trans-unit.target: 太好了!现在该激活接下来的两个分级了,这将抛弃那些空燃料箱,然后启动你的下一个引擎。

trans-unit.source: %ActivateInstruction% to jettison your empty fuel tanks and engines.
trans-unit.note: LevelFlightTutorial Step 5 EnsureStage - %ActivateInstruction% placeholder replaced at runtime

trans-unit.source: %ActivateInstruction% again to start your next engine.
trans-unit.target: 再次%ActivateInstruction%以启动你的下一个引擎。
trans-unit.note: LevelFlightTutorial Step 5 EnsureStage - %ActivateInstruction% placeholder replaced at runtime

trans-unit.source: Now, let's take a look at Map View.
trans-unit.target: 现在,让我们看看地图视图。

trans-unit.source: This is the Map View. First, let's zoom in on your craft.
trans-unit.target: 这就是地图视图。首先,让我们放大到你的载具。

trans-unit.source: The blue cone is your craft and the blue line is your predicted trajectory/orbit. The green arrow is your 'apoapsis,' the highest point along your orbit.
trans-unit.target: 蓝色圆锥是你的载具,蓝线是你的预测轨迹/轨道。绿色箭头是你的"轨道远点",即轨道上最高的点。

trans-unit.source: Awesome! Now we need to kill the engines and wait.
trans-unit.target: 太棒了!现在我们需要关闭引擎并等待。

trans-unit.source: Wait until we are 30 seconds from the apoapsis to do our next burn
trans-unit.target: 等到距离轨道远点还有30秒时,再进行下一次点火

trans-unit.source: While we're waiting, I just wanted to say thanks for playing our game.
trans-unit.target: 在等待的同时,我想说感谢你玩我们的游戏。

trans-unit.source: Now we need to Heading Lock our 'prograde.' Prograde just means the direction the craft is moving. This ensures we burn efficiently as we reach the peak of our orbit.
trans-unit.target: 现在我们需要航向锁定"顺行方向"。顺行方向就是载具运动的方向。这确保我们在到达轨道最高点时高效地燃烧。

trans-unit.source: Continue like this until your engine runs out of fuel.
trans-unit.target: 继续这样飞行,直到引擎耗尽燃料。

trans-unit.source: %ActivateInstruction% to jettison your empty fuel tank and engine.
trans-unit.note: LevelFlightTutorial Step 9 EnsureStage - %ActivateInstruction% placeholder replaced at runtime

trans-unit.source: %ActivateInstruction% again to start your last engine.
trans-unit.target: 再次%ActivateInstruction%以启动你的最后一个引擎。
trans-unit.note: LevelFlightTutorial Step 9 EnsureStage - %ActivateInstruction% placeholder replaced at runtime

trans-unit.source: We're almost there. Now burn until the orange 'periapsis' arrow shows up. The periapsis is the lowest point in our orbit, and we want it well above the atmosphere.
trans-unit.target: 我们快到了。现在继续燃烧,直到橙色"轨道近点"箭头出现。轨道近点是我们轨道的最低点,我们希望它远高于大气层。

trans-unit.source: Continue burning until the orange 'periapsis' arrow appears and is well above the atmosphere.
trans-unit.target: 继续燃烧,直到橙色"轨道近点"箭头出现并且远高于大气层。

trans-unit.source: You did it! Now kill your engines.
trans-unit.target: 你做到了!现在关闭引擎。

trans-unit.source: Now let's activate those fancy solar panels
trans-unit.target: 现在让我们激活那些漂亮的太阳能板

trans-unit.source: Returns true if the text on the left contains the text on the right.

trans-unit.source: Gets a property of the craft with the specified ID.
trans-unit.target: 获取具有指定ID的载具的属性。

trans-unit.source: Event called when this craft docks with another craft. NOTE: Part IDs may change after docking with another craft.

trans-unit.source: Logs the message to the flight log. If the second parameter is true, it overrides the message; if false, it writes a new one every time.

trans-unit.source: The European Space Agency is going to visit Jupiter for the first time, to commemorate this event, can you bring JUICE to Tydos? Bring the vessel to Droo orbit, deploy it and use only its built in propulsion to reach the Gas Giant. How many gravity assists are you going to need?

trans-unit.source:
Welcome to the JUICE challenge! Can you bring JUICE to Tydos?
Fuel is low, so you may need to plan some Gravitational Assists to get there.
trans-unit.target:
欢迎来到JUICE挑战!你能将JUICE送到Tydos吗?
燃料有限,你可能需要规划一些引力弹弓.

trans-unit.source:
First, let's deploy the instruments and solar panels.
%ActivateInstruction% and wait for all of them to be fully deployed.
trans-unit.target:
首先,让我们部署仪器和太阳能板
%ActivateInstruction% 然后等待它们完全展开部署.

trans-unit.source:
While things unfold, the Juno System isn't the same as the Solar System.
There are a couple details worth noting.
trans-unit.target:
在等待仪器展开时,考虑到Juno系和太阳系不太一样
有些值得提及的细节.

trans-unit.source: The real mission launched by the European Space Agency to explore Jupiter will do many gravity assists with the Moon, Earth and Venus to gain enough velocity to reach Jupiter.
trans-unit.target: 现实中,这枚由欧空局发射的探测器将会使用多次月球,地球,金星飞掠来积攒足够的速度前往木星.

trans-unit.source: Juno is much more benevolent, the energy required to get to the gas giants is much lower, and right now you are in a really good window to fly by Luna to get a boost to Tydos.
trans-unit.target: 在Juno系会简单一下,需要前往气态巨行星的能力要低很多,你现在正处于一个绝佳的Luna引力弹弓窗口.

trans-unit.source:
Plan your burns well, you can go crazy and have as many gravity assists as you want.
But if you forget efficiency, you may realise you don't have enough fuel too late.
trans-unit.target:
合理规划你的轨道机动,你可以尽情发挥,想打多少弹弓都行.
但如果你忽视了效率,意识到燃料不足时就晚了.

trans-unit.source:
If you zoom out you will see Tydos is currently targeted.
This shows some extra useful information in Map View, such as your closest approach.

To target other celestial bodies to plan your gravity assists
you can click on them directly or search them using the tool at the top left.
trans-unit.target:
如果你缩小地图你会发现目标被设置为Tydos
这会在地图界面额外显示有用的信息,比如最近的接近点

如果需要瞄准其他天体进行引力助推
你可以直接点击它们或者用左上角的搜索工具.

trans-unit.source:
Remember to start your engine or else you may miss a burn.
%ActivateInstruction% and throttle up when you are ready to go.

Good Luck!
trans-unit.target:
记得启动你的引擎,否则你可能会错过一次点火机会。
当你准备好出发时,%ActivateInstruction%并加大油门。

祝你好运!

trans-unit.source: Bring JUICE to Tydos. Fly by closer than 300Mm.
Fly by Tydos with a Periapsis under 300Mm
Bring your apoapsis down to get captured
trans-unit.target: 减少轨道远点以被捕获

trans-unit.source: That was quite the journey! If you'd like to know more about ESA's mission you can visit https://simplerockets.com/r/JUICE
trans-unit.target: 这真是一次难忘的旅程!如果你想了解更多关于欧洲航天局任务的信息,可以访问https://simplerockets.com/r/JUICE
